meaning: vi. 变均匀;vt. 使均匀

examples.en: Critics say streaming services homogenize music into safe, repetitive formulas.
examples.zh: 批评者称流媒体把音乐同质化为安全的套路。

meaning: a. 强夺的, 贪欲的, 贪婪的

examples.en: Villagers accused the rapacious logging company of stripping the hillsides bare.
examples.zh: 村民指责贪婪的伐木公司把山坡剃得精光。

meaning: vi. 屈尊;vt. 赐予

examples.en: The reclusive master would not deign to answer the journalists' questions.
examples.zh: 隐居的大师不屑回答记者的提问。

meaning: n. 雷格泰姆旋律, 散拍乐;a. 滑稽的

examples.en: The pianist opened the recital with a lively ragtime number.
examples.zh: 钢琴家以一曲轻快的拉格泰姆开场。

meaning: vt. 连累, 暗示...有罪, 控告;控告, 使入罪, 连累

examples.en: The seized emails clearly incriminate two senior managers in the scheme.
examples.zh: 查获的邮件清楚表明两名高管卷入该阴谋。

meaning: n. 大黄蜂

examples.en: A bumblebee buzzed from flower to flower in the herb garden.
examples.zh: 大黄蜂在香草园的花朵间嗡嗡穿行。

meaning: n. 寄宿处

examples.en: The creaking boardinghouse has lodged students since the 1920s.
examples.zh: 这家吱呀作响的公寓自二十年代就住着学生。

meaning: a. 清澈的, 透明的, 平静的

examples.en: The limpid water of the spring reveals every pebble below.
examples.zh: 清澈的泉水能看见水底的每颗卵石。

meaning: n. 脚镣, 羁绊, 束缚;vt. 束缚, 加脚镣

examples.en: Ancient traditions should not fetter the imagination of young designers.
examples.zh: 古老传统不应束缚年轻设计师的想象。

meaning: a. 脱水的

examples.en: Hikers who arrive dehydrated are treated before continuing up the trail.
examples.zh: 脱水抵达的徒步者要先处理再上山。

meaning: n. 甲壳, 壳;甲, 甲壳, 介

examples.en: The turtle's hard carapace protects it from most shoreline predators.
examples.zh: 海龟坚硬的甲壳能抵挡多数岸边捕食者。

meaning: n. 纹章, 纹章学, 军械库, 兵工厂;军械库

examples.en: The castle's armory displays swords and armor from four centuries.
examples.zh: 城堡的兵器馆展出四个世纪的刀剑盔甲。

meaning: a. 有韵律的, 有节奏的;节律的

examples.en: The rhythmical chanting of the rowers kept the longboat on course.
examples.zh: 桨手们有节奏的号子使长船保持航向。

meaning: n. 家具师, 细工木匠

examples.en: A skilled cabinetmaker joined the drawers without a single visible nail.
examples.zh: 手艺高超的家具师拼的抽屉看不见一颗钉子。

meaning: vt. 使困惑, 使仓皇失措, 打乱(计划等)

examples.en: The sudden technical glitches badly disconcerted the young presenter.
examples.zh: 突如其来的技术故障让年轻的主讲人手足无措。

meaning: a. 天生的；先天的

examples.en: Some researchers argue that a sense of fairness is inborn.
examples.zh: 一些研究者认为,公平感是与生俱来的。

meaning: vt. 取出内脏, 除去精华, 切除(病人)器官;vi. (因手术不良)内脏凸出

examples.en: The proposed amendments would effectively eviscerate the new privacy law.
examples.zh: 拟议的修正案将实质上掏空新隐私法。

meaning: adv. 现象, 从感官认识到, 非凡, 出众

examples.en: The tiny app grew phenomenally popular among teenagers within months.
examples.zh: 这款小应用几个月内在青少年中红得发紫。

meaning: a. 不注意的, 不留心的, 不谨慎的

examples.en: Heedless of the warnings, the hikers tried to cross the swollen river.
examples.zh: 徒步者不顾警告,试图蹚过暴涨的河水。

meaning: n. 矿脉, 水路, 排水沟

examples.en: Prospectors staked claims wherever they suspected a rich lode.
examples.zh: 探矿者在疑似富矿脉处圈地立桩。

meaning: n. 验光师, 配镜师;验光师

examples.en: The optometrist adjusted his prescription after the annual eye exam.
examples.zh: 年度验光后,验光师调整了他的镜片度数。

meaning: a. 轻率的, 鲁莽的

examples.en: It was imprudent to post confidential slides on a public forum.
examples.zh: 把机密幻灯片发到公开论坛实在轻率。

meaning: vt. 饮, 吸取, 吸入;vi. 喝, 吸收水分

examples.en: Delegates imbibed enormous quantities of coffee during the all-night negotiations.
examples.zh: 通宵谈判中,代表们灌下了大量咖啡。

meaning: vt. 硬卖给, 偷偷插入, 使混入

examples.en: Publishers should not foist dull textbooks on captive students.
examples.zh: 出版商不该把乏味的教材硬塞给学生。

meaning: n. 瘟疫, 散布毒害的事物, 罪恶;疫病, 疫病流行

examples.en: Medieval chronicles describe pestilence sweeping through crowded port cities.
examples.zh: 中世纪编年史记载瘟疫横扫拥挤的港城。

meaning: a. 滑稽的, 爱开玩笑的

examples.en: His facetious remarks about the budget crisis annoyed the auditors.
examples.zh: 他拿预算危机开玩笑的话惹恼了审计员。

meaning: a. 悲哀的, 忧郁的, 阴沉的

examples.en: The doleful sound of the foghorn echoed across the bay.
examples.zh: 雾号凄凉的鸣响在海湾上空回荡。

meaning: n. (被风刮在一起的)雪堆, 随风飘飞的雪

examples.en: A snowdrift blocked the farmhouse door after the overnight blizzard.
examples.zh: 一夜暴风雪后,雪堆堵住了农舍的门。

meaning: n. 人造丝;人造纤维; 人造丝

examples.en: The summer dresses are made from light, breathable rayon.
examples.zh: 这些夏装由轻盈透气的人造丝制成。

meaning: n. 热力学;热力学

examples.en: The second law of thermodynamics explains why engines can never be perfectly efficient.
examples.zh: 热力学第二定律解释了发动机为何永远无法完全高效。

meaning: a. 不可忍受的, 忍耐不住的

examples.en: Colleagues found his insufferable arrogance impossible to work with.
examples.zh: 同事们觉得他傲慢得让人无法忍受,难以共事。

meaning: n. 缝被子的人

examples.en: The quilter stitches each cover from scraps of old clothing.
examples.zh: 缝被匠用旧衣碎布缝制每床被子。

meaning: n. 嘲鸫

examples.en: A mockingbird imitated car alarms from the neighbor's rooftop.
examples.zh: 嘲鸫在邻居屋顶上模仿汽车警报声。

meaning: n. 叉角羚

examples.en: The pronghorn can sustain high speeds across open prairie for miles.
examples.zh: 叉角羚能在开阔草原上高速奔跑数英里。

meaning: n. 焊接剂, 接合物;v. 施以焊接, 焊合, 联结

examples.en: A single cracked solder joint caused the keyboard to fail intermittently.
examples.zh: 一处虚焊导致键盘间歇失灵。

meaning: a. 无嗅的, 没有气味的

examples.en: The gas is naturally odorless, so a warning agent is added.
examples.zh: 这种气体本来无味,因此加入了警示剂。

meaning: a. 旋律美妙的, 旋律优美的, 有乐曲的

examples.en: The melodious call of the blackbird greets each spring morning.
examples.zh: 乌鸫婉转的鸣叫迎来每个春晨。

meaning: n. 倦怠, 厌倦;厌倦

examples.en: A creeping ennui settled over the team after the third restructuring.
examples.zh: 第三次重组后,一种莫名的倦怠笼罩全组。

meaning: vt. 抹去, 消除, 忘却

examples.en: Time could not efface the memory of that terrible winter.
examples.zh: 时间也抹不去那个寒冬的记忆。

meaning: n. 软木材

examples.en: Fast-growing softwood like pine is cheaper than dense hardwood.
examples.zh: 松木等速生软木比致密硬木便宜。

meaning: a. 听觉的, 声学的

examples.en: Thick velvet curtains noticeably improved the hall's acoustical quality.
examples.zh: 厚重的天鹅绒窗帘明显改善了大厅的声学效果。

meaning: a. 假装圣洁的, 假装虔诚的, 假装诚实的

examples.en: His sanctimonious lectures on honesty rang hollow after the scandal.
examples.zh: 丑闻之后,他关于诚实的伪善说教显得空洞。

meaning: v. 延长, (使)伸延;a. 伸长的

examples.en: Shadows elongate dramatically across the square as the sun sets.
examples.zh: 日落时分,广场上的影子被拉得极长。

meaning: n. 城市居民

examples.en: A lifelong urbanite struggled to adjust to the village's slow rhythm.
examples.zh: 过惯都市生活的人难以适应乡村的慢节奏。

meaning: n. 海蓝宝石, 浅绿色;海蓝宝石

examples.en: The bride chose an aquamarine ring instead of a traditional diamond.
examples.zh: 新娘选了海蓝宝石戒指,而非传统钻戒。

meaning: adv. 威胁地, 胁迫地, 危险地

examples.en: The dog growled threateningly when the stranger touched the gate.
examples.zh: 陌生人碰门时,那条狗发出威胁的低吼。

meaning: n. 经雕琢的宝石

examples.en: The apprentice learned to cut and polish each gemstone by hand.
examples.zh: 学徒学习手工切割打磨每颗宝石。

meaning: vt. 挤出, 压出, 逐出;vi. 伸出, 突出

examples.en: The machine can extrude molten plastic into almost any shape.
examples.zh: 这台机器能把熔融塑料挤成几乎任何形状。

meaning: n. 狭小空间, 鸡笼, 捕鱼篓;vt. 关进鸡舍, 监禁

examples.en: The hens were shut safely in the coop before the fox arrived.
examples.zh: 狐狸到来之前,母鸡已被安全关进鸡舍。

meaning: a. 慢的, 迟到的, 勉强的, 拖拉的, 迟的

examples.en: Two tardy grain deliveries in one week angered the miller.
examples.zh: 一周内两次粮食迟到让磨坊主很恼火。

meaning: n. 折光, 折射;折射, 屈光

examples.en: Refraction bends light, making the submerged coin appear displaced.
examples.zh: 折射弯曲光线,使水中的硬币看似错位。

meaning: n. 表皮, (昆虫的)真皮;表皮

examples.en: The epidermis serves as the body's first barrier against infection.
examples.zh: 表皮是人体抵御感染的第一道屏障。

meaning: vt. 照耀, 启发, 使灿烂, 放射;vi. 发光, 变灿烂

examples.en: Factories irradiate certain spices to kill harmful bacteria.
examples.zh: 工厂对某些香料辐照杀菌。

meaning: a. 结晶的, 使晶状的;v. 使结晶( crystallize的过去式和过去分词); 计划成型, 具体化

examples.en: Her vague ideas finally crystallized into a coherent research proposal.
examples.zh: 她模糊的想法最终凝成一份连贯的研究计划。

meaning: a. 腺的, 含腺的, 天生的, 固有的, 肉体的;腺的

examples.en: The glandular tissue releases hormones that regulate metabolism throughout the body.
examples.zh: 腺体组织释放调节全身代谢的激素。

meaning: n. 慢, 缓慢, 迟延

examples.en: His repeated tardiness eventually cost the courier his job.
examples.zh: 屡屡迟到最终让快递员丢了工作。

meaning: a. 很多的, 丰富的, 浪费的, 慷慨的

examples.en: The landlord offered profuse apologies for the broken heating.
examples.zh: 房东对暖气故障连声道歉。

meaning: v. 压缩, 压紧, 使收缩( constrict的过去式和过去分词)

examples.en: The tunnel's constricted entrance allows only one car at a time.
examples.zh: 隧道狭窄的入口一次只容一辆车通过。

meaning: n. 仆人, 侍从, 马屁精;vt. 服侍, 侍候, 奉承

examples.en: The dictator sent his lackeys to silence the independent editors.
examples.zh: 独裁者派走卒去让独立编辑噤声。

meaning: a. 夸大的, 夸夸其谈的

examples.en: Voters tired of the candidate's bombastic promises of instant prosperity.
examples.zh: 选民厌倦了候选人夸夸其谈的速富承诺。

meaning: n. 城市居民的生活方式, 城市化

examples.en: The mayor championed walkable streets as the core of her urbanism.
examples.zh: 市长把可步行街道作为其城市规划理念的核心。

meaning: a. 不适合的, 不合体的, 不相配的

examples.en: Shouting at referees is unbecoming behavior for a team captain.
examples.zh: 冲裁判大喊大叫有失队长风范。

meaning: v. 节约, 节省, 有效地利用

examples.en: The family decided to economize by cooking at home every night.
examples.zh: 这家人决定每晚在家做饭以节省开支。

meaning: n. 水道, 河道;水流权, 河流, 水路

examples.en: The old watercourse was restored to feed the dry wetlands.
examples.zh: 古河道得以修复,为干涸的湿地供水。

meaning: n. 陆块

examples.en: Antarctica is the coldest landmass and holds most of earth's freshwater.
examples.zh: 南极洲是最冷的大陆块,储存着地球大部分淡水。

meaning: a. 有先见之明的, 有远虑的, 节俭的

examples.en: Provident farmers store surplus grain against the risk of drought.
examples.zh: 有远见的农民储存余粮以防旱灾。

meaning: n. 轻率, 轻浮, 不稳定

examples.en: A moment of levity eased the tension in the courtroom.
examples.zh: 片刻的轻松缓和了法庭里的紧张气氛。

meaning: vi. 闷热, 被暑气所苦, 汗流浃背;vt. 使闷热, 使热得出汗

examples.en: Commuters swelter on packed trains whenever the air conditioning fails.
examples.zh: 空调一失灵,通勤者就在拥挤车厢里闷热难当。

meaning: vt. 以甜言蜜语诱惑, 用甜言蜜语骗;vi. 用甜言蜜语哄骗

examples.en: The child tried to wheedle an extra dessert with charming smiles.
examples.zh: 孩子想靠讨喜的笑脸哄来多一份甜点。

meaning: a. 刮风的, 阵阵猛急的, 突发的, 津津有味的

examples.en: Gusty winds forced the balloon pilots to land before noon.
examples.zh: 阵风迫使热气球飞行员中午前降落。

meaning: a. 抱不平的, 不满的, 不服的;n. 不满现状的人

examples.en: A group of malcontent employees leaked the memo to the press.
examples.zh: 一伙不满的员工把备忘录泄露给媒体。

meaning: vt. 切割, 雕刻;切

examples.en: The artisan will incise the couple's names into the silver band.
examples.zh: 工匠将把两人的名字刻在银环上。

meaning: a. 易弯的, 柔韧的, 柔顺的

examples.en: Bamboo is remarkably pliant, bending in storms without breaking.
examples.zh: 竹子极为柔韧,风暴中弯而不折。

meaning: n. 六角形, 六边形;六角, 六角形, 六角边

examples.en: Each cell of the honeycomb is a nearly perfect hexagon.
examples.zh: 蜂巢的每个巢室都是近乎完美的六边形。

meaning: a. 有齿的, 锯齿的, 锯齿状的

examples.en: The toothed belt driving the camshaft should be replaced at regular intervals.
examples.zh: 驱动凸轮轴的齿形皮带应定期更换。

meaning: n. 伴舞乐队的指挥

examples.en: The bandleader cued the brass section for the final chorus.
examples.zh: 乐队指挥示意铜管部进入最后副歌。

meaning: n. 副业, 嗜好;法院之间诉讼的转移, 职业, 本职

examples.en: Carpentry began as a weekend avocation but became her main career.
examples.zh: 木工起初是周末爱好,后来成了她的主业。

meaning: a. 讽刺的, 挖苦的

examples.en: The magazine's satiric covers often anger the powerful.
examples.zh: 这本杂志的讽刺封面常惹恼权贵。

meaning: vt. 课税过重, 使负担过度;抽税过重, 负担过度

examples.en: Taking nine courses this term would overtax even the strongest student.
examples.zh: 这学期修九门课,最强的学生也会吃不消。

meaning: n. 抵押品, 挑战;vt. 以...为担保, 以...为赌注

examples.en: The knight offered his sword as a gage of honorable intent.
examples.zh: 骑士献出佩剑,以示诚信。

meaning: a. 软弱的, 没气力的, 无活力的;弛缓的

examples.en: The celery turned flaccid after a week forgotten in the fridge.
examples.zh: 在冰箱里放了一周,芹菜变得软塌塌。

meaning: n. 不敬, 非礼, 不敬行为

examples.en: His irreverence toward sacred traditions both delighted and scandalized readers.
examples.zh: 他对神圣传统的亵渎式不敬让读者又惊又喜。

meaning: vt. 强夺, 夺走, 使出神, 强奸;强夺, 抢去, 强奸

examples.en: The audience was ravished by the soprano's flawless high notes.
examples.zh: 女高音完美的高音令听众如痴如醉。

meaning: vt. 使升华, 使高尚;vi. 升华, 纯化

examples.en: Competitive athletes often sublimate their frustration into relentless daily training.
examples.zh: 竞技选手常把挫败感升华为日复一日的苦练。

meaning: vt. 使受苦, 使(更)恶化, 使怨恨, 加苦味于

examples.en: Years of unpaid overtime embittered the once loyal staff.
examples.zh: 常年无偿加班让原本忠心的员工心怀怨愤。

meaning: n. 乡下人, 乡巴佬；山地内部的贫农, 山地人

examples.en: The comedian rejected the lazy hillbilly stereotype in his new special.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员在新专场里拒绝了俗套的乡巴佬形象。

meaning: n. 迅速, 快

examples.en: The falcon strikes its prey with astonishing swiftness.
examples.zh: 游隼出击猎物时速度惊人。

meaning: a. 清爽的, 疾行的, 强烈的;adv. 显著地

examples.en: The crew put a spanking new coat of paint on the old tram.
examples.zh: 工人们给旧电车刷上崭新的油漆。

meaning: a. 想要的, 想望的, 渴望的

examples.en: The board is desirous of a partner with deep retail experience.
examples.zh: 董事会渴盼拥有深厚零售经验的伙伴。

meaning: adv. 反季节地；不合季节地

examples.en: An unseasonably warm March tricked the orchards into early blossom.
examples.zh: 三月反常温暖,诱使果园提前开花。

meaning: vt. 赔偿, 补偿, 保护, 保障;赔偿

examples.en: The insurer agreed to indemnify the firm against future lawsuits.
examples.zh: 保险公司同意为企业未来的诉讼提供保障。

meaning: a. 教育学的, 教授法的, 小学教师的

examples.en: The school pairs every new teacher with a pedagogic mentor.
examples.zh: 学校给每位新教师配备教学导师。

meaning: vt. 增威严, 使高贵, 故作显贵

examples.en: The spokesperson refused to dignify the rumor with a response.
examples.zh: 发言人拒绝回应,免得抬高那则谣言。

meaning: n. 肖像画家, 人像摄影师

examples.en: The court portraitist captured the queen's weary expression perfectly.
examples.zh: 宫廷肖像画家精准捕捉了女王倦怠的神情。

meaning: n. 石工, 石匠

examples.en: A stonemason spent the summer repairing the abbey's weathered walls.
examples.zh: 一位石匠花了整个夏天修缮修道院风化的石墙。

meaning: a. 饶舌的, 多嘴的, 喋喋不休的

examples.en: The garrulous taxi driver shared his entire life story during the ride.
examples.zh: 话痨司机一路讲完了自己的整个人生。

meaning: a. 符合语言习惯的, 惯用的, 有许多习语的

examples.en: Fluent speakers use idiomatic phrases that rarely appear in textbooks.
examples.zh: 地道的说话者常用教科书上少见的习语。

meaning: n. 引力, 重力, 沉下;引力

examples.en: Gravitation keeps the moon in orbit around the earth.
examples.zh: 引力使月球保持在绕地球的轨道上。

meaning: vt. 养驯, 引进(外来词等), 教化

examples.en: Ancient farmers managed to domesticate wild grasses into productive wheat.
examples.zh: 古代农人把野草驯化成高产的麦子。

meaning: n. 联盟, 邦联;共谋, 违法的结社, 联盟

examples.en: The coastal cities formed a confederacy to protect their trade routes.
examples.zh: 沿海诸城结成联盟以保护商路。

meaning: n. 人工孵化的鱼苗或小鸟

examples.en: Each hatchling must reach the sea before the gulls descend.
examples.zh: 每只幼龟都得赶在鸥群俯冲前入海。

meaning: a. 自夸的, 自负的, 喜夸耀的

examples.en: Nobody believed the boastful claims in the late-night commercials.
examples.zh: 没人相信深夜广告里那些夸海口的说法。

meaning: a. 灵巧的, 敏捷的, 聪明的

examples.en: The adroit negotiator settled the strike within a single morning.
examples.zh: 干练的谈判手一个上午就化解了罢工。

meaning: vi. 七嘴八嘴地说, 喋喋不休地说;vt. 急促地说

examples.en: Excited children gabble so fast that parents miss half the story.
examples.zh: 孩子们兴奋起来叽里咕噜,家长漏听一半。

meaning: n. 咖啡壶, 小饭店, 午餐柜

examples.en: The office coffeepot was always empty by ten o'clock.
examples.zh: 到十点,办公室的咖啡壶准是空的。

meaning: n. 独裁者

examples.en: The aging autocrat jailed journalists who questioned his decrees.
examples.zh: 年迈的独裁者监禁质疑其法令的记者。

meaning: vt. 装饰, 修饰

examples.en: Villagers bedeck the streets with lanterns before the harvest festival.
examples.zh: 收获节前,村民们用灯笼装点街道。

meaning: a. 逃避现实的;n. 逃避现实者

examples.en: After exhausting shifts, nurses turn to escapist novels for relief.
examples.zh: 下班后,护士们靠逃离现实的小说解乏。

meaning: a. 有义务的; 必须的; 有责任的;v. 使负有责任或义务（ obligate的过去式和过去分词 ）

examples.en: Judges are obligated to disclose any financial interest in a case.
examples.zh: 法官有义务披露与案件的任何经济利益关联。

meaning: n. 折衷派, 折衷主义, 折衷说;折衷医学

examples.en: The gallery's eclecticism ranges from folk art to video installations.
examples.zh: 这家画廊包罗万象,从民间艺术到影像装置。

meaning: a. 一致的, 符合的, 同时发生的

examples.en: The rise in unemployment was coincident with the collapse of tourism.
examples.zh: 失业率上升与旅游业崩溃恰好同时发生。

meaning: n. 语文学, 文献学

examples.en: Classical philology requires patient study of handwritten medieval manuscripts.
examples.zh: 古典语文学需要耐心研究中世纪手抄本。

meaning: a. 火的, 似火的, 火成的

examples.en: Igneous rocks form when molten magma cools and solidifies.
examples.zh: 火成岩由熔融岩浆冷却凝固而成。

meaning: n. 旋回, 回转, 旋转;回旋, 环旋

examples.en: The skater's rapid gyration drew audible gasps from the audience.
examples.zh: 滑冰者急速的旋转引来观众阵阵惊叹。

meaning: vt. 除去污物, 澄清, 净化;vi. 澄清, 排便

examples.en: Careful owners ensure their pets do not defecate on the running track.
examples.zh: 细心的主人确保宠物不在跑道上排便。

meaning: vt. 使不活动, 撤销, 使失去活性, 灭活;灭活, 使不活动

examples.en: Heating the serum can inactivate most lingering viruses.
examples.zh: 加热血清可使大部分残留病毒灭活。

meaning: n. 探矿, 勘探

examples.en: Gold prospecting once drew thousands of families to the frozen north.
examples.zh: 淘金热曾把成千上万的家庭引向冰封的北方。

meaning: vt. 使衰弱

examples.en: Repeated malaria attacks can debilitate a child for months.
examples.zh: 疟疾反复发作能让孩子虚弱数月。

meaning: vt. 使消瘦, 使憔悴;vi. 消瘦

examples.en: Prolonged hunger can emaciate even the sturdiest adolescents.
examples.zh: 长期饥饿连最壮实的少年也会消瘦。

meaning: v. 掩饰, 假装不知道

examples.en: Caught officials often dissemble rather than admit simple mistakes.
examples.zh: 被抓住错处的官员往往遮遮掩掩,不认低级失误。

meaning: n. 硅酸盐;硅酸盐; 硅酸酯

examples.en: The lunar soil is rich in silicate minerals similar to earth's.
examples.zh: 月壤富含与地球相近的硅酸盐矿物。

meaning: vt. 使狂喜

examples.en: The violin solo seemed to enrapture the entire concert hall.
examples.zh: 小提琴独奏仿佛令整座音乐厅如痴如醉。

meaning: a. 懒惰的, 无痛的;无痛的

examples.en: The indolent heir let the family business drift into bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 懒散的继承人任由家族企业滑向破产。

meaning: vt. 使习惯于;vi. 生效

examples.en: Desert guides are inured to temperatures that floor ordinary travelers.
examples.zh: 沙漠向导早已习惯让普通旅行者瘫倒的高温。

meaning: a. 不能渗透的, 不能通过的;不透性

examples.en: The clay liner makes the landfill impermeable to rainwater.
examples.zh: 黏土衬层使垃圾场不渗雨水。

meaning: n. 忠诚, 忠贞, 忠实

examples.en: The barons swore fealty to the young king at the coronation.
examples.zh: 加冕礼上,贵族们向年轻的国王宣誓效忠。

meaning: n. 契约, 契据, 凹痕;vt. 以契约束缚

examples.en: Poor migrants signed indenture contracts promising years of unpaid labor.
examples.zh: 贫穷移民签订契约,允诺多年无偿劳作。

meaning: a. 盐水似的, 海水似的, 咸的;含盐度

examples.en: The briny breeze carried the smell of the exposed mudflats.
examples.zh: 咸涩的海风带来裸露泥滩的气味。

meaning: a. 不狡猾的, 诚实的

examples.en: His guileless smile put even wary clients at ease.
examples.zh: 他毫无心机的笑容连谨慎的客户也放松下来。

meaning: a. 迅速的, 敏捷的

examples.en: The crew made expeditious repairs before the storm arrived.
examples.zh: 队员们赶在风暴来临前迅速完成抢修。

meaning: n. 贪婪

examples.en: The report laid the firm's collapse squarely at the feet of avarice.
examples.zh: 报告把公司倒闭直接归咎于贪婪。

meaning: n. 不适合, 不一致, 不信奉国教

examples.en: Her bold nonconformity in dress set her apart in the conservative office.
examples.zh: 她大胆不羁的着装在保守的办公室里格外扎眼。

meaning: v. 混合

examples.en: The rules forbid brokers to commingle client funds with their own.
examples.zh: 规定禁止经纪商把客户资金与自有资金混同。

meaning: vt. 分裂, 劈开, 强夺, 撕碎, 划破;vi. 撕开, 裂开

examples.en: Critics warned the dispute could rend the party in two.
examples.zh: 批评人士警告,这场纷争可能使政党裂成两半。

meaning: a. 不高兴的, 不平的

examples.en: The grouchy neighbor complained about every ball that landed in his yard.
examples.zh: 脾气坏的邻居抱怨每个掉进院子的球。

meaning: vt. 使复员, 使退伍, 遣散

examples.en: The government began to demobilize thousands of soldiers after the treaty.
examples.zh: 条约签订后,政府开始遣散数以千计的士兵。

meaning: vt.以符号表示,把.....写成记号(或标志)

examples.en: Composers notate their ideas as fast as the melodies arrive.
examples.zh: 旋律一到,作曲家便尽快记成乐谱。

meaning: a. 无比的, 出类的, 无双的

examples.en: Her peerless control of tone sets this cellist above her rivals.
examples.zh: 这位大提琴家无与伦比的音色掌控使她技压群芳。

meaning: a. 可尊敬的, 可估计的

examples.en: The estimable professor donated her entire prize to the scholarship fund.
examples.zh: 可敬的教授把全部奖金捐给奖学金基金。

meaning: n. 凝结器, 冷凝器, 缩写者;聚光器; 电容器; 冷凝器; 冷凝塔

examples.en: The condenser converts spent steam back into water for reuse.
examples.zh: 冷凝器把废蒸汽重新变为水以循环使用。

meaning: a. 过敏的, 高灵敏度的;过敏的

examples.en: Hypersensitive skin often reacts badly to common cosmetic fragrances.
examples.zh: 高敏皮肤常对常见的化妆品香料起不良反应。

meaning: n. 生皮, 生皮鞭;vt. (用生皮鞭)抽打

examples.en: The puppy chewed the rawhide bone for hours without pause.
examples.zh: 小狗不停嘴地啃了好几个小时生皮骨头。

meaning: a. 吝啬的, 贪婪的

examples.en: The miserly owner refused to heat the offices past noon.
examples.zh: 吝啬的老板过了中午就不给办公室供暖。

meaning: n. 伪装, 假装, 假托, 佯攻;vi. 装作, 假装, 佯攻

examples.en: The striker's clever feint sent the goalkeeper the wrong way.
examples.zh: 前锋巧妙的假动作骗得守门员扑错方向。

meaning: a. 无脊椎的, 没有骨气的, 懦弱的

examples.en: Colleagues called the manager spineless for never defending his staff.
examples.zh: 同事说经理没骨气,从不为下属撑腰。

meaning: v. 混合, 混入( mingle的现在分词 ); 混进, 与…交往

examples.en: Casual mingling between conference sessions sparked several joint ventures.
examples.zh: 会议间隙的随意交流促成了几桩合作。

meaning: 钾碱;钾硷, 碳酸钾, 草硷

examples.en: The region's potash deposits supply farmers with potassium fertilizer.
examples.zh: 该地区的钾碱矿藏为农民供应钾肥。

meaning: a. 轻浮的, 轻狂的, 心情浮动的

examples.en: Her flighty decisions kept the design team in constant chaos.
examples.zh: 她反复无常的决定让设计团队一直乱作一团。

meaning: n. 诽谤, 中伤, 洒水;喷洒

examples.en: Rival campaigns cast aspersions on his academic record.
examples.zh: 竞争阵营对他的学历含沙射影。

meaning: n. 语音学, 语音体系, 表音拼法;语音学

examples.en: Phonetics explains why learners often confuse these two vowel sounds.
examples.zh: 语音学解释了学习者为何常混淆这两个元音。

meaning: a. 过于自信的, 自负的;过于自信的, 过于自恃的

examples.en: The overconfident pilot ignored two separate warnings from the tower.
examples.zh: 过于自信的飞行员无视塔台的两次警告。

meaning: a. 有鳞(斑)的, 瓦片迭盖的, 栉比鳞次的

examples.en: The chef scaled and gutted the fish in under a minute.
examples.zh: 厨师不到一分钟就刮净鱼鳞、去除内脏。

meaning: a. 熔化的, 熔凝的

examples.en: The short circuit left two cables fused into one charred mass.
examples.zh: 短路使两条电缆熔成焦黑的一团。

meaning: n. 智力迟钝的学生, 傻瓜

examples.en: He was labeled the class dunce until a teacher spotted his gift.
examples.zh: 他一直被当作班里的笨学生,直到有老师发现他的天赋。

meaning: vt. 使组织化, 使系统化, 把...分类;系统化, 分类

examples.en: The librarian worked weekends to systematize the uncatalogued letters.
examples.zh: 图书管理员周末加班,把未编目的信件系统整理。

meaning: a. 送葬的, 适合葬礼的, 悲哀的

examples.en: The committee met in funereal silence after the funding cuts.
examples.zh: 经费被砍后,委员会在死一般沉寂中开会。

meaning: n. 银(器)匠

examples.en: The silversmith hammered the bowl from a single flat sheet.
examples.zh: 银匠用一张平银片锤打出这只碗。

meaning: n. 雾号, 响而尖的声音

examples.en: The foghorn moaned every thirty seconds through the thick night mist.
examples.zh: 浓雾弥漫的夜里,雾号每三十秒低鸣一次。

meaning: n. 礼貌, 礼让;礼让, 友谊

examples.en: Decades of comity between the two courts eased the extradition process.
examples.zh: 两家法院多年的礼让简化了引渡程序。

meaning: n. 即兴创作者

examples.en: A gifted improviser, the pianist never plays a piece the same way.
examples.zh: 这位钢琴家即兴天赋出众,同一首曲子从不重样。

meaning: n. 结晶, 定形, 明朗化, 具体化;结晶

examples.en: The crystallization of salt leaves white rings on the shallow rocks.
examples.zh: 盐分结晶在浅水岩石上留下白色环痕。

meaning: v. 分割…的肢体, 肢解( dismember的过去式和过去分词); 身首异处

examples.en: The dismembered fresco was reassembled from fragments held in three museums.
examples.zh: 支离破碎的壁画由三座博物馆的残片复原。

meaning: n. 叛教, 变节, 脱党;叛教, 背教, 脱党

examples.en: In that strict era, apostasy from the state church cost him his post.
examples.zh: 在那个严苛年代,叛离国教使他丢掉职位。

meaning: a. 卑贱的, 卑鄙的, 低级的

examples.en: The general was discharged for the ignoble theft of relief supplies.
examples.zh: 将军因卑劣地盗窃救援物资而被除役。

meaning: n. 顶点, 极度, 最高点;极期

examples.en: Many critics consider this symphony the acme of the composer's career.
examples.zh: 许多评论家视这部交响曲为作曲家生涯的巅峰。

meaning: n. 自制;节制; 节欲

examples.en: Stroke patients often need months of therapy to restore continence.
examples.zh: 中风患者常需数月治疗才能恢复自控能力。

meaning: n. 芽, 嫩枝;v. 萌芽, 发芽

examples.en: Small tech firms burgeon wherever fast broadband reaches rural towns.
examples.zh: 宽带一通到乡镇,小型科技公司便蓬勃生长。

meaning: 残存性, 生存性, 耐受性

examples.en: Engineers tested the capsule's survivability in extreme reentry heat.
examples.zh: 工程师测试返回舱在再入高温下的存活性。

meaning: n. 自我主义, 利己主义

examples.en: Raw egoism, not strategy, drove the chairman's sudden resignation.
examples.zh: 促使董事长突然辞职的是赤裸的私心。

meaning: a. 鲁莽的, 卑鄙的, 厚颜无耻的

examples.en: The impudent clerk rolled his eyes at the customer's question.
examples.zh: 无礼的店员对顾客的提问直翻白眼。

meaning: vt. 启迪, 熏陶, 教诲

examples.en: The museum's new wing was designed to edify and delight visitors.
examples.zh: 博物馆新翼旨在启迪并愉悦观众。

meaning: vi. 附着, 粘着, 凝聚, 一致;粘合

examples.en: A strong narrative thread helps the essay's paragraphs cohere.
examples.zh: 有力的叙事主线让文章各段浑然一体。

meaning: a. 肥大的, 肥胖的;肥胖的

examples.en: The corpulent king required a specially reinforced chair for ceremonies.
examples.zh: 肥胖的国王需要特制加固椅出席典礼。

meaning: vt. 夺取, 掠夺

examples.en: Illegal miners continue to despoil the protected rainforest.
examples.zh: 非法矿工继续糟蹋这片受保护雨林。

meaning: a. 不安的, 窘迫的

examples.en: The abashed student apologized after interrupting the lecture twice.
examples.zh: 窘迫的学生两次打断讲课后连声道歉。

meaning: a. 无弹性的, 无弹力的, 无适应性的;无弹性的

examples.en: Demand for insulin is inelastic because patients cannot do without it.
examples.zh: 胰岛素需求缺乏弹性,因为患者离不了它。

meaning: a. 有利益的, 唯利是图的

examples.en: Many graduates struggle to find gainful employment in their field.
examples.zh: 许多毕业生难以找到本专业收入可观的工作。

meaning: n. 头韵;同音韵错误症

examples.en: The slogan's catchy alliteration makes it easy to remember.
examples.zh: 标语上口的头韵让人过耳不忘。

meaning: a. 耐火的, 防火的;vi. 变成有耐火性

examples.en: The archive stores rare maps in fireproof steel cabinets.
examples.zh: 档案馆把珍稀地图存入防火钢柜。

meaning: v. (使)膨胀, (使)扩张

examples.en: The condition causes the abdomen to distend painfully after meals.
examples.zh: 这种病使腹部饭后胀痛膨大。

meaning: n. 薪水, 报酬

examples.en: The charter listed every emolument attached to the office of mayor.
examples.zh: 章程列出市长职位附带的所有薪俸。

meaning: a. 奴隶的, 奴性的, 盲从的

examples.en: The intern's slavish copying of the old format pleased nobody.
examples.zh: 实习生一味照搬旧格式,谁都不满意。

meaning: a. 预兆的, 预后的;n. 先兆, 预测

examples.en: Rising antibody levels are a useful prognostic sign for recovery.
examples.zh: 抗体水平上升是有利于康复的预后迹象。

meaning: 压缩, 浓缩, 精简, 简缩

examples.en: Heavy machinery caused severe soil compaction across the building site.
examples.zh: 重型机械使工地土壤严重板结。

meaning: a. 体操的, 体育的

examples.en: Her gymnastic routine combines daring difficulty with elegant control.
examples.zh: 她的体操动作把高难与优雅融为一体。

meaning: 偶然地, 意外地

examples.en: The missing manuscript was fortuitously discovered during an office move.
examples.zh: 搬办公室时侥幸找到了丢失的手稿。

meaning: vi. 飞奔, 疾行;n. 飞奔, 飞云, 小阵雨, 皮垢

examples.en: Low clouds scud across the ridge before an autumn storm.
examples.zh: 秋雨来临前,低云疾掠过山脊。

meaning: vt. 开动, 驱使, 激励

examples.en: A single sensor actuates the entire alarm sequence.
examples.zh: 一个传感器就能启动整套报警程序。

meaning: n. 出口, 外出;vi. 外出

examples.en: The safety inspector demanded a second point of egress from the basement.
examples.zh: 安全检查员要求地下室增设第二出口。

meaning: n. (大学)研究生助教奖学金

examples.en: She funded her graduate studies through a teaching assistantship.
examples.zh: 她靠助教奖学金读完研究生。

meaning: a. 阴谋的, 诡诈的;n. 设计(工作), 计谋

examples.en: The designing clerk spread rumors to undermine her rival's promotion.
examples.zh: 工于心计的职员散布谣言,毁掉对手升迁。

meaning: n. 拂晓, 黎明

examples.en: At the dawning of the industrial age, steam reshaped every trade.
examples.zh: 工业时代的曙光里,蒸汽重塑各行各业。

meaning: vt. 使隔离, 使孤立, 隔开

examples.en: He built a cabin in the pines to seclude himself from city noise.
examples.zh: 他在松林里筑屋,把自己与城市喧嚣隔开。

meaning: n. 联合, 结合, 合并;聚并; 凝并

examples.en: The movement grew from the coalescence of several local protests.
examples.zh: 这场运动由几场地方抗议汇聚而成。

meaning: vt. 偷窃, 窃取

examples.en: The magpie would filch shiny coins from the open till.
examples.zh: 那只喜鹊会从敞开的钱箱叼走亮硬币。

meaning: n. 光球, 发光球体;光球

examples.en: Sunspots appear as cooler patches within the sun's photosphere.
examples.zh: 太阳黑子是太阳光球层中较冷的区域。

meaning: n. 变质, 糟蹋, 损耗, 损坏;(原料,材料,产品)损坏

examples.en: Cold storage reduces spoilage of berries during long shipments.
examples.zh: 冷藏减少浆果长途运输中的腐坏。

meaning: n. 武器, 军事行动;武器, 军械, 枪械

examples.en: The ceasefire agreement bars both nations from importing new arms.
examples.zh: 停火协议禁止两国进口新武器。

meaning: a. 易传染的, 有魅力的, 吸引人的

examples.en: His nervousness proved catching, and soon the whole waiting room fidgeted.
examples.zh: 他的紧张会传染,不久候诊室人人坐立不安。

meaning: a. 树的, 栖于树木的;树的, 树上生活的

examples.en: Monkeys are mostly arboreal, feeding on leaves high in the canopy.
examples.zh: 猴子大多树栖,在林冠高处觅食树叶。

meaning: a. 吵闹的

examples.en: Clamorous fans pressed against the barriers outside the hotel.
examples.zh: 喧闹的粉丝挤在酒店外的护栏上。

meaning: a. 难解的, 深奥的

examples.en: The professor made even abstruse physics feel like plain common sense.
examples.zh: 教授连深奥的物理都讲得像常识。

meaning: n. 放映员, 电视技师, 地图制作者

examples.en: The old projectionist still runs film reels every weekend.
examples.zh: 老放映员每个周末仍放胶片电影。

meaning: vt. 谴责, 责骂, 申斥

examples.en: The captain began to upbraid the sailors for their carelessness.
examples.zh: 船长开始训斥水手的粗心大意。

meaning: a. 轻信的, 易受骗的

examples.en: Credulous investors wired money to a firm that existed only on paper.
examples.zh: 轻信的投资者把钱汇给只有纸面存在的公司。

meaning: n. 割让, 转让;财产权利等的转让, 再保险

examples.en: The peace treaty included the cession of the disputed border province.
examples.zh: 和约包括割让争议边境省份。

meaning: n. 市郊化, 郊区化；近郊化

examples.en: Rapid suburbanization swallowed farmland as commuters sought cheaper housing.
examples.zh: 通勤者寻求更便宜的住房,快速的郊区化吞噬农田。

meaning: 左利或右利(偏于用一侧手工作)

examples.en: Studies find no link between handedness and mathematical ability.
examples.zh: 研究发现惯用手与数学能力并无关联。

meaning: n. 磁层;磁动层

examples.en: Earth's magnetosphere shields the surface from lethal solar radiation.
examples.zh: 地球磁层保护地表免受致命太阳辐射。

meaning: n. 冗长的文章, (瓦工用的)抹灰靠尺;事故陈述书, 呈文, 冗长文章

examples.en: The manager posted a three-page screed against remote work.
examples.zh: 经理发长文痛批远程办公,足有三页。

meaning: a. 驯服的, 易于管教的;易加工的, 易处理的

examples.en: The new software made the archive far more tractable for researchers.
examples.zh: 新软件让研究人员处理档案顺手多了。

meaning: n. 中生代;a. 中生代的

examples.en: Dinosaurs dominated terrestrial life throughout the Mesozoic era.
examples.zh: 整个中生代,恐龙统治着陆地生命。

meaning: a. 不腐败的, 不能收买的, 清廉的

examples.en: An incorruptible auditor was brought in to examine the books.
examples.zh: 一位不受收买的审计员被请来查账。

meaning: a. 有相互关系的

examples.en: Test anxiety is strongly correlated with lower exam performance.
examples.zh: 考试焦虑与较低的考试成绩高度相关。

meaning: n. 可展性, 可锻性, 顺从;展性

examples.en: Gold's malleability lets artisans hammer it into whisper-thin foil.
examples.zh: 黄金的可塑性使工匠能锤出极薄金箔。

meaning: vt. 打乱, 挫败, 使破灭

examples.en: The unexpected question seemed to discomfit the confident witness.
examples.zh: 意外的提问让自信的证人乱了方寸。

meaning: a. 宽敞的, 方便的

examples.en: The commodious cabin sleeps eight skiers in surprising comfort.
examples.zh: 宽敞的小屋能让八名滑雪者睡得意外舒适。

meaning: a. 使恶化的, 加重的, 恼人的

examples.en: The aggravating clatter from the site drove residents to protest.
examples.zh: 工地恼人的哐当声逼得居民抗议。

meaning: vt. 使都市化, 使成都市式, 使文雅

examples.en: The province plans to urbanize the coastal belt within two decades.
examples.zh: 该省计划二十年内使沿海地带城市化。

meaning: a. 隔音的

examples.en: The studio spent a fortune to soundproof every rehearsal room.
examples.zh: 录音棚花重金给每间排练室做隔音。

meaning: n. 游移不定, 踌躇, 不果断

examples.en: The committee's vacillation over the venue delayed the entire conference.
examples.zh: 委员会在选址上摇摆不定,耽误了整场会议。

meaning: a. 不能架桥的, 不能逾越的

examples.en: Years of distrust left an unbridgeable gap between the departments.
examples.zh: 多年不信任在部门间留下无法弥合的鸿沟。

meaning: vt. 使昏沉, 使迷惑, 使糊涂

examples.en: The contradictory timetables befuddle even the most experienced commuters.
examples.zh: 相互矛盾的时刻表连老通勤者都犯晕。

meaning: n. 美食家

examples.en: A confirmed gourmand, he travels widely in search of regional dishes.
examples.zh: 他是十足的美食家,为寻地方美食四处旅行。

meaning: a. 贪婪的

examples.en: The avaricious landlord squeezed every last coin from struggling tenants.
examples.zh: 贪婪的房东把拮据房客的最后几枚硬币都榨走。

meaning: n. 内毒素;内毒素

examples.en: The released endotoxin can trigger dangerous fevers in patients.
examples.zh: 释放出的内毒素可在病人体内引发高烧。

meaning: vt. 使成化石, 使陈腐;vi. 变成化石, 变陈腐

examples.en: Bones fossilize only when buried quickly in mineral-rich sediment.
examples.zh: 骨骼只有迅速埋入富矿沉积物才会化石化。

meaning: a. 灵巧的, 惯用右手的

examples.en: The dexterous surgeon completed the delicate repair in two hours.
examples.zh: 手法灵巧的外科医生两小时完成精细修复。

meaning: a. 无敌的, 无比的

examples.en: Her matchless timing made even familiar jokes feel fresh.
examples.zh: 她无与伦比的节奏感让老段子也显新意。

meaning: n. 洗澡, 洗礼, 斋戒沐浴;洗净; 洗净液

examples.en: Pilgrims perform a ritual ablution before entering the ancient temple.
examples.zh: 朝圣者进古庙前行净身仪式。

meaning: a. 不是必要的, 可有可无的

examples.en: The review concluded that the middle management layer was dispensable.
examples.zh: 评估结论是中层管理可有可无。

meaning: a. 地磁的

examples.en: Migrating birds navigate partly by reading geomagnetic fields.
examples.zh: 候鸟部分依靠地磁场辨别方向。

meaning: n. 电离层;电离层

examples.en: Radio signals bounce off the ionosphere to reach distant receivers.
examples.zh: 无线电波经电离层反射到达远方接收器。

meaning: vt. 消除, 使清凉, 熄灭;消, 灭; 消和(石灰); 松, 缓和

examples.en: Iced lemonade helps slake the thirst of harvest crews.
examples.zh: 冰柠檬水帮收获农工解渴消暑。

meaning: vi. 说模棱两可的话, 支吾

examples.en: When pressed for details, the spokesperson began to equivocate.
examples.zh: 被追问细节时,发言人开始闪烁其词。

meaning: vt. 使带磁力, 吸引;vi. 受磁

examples.en: A strong current magnetizes the iron core inside the coil.
examples.zh: 强电流使线圈内的铁芯磁化。

meaning: vt.vi. 横切, 横穿;a. 横切的, 横穿的

examples.en: The hiking trail crosscuts the meadow to reach the ridge.
examples.zh: 步道横穿草地直上山脊。

meaning: n. 有神论者, 一神论者

examples.en: A theist and an atheist found common ground in ethics class.
examples.zh: 有神论者与无神论者在伦理课上找到共识。

meaning: a. 多细胞的;多细胞的; 多空隙的

examples.en: Multicellular life appears in the fossil record over six hundred million years ago.
examples.zh: 化石记录显示,多细胞生命出现于六亿多年前。

meaning: n. 鸟翼, 翅膀, 翅前翼, 羽毛, 小齿轮;vt. 剪断翼尖, 绑住...两臂

examples.en: The falconer will pinion the hawk's wing before training begins.
examples.zh: 训练开始前,驯鹰人会缚住鹰的一侧翅膀。

meaning: n. 乡下习气, 方言, 地方风俗

examples.en: Travel, the editor argued, is the surest cure for provincialism.
examples.zh: 编辑说,旅行是狭隘地方观念最灵的药。

meaning: n. 团的编制, 系统化, 严格控制;组成, 编组, 统制

examples.en: Workers resented the strict regimentation of the assembly line.
examples.zh: 工人憎恶流水线的严格管束。

meaning: n. 亮晶晶的小物件;v. (使)闪烁

examples.en: Hundreds of sequins spangle the figure skater's new costume.
examples.zh: 数百枚亮片缀满滑冰选手的新装。

meaning: n. 圣乐, 清唱剧, 神剧

examples.en: The choir spent the whole winter rehearsing a demanding oratorio.
examples.zh: 合唱团整个冬天排练一部高难度清唱剧。

meaning: a. 不屈不挠的, 大胆的

examples.en: The dauntless reporter kept investigating despite repeated threats.
examples.zh: 屡遭威胁,无畏的记者仍坚持调查。

meaning: n. 地震仪;地震计

examples.en: The seismograph recorded a faint tremor hours before the eruption.
examples.zh: 地震仪在喷发前数小时录得轻震。

meaning: a. 麻痹的, 迟缓的, 迟钝的, 蛰伏的;迟钝的, 不活泼的, 缓慢的

examples.en: The torpid snake barely stirred when the keepers entered.
examples.zh: 饲养员进来时,迟钝的蛇几乎没动。

meaning: n. 口语, 口语用法, 口语词, 方言, 口语体

examples.en: The novel's rural colloquialism gives the dialogue its charm.
examples.zh: 小说里的乡土口语赋予对白韵味。

meaning: n. 认识, 察知, 审理

examples.en: The court took cognizance of the new DNA evidence.
examples.zh: 法院注意到新的DNA证据。

meaning: n. 快活, 活泼, 精神充沛

examples.en: The young host's vivacity energized the entire late-night show.
examples.zh: 年轻主持人的朝气让整档深夜节目生龙活虎。

meaning: n. 圆锥形纸袋, 短号;小助听筒

examples.en: He learned to play the cornet in the village brass band.
examples.zh: 他在乡村铜管乐队学会了吹短号。

meaning: n. 谚语, 俗话, 笑柄

examples.en: The city's transit system became a byword for chronic delays.
examples.zh: 该市公交成了长期晚点的代名词。

meaning: vt. 声明不赞成, 抗议, 反对;对...表示不赞成, 反对

examples.en: Engineers deprecate the old protocol in favor of secure alternatives.
examples.zh: 工程师们主张弃用旧协议,改用安全方案。

meaning: n. 贫困, 贫穷, 拮据, 馈乏;赤贫, 缺乏

examples.en: The charity rescued talented students from penury and neglect.
examples.zh: 慈善机构把有天赋的学生从赤贫与忽视中解救出来。

meaning: a. 舞蹈艺术的, 舞台舞蹈的

examples.en: The ballet's choreographic sequences blur the line between dance and mime.
examples.zh: 芭蕾的舞蹈编排模糊了舞蹈与哑剧的界限。

meaning: n. 默许, 纵容;纵容, 默许

examples.en: The smuggling ring operated with the connivance of border guards.
examples.zh: 走私团伙在边防的默许下活动。

meaning: v. 嘲笑;n. 嘲笑

examples.en: Rival fans would gibe at the goalkeeper after every fumbled save.
examples.zh: 每次扑救脱手,对家球迷都要讥笑守门员。

meaning: vt. 否定, 反驳;n. 否认, 反驳, 反对

examples.en: Nobody could gainsay the referee's decision after the video review.
examples.zh: 视频回放后,谁也无法否认裁判的判罚。

meaning: vt. 熏制;熏烟

examples.en: The school closed for a day to fumigate the kitchens.
examples.zh: 学校停课一天,给厨房熏蒸消毒。

meaning: n. 所有权;所有权, 业主权, 资本

examples.en: He converted the partnership into a sole proprietorship last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天,他把合伙企业改为独资经营。

meaning: n. 绦虫;绦虫

examples.en: The vet found a tapeworm segment in the puppy's stool.
examples.zh: 兽医在小狗粪便中发现绦虫节片。

meaning: v. 转播, 重播;n. 转播, 重播

examples.en: The station will rebroadcast the documentary with subtitles on Friday.
examples.zh: 电视台周五将带字幕重播这部纪录片。

meaning: vt. 使衰弱;a. 衰弱的, 无力的

examples.en: The relentless humidity can enervate even the fittest athletes.
examples.zh: 持续的闷热连最健壮的运动员也能拖垮。

meaning: a. 贪婪的, 妄想的

examples.en: Covetous eyes followed the crown jewels behind the glass case.
examples.zh: 贪婪的目光紧盯着玻璃柜后的王冠珠宝。

meaning: vt. 预示

examples.en: Dark towering clouds betoken a violent afternoon storm.
examples.zh: 高耸的乌云预示午后将有猛烈的暴风雨。

meaning: vt. 使孤寂, 使丧失, 使失去

examples.en: The epidemic bereaved thousands of families of their sole earners.
examples.zh: 瘟疫夺走了数千家庭唯一的收入来源。

meaning: n. （美）牧牛工

examples.en: A lone cowhand herded the strays back across the river.
examples.zh: 一名牧牛工独自把走散的牛赶回河对岸。

meaning: a. 热的, 热心的

examples.en: The debate ended in fervid argument over the smallest clause.
examples.zh: 辩论最终因最细小的条款激烈争吵收场。

meaning: vt. 使爆发, 以严词谴责;vi. 爆炸, 怒喝, 电闪

examples.en: Opposition editorials fulminate against the new surveillance powers.
examples.zh: 反对派的社论怒斥新的监控权力。

meaning: n. 海山

examples.en: Divers filmed rare octopuses nesting on the volcanic seamount.
examples.zh: 潜水员在火山海山上拍到罕见章鱼筑巢。

meaning: n. 震压造型；震动

examples.en: The train's constant jolting made it impossible to read.
examples.zh: 列车不停颠簸,让人无法看书。

meaning: v. 使负担过重, 使过度疲劳( overtax的过去式和过去分词 ); 对…征税过重

examples.en: Overtaxed nurses are leaving the profession in alarming numbers.
examples.zh: 不堪重负的护士正以惊人数量离职。

meaning: a. 幻影的, 错觉的, 迷惑人的

examples.en: The mirage was an illusive promise of water beyond the dunes.
examples.zh: 海市蜃楼是沙丘之外虚幻的水源。

meaning: n. 野心, 追求名利

examples.en: Critics saw his volunteer work as mere careerism in disguise.
examples.zh: 批评者认为他的志愿工作只是变相的钻营。

meaning: a. 推测的, 好推测的

examples.en: The reconstruction of the lost palace remains partly conjectural.
examples.zh: 对失落宫殿的复原在一定程度上仍属推测。

meaning: a. 无准备的, 即席的, 临时的;临时的, 当时的

examples.en: Her extemporaneous remarks at the town hall were more moving than the script.
examples.zh: 她在市政会的即席发言比讲稿更动人。

meaning: a. 冒险的, 好冒险的, 不顾一切的

examples.en: The venturesome couple cycled from the mountains all the way to the sea.
examples.zh: 这对爱冒险的夫妇从山区一路骑行到海边。

meaning: a. 无信仰的, 不敬神的, 不虔诚的, 不孝的

examples.en: The playwright was accused of impious satire against the clergy.
examples.zh: 剧作家被指用不敬的讽刺抨击神职人员。

meaning: a. 千倍的;adv. 千倍地, 成千倍

examples.en: The investment in early education repaid the city a thousandfold.
examples.zh: 对早期教育的投入让城市获得千倍回报。

meaning: a. 瘦的, 细长的, 长而柔软的

examples.en: His lank hair fell across his eyes as he studied the board.
examples.zh: 他盯着棋盘,细长的头发垂到眼前。

meaning: a. 怠惰的, 懒惰的

examples.en: The slothful manager let safety inspections slip for months.
examples.zh: 懒怠的经理把安全检查拖了好几个月。

meaning: n. 厚颜无耻

examples.en: He had the effrontery to demand an apology from his victims.
examples.zh: 他竟厚颜无耻地要求受害者道歉。

meaning: n. 主发条, 主要动机, 主要原因, 主要动力;主要动机, 主要原因, 主要动力

examples.en: Ambition was the mainspring of the founder's relentless schedule.
examples.zh: 雄心是创始人连轴转的主要动力。

meaning: n. 不切实际, 办不到

examples.en: A quick cost study exposed the impracticality of the plan.
examples.zh: 一次快速成本核算暴露了计划的不切实际。

meaning: a. 减去的, 有负号的, 负的

examples.en: Marble sculpture is a subtractive process, removing stone chip by chip.
examples.zh: 大理石雕刻是减法,一凿一凿地去除石料。

meaning: n. 跳跃, 雀跃, 嬉戏;vi. 跳跃, 雀跃, 耍闹

examples.en: Newborn lambs gambol across the meadow in the spring sunshine.
examples.zh: 春日阳光下,初生的羊羔在草地上欢蹦。

meaning: n. 装载量, 列车载重

examples.en: A trainload of timber arrives at the mill every morning.
examples.zh: 每天清晨都有一整车木材运抵锯木厂。

meaning: vt. 使稀少, 使稀薄, 使纯化, 精炼;vi. 变稀少, 变稀薄

examples.en: The lab uses special pumps to rarefy the air inside the chamber.
examples.zh: 实验室用特种泵让腔内空气变得稀薄。

meaning: n. 驾驶/操纵气球的人

examples.en: The balloonist tracked wind layers to steer toward the valley.
examples.zh: 气球驾驶员追踪各层风向,朝山谷飘去。

meaning: vt. 用棒打, 殴打, 硬灌(观念等);vi. 敲击

examples.en: The home side proceeded to drub the weary champions.
examples.zh: 主队随即把疲惫的卫冕冠军打得落花流水。

meaning: vt. 使倾覆, (重量、价值)超过, 使失去均衡, 跌倒;vi. 失去平衡

examples.en: The extra cargo nearly overbalanced the small ferry.
examples.zh: 额外的货物险些让小渡轮倾覆。

meaning: a. 未施肥的

examples.en: Unfertilized eggs will never develop into chicks, whatever the incubator does.
examples.zh: 未受精的蛋无论怎么孵都孵不出小鸡。

meaning: vt. 沐浴, 洗;n. 剩余物

examples.en: Each dawn the tide gently laves the coral flats.
examples.zh: 每天清晨,潮水轻轻冲刷珊瑚滩。

meaning: n. 船货, 大量;船货, 船双运载量, 大量

examples.en: The harbor handled its largest shipload of grain in decades.
examples.zh: 港口迎来了数十年来最大的一船谷物。

meaning: a. 易延展的, 韧性的, 易教导的;延伸性的

examples.en: Copper is prized for wiring because it is ductile and conductive.
examples.zh: 铜因延展性好又导电而广泛用于导线。

meaning: vt. 逼使, 强迫, 伸出;vi. 打扰, 强行闯入

examples.en: Reporters were warned not to obtrude on the family's grief.
examples.zh: 记者被警告不得打扰这家的丧亲之痛。

meaning: vi. 流于感伤;vt. 使感伤

examples.en: The film avoids any temptation to sentimentalize the miners' lives.
examples.zh: 这部电影避免把矿工的生活拍得过分感伤。

meaning: n. 严格执行纪律的人

examples.en: The new coach is a martinet who schedules every minute of camp.
examples.zh: 新教练治军极严,训练营每分钟都排定。

meaning: vt. 为供神而宰杀, 牺牲, 杀死

examples.en: Ancient texts describe how devotees would immolate offerings on the altar.
examples.zh: 古代文献记载信徒在祭坛上焚烧祭品。

meaning: n. 符号学, 符号使用

examples.en: The film's dense symbology rewards viewers who watch it twice.
examples.zh: 影片密集的符号体系值得观众二刷。

meaning: vi. 随潮流, 拖延, 妥协, 调停

examples.en: Faced with protests, the council chose to temporize for another month.
examples.zh: 面对抗议,议会决定再拖延一个月。

meaning: a. 多角形的, 多边形的;多边形的, 多角形的

examples.en: The polygonal stones of the fortress fit together without mortar.
examples.zh: 要塞的多边形石块不用灰浆便严丝合缝。

meaning: vt. 使堕落;vi. 放荡

examples.en: Unlimited wealth and leisure can debauch an undisciplined heir.
examples.zh: 无限的财富与安逸会蚀空缺乏自律的继承人。

meaning: n. 犀鸟

examples.en: A hornbill surveyed the canopy from the tallest emergent tree.
examples.zh: 一只犀鸟从最高的露生树上俯瞰林冠。

meaning: n. 一半, 一部分, 应得之份;等分, 一半, 一部分

examples.en: Each moiety of the tribe takes turns hosting the harvest feast.
examples.zh: 部落的每个半族轮流主办丰收盛宴。

meaning: vt. 废黜, 废位赶出

examples.en: The injury threatens to dethrone the defending champion before the final.
examples.zh: 这场伤病恐让卫冕冠军在决赛前让出王座。

meaning: a. 犬牙交错的；受契约约束的；缩进排印的

examples.en: The coastline's deeply indented bays shelter entire fishing fleets.
examples.zh: 海岸线深深凹进的海湾庇护着整支渔船队。

meaning: a. 不顺从的, 地位不低的

examples.en: The insubordinate sergeant was demoted after ignoring direct orders.
examples.zh: 抗命的军士因无视直接命令被降职。

meaning: n. 感伤主义

examples.en: Critics panned the sequel for its cheap sentimentalism.
examples.zh: 评论家批评续集充斥廉价的感伤情调。

meaning: a. 无决断的, 优柔寡断的, 踌躇不定的

examples.en: An irresolute board watched the startup drift for a full year.
examples.zh: 优柔寡断的董事会眼睁睁看初创公司漂了一年。

meaning: a. 平凡的, 陈腐的, 老生常谈的

examples.en: The speech was dismissed as platitudinous even by loyal supporters.
examples.zh: 连忠实支持者也嫌这篇演讲陈词滥调。

meaning: a. 未失真的, 不偏激的

examples.en: The antenna delivers an undistorted signal even during storms.
examples.zh: 即使暴风雨中,天线输出的信号也不失真。

meaning: a. 保持的, 有保持力的, 记性好的

examples.en: She has a retentive memory for names and small favors.
examples.zh: 她对人名和点滴恩惠都记得牢。

meaning: a. 有灰雾的；不清晰的

examples.en: The old greenhouse panes stay fogged no matter how often we wipe them.
examples.zh: 无论擦多少次,旧温室玻璃总蒙着雾。

meaning: vt.使过度疲劳

examples.en: Coaches know better than to overtire their star players.
examples.zh: 教练深谙不能让主力球员过度疲劳。

meaning: vt. 使昏乱, 使腐坏;vi. 变质

examples.en: Long meetings seem to addle his usually sharp mind.
examples.zh: 冗长的会议似乎把他敏捷的头脑搅乱。

meaning: vi. 悸动, 心跳, 发抖;心悸

examples.en: Her heart palpitated wildly as the results were read aloud.
examples.zh: 宣读结果时,她的心怦怦狂跳。

meaning: a. 讲究仪式的, 隆重的

examples.en: The ceremonious greeting involved bows, tea, and formal introductions.
examples.zh: 隆重的见面礼包括鞠躬、奉茶和正式引见。

meaning: vt. 强求, 硬要;vi. 强求, 纠缠

examples.en: Street vendors importune tourists outside the cathedral gates.
examples.zh: 大教堂门外,小贩们缠着游客兜售。

meaning: a. 沉迷于酒色的, 闲游浪荡的, 消失的

examples.en: The heir's dissipated lifestyle alarmed the trustees of the estate.
examples.zh: 继承人放荡的生活方式令遗产受托人担忧。

meaning: v. 侵入, 侵扰, 打扰( intrude的现在分词); 把…强加于

examples.en: Paparazzi kept intruding on the couple's honeymoon despite repeated warnings.
examples.zh: 屡次警告之后,狗仔队仍不断侵扰这对夫妇的蜜月。

meaning: a. 细心的, 吝啬的, 谨慎的

examples.en: Be chary of investment schemes promising quick and effortless profits.
examples.zh: 对承诺轻松速富的投资计划要格外谨慎。

meaning: n. 高地

examples.en: The herders graze their yaks on the windswept tableland.
examples.zh: 牧民在风大的高地上放牧牦牛。

meaning: n. 粉碎, 以原子弹轰炸, 雾化;原子化; 雾化

examples.en: Fuel atomization inside the cylinder improves combustion efficiency.
examples.zh: 气缸内的燃油雾化提高燃烧效率。

meaning: a. 丰厚的, 慷慨的

examples.en: The munificent donor funded an entire wing of the hospital.
examples.zh: 慷慨的捐助人出资建起医院的整座侧楼。

meaning: n. 蒸发, 汽化;汽化

examples.en: The vaporization of liquid nitrogen produces a dramatic cloud of white fog.
examples.zh: 液氮汽化时会产生一大团白色雾气。

meaning: a. 感光性的, 对光敏感的;对光敏感的, 感光的

examples.en: The workers wore goggles because the film stays photosensitive under bright lab lights.
examples.zh: 工人们戴上了护目镜,因为胶片在明亮灯光下仍然感光。

meaning: n. 改良主义

examples.en: The party split between radicals who wanted revolution and gradualists who defended reformism.
examples.zh: 该党在主张革命的激进派与拥护改良的渐进派之间分裂。

meaning: n. 心灵学, 通灵学;心灵学, 心灵心理学(一门唯心的学科)

examples.en: She spent years testing parapsychology claims under strict laboratory conditions.
examples.zh: 她多年在严格的实验室条件下检验超心理学的说法。

meaning: n. 适合, 一致, 共同点

examples.en: There is a clear congruity between the survey results and last year's sales data.
examples.zh: 调查结果与去年的销售数据之间存在明显的一致性。

meaning: a. 优秀的, 超群的, 卓越的

examples.en: She became the preeminent scholar of medieval history after three acclaimed books.
examples.zh: 连出三本备受赞誉的著作后,她成为中世纪史领域的顶尖学者。

meaning: n. 泉水

examples.en: The village pipes clean springwater from the mountain to every kitchen.
examples.zh: 村子把干净的山泉水从山上输送到每家厨房。

meaning: n. 造船木匠

examples.en: The old shipwright still shapes every plank with tools his grandfather owned.
examples.zh: 老造船匠仍用祖父传下的工具打磨每一块船板。

meaning: 无礼

examples.en: His immodesty was obvious when he read his own praises aloud at dinner.
examples.zh: 他在晚宴上朗读别人对自己的赞美,狂态尽显。

meaning: vt. (非正式)使惊呆, 使吓得要死, 使发呆;vt.vi. 使石化, 使成为化石, 使变僵, 变僵硬, 使消失活力, 使僵化

examples.en: Even seasoned climbers say the narrow ridge can petrify anyone who looks down.
examples.zh: 就连老练的登山者都说,这条窄脊会吓呆任何低头下看的人。

meaning: vt. 烤, 烘, 使干透;vi. 烤干, 焦干

examples.en: Weeks without rain will parch the fields and threaten the whole wheat harvest.
examples.zh: 连续数周无雨会使田地干透,危及整季小麦收成。

meaning: vt. 先于, 前于;提前日期(比实际毋早的日期)

examples.en: These hand-drawn maps antedate the printing press by nearly two centuries.
examples.zh: 这些手绘地图比印刷机的出现早了近两个世纪。

meaning: a. 吹毛求疵的, 挑毛病的

examples.en: Constant carping about tiny formatting errors discouraged the whole volunteer team.
examples.zh: 对细小格式错误没完没了的挑剔让整个志愿团队泄气。

meaning: n. 太阳的色球层;色球

examples.en: During the total eclipse, the sun's chromosphere glowed briefly as a red ring.
examples.zh: 日全食期间,太阳的色球层短暂地呈现出红色光环。

meaning: n. 倾斜, 下坡

examples.en: The hikers rested on a gentle declivity covered with soft moss and ferns.
examples.zh: 徒步者在一处覆盖着柔软苔藓和蕨类的缓坡上休息。

meaning: a. 不可非难的, 无缺点的, 无过失的

examples.en: Her conduct as treasurer was irreproachable; every audit passed and every receipt was filed.
examples.zh: 她担任司账期间无可挑剔,每次审计都通过,每张收据都存档。

meaning: n. 鱼龙

examples.en: The museum's newest exhibit is an ichthyosaur skeleton found in a Dorset cliff.
examples.zh: 博物馆最新的展品是在多塞特郡悬崖中发现的鱼龙骨架。

meaning: a. 不锈的;不锈, 防锈的

examples.en: The factory coats each bolt with zinc to keep the fittings rustproof for decades.
examples.zh: 工厂给每颗螺栓镀锌,使配件几十年不生锈。

meaning: a. 忧伤的, 悲痛的

examples.en: He gave a dolorous sigh whenever anyone mentioned the cancelled project.
examples.zh: 每当有人提起那个被取消的项目,他都悲伤地叹气。

meaning: n. 镀金, 镀金材料, 涂金, 虚饰的外观, 假象;镀金, 装金

examples.en: The delicate gilding on the dome took craftsmen almost three years to finish.
examples.zh: 圆顶上精细的镀金工艺花了工匠近三年才完成。

meaning: n. 超大陆

examples.en: Geologists believe a new supercontinent could form roughly two hundred million years from now.
examples.zh: 地质学家认为,大约两亿年后可能会形成新的超级大陆。

meaning: v. 掩饰, 假装, 装糊涂

examples.en: She could not dissimulate her surprise when the exam results were read out.
examples.zh: 宣读考试成绩时,她无法掩饰自己的惊讶。

meaning: a. 铁磁体;磁性铁的

examples.en: Iron and nickel are ferromagnetic materials that respond strongly to outside magnetic fields.
examples.zh: 铁和镍是铁磁性材料,对外部磁场反应强烈。

meaning: n. 工匠；手艺人；工艺师

examples.en: The fair brought together forty craftspeople selling pottery, leather goods, and handwoven textiles.
examples.zh: 集市汇聚了四十位手艺人,售卖陶器、皮具和手织布。

meaning: adv. 卓越地, 超群地

examples.en: The young cellist played with surpassingly delicate phrasing that silenced the whole hall.
examples.zh: 年轻大提琴手的乐句处理格外细腻,全场为之屏息。

meaning: v. 咀嚼

examples.en: Dietitians remind children to masticate each mouthful thoroughly before swallowing.
examples.zh: 营养师提醒孩子们每一口食物都要充分咀嚼后再吞咽。

meaning: a. 偶然的, 外来的;偶生的, 偶发的; 异位的

examples.en: The cuttings developed adventitious roots within weeks of being placed in water.
examples.zh: 插枝放入水中几周内就长出了不定根。

meaning: a. 瘟疫的, 有害的, 传播疾病的, 讨厌的, 恼人的;疫病的

examples.en: The troops avoided the pestilential swamps where fever spread every summer.
examples.zh: 部队避开了那片瘟疫滋生的沼泽,那里每年夏天都流行热病。

meaning: vt. 召集...开会

examples.en: The dean will convoke an emergency meeting to discuss the budget cuts.
examples.zh: 院长将召开紧急会议,讨论预算削减问题。

meaning: vt. 议论, 辩驳, 驳击;vi. 参加辩论

examples.en: No scholar has managed to controvert the evidence in those geological records.
examples.zh: 还没有学者能驳倒那些地质记录中的证据。

meaning: a. 无利的, 无益的

examples.en: After two profitless years, the riverside cafe finally closed its doors.
examples.zh: 连续两年无利可图后,这家河边咖啡馆终于关门了。

meaning: vt. 填迟...的日期;n. 事后日期

examples.en: These letters postdate the treaty, so they cannot describe the original negotiations.
examples.zh: 这些信件写于条约之后,不可能描述当时的谈判。

meaning: n. 掺杂, 掺假的东西;掺杂; 掺加

examples.en: Inspectors fined the firm for the adulteration of olive oil with cheaper seed oils.
examples.zh: 检查员因该公司往橄榄油里掺廉价种子油而开出罚单。

meaning: n. 除臭剂, 防臭剂;除臭剂

examples.en: A simple deodorizer made from baking soda keeps the refrigerator smelling fresh.
examples.zh: 用小苏打做的简易除味剂能让冰箱保持气味清新。

meaning: n. 地震学

examples.en: Advances in seismology help scientists map fault lines beneath crowded cities.
examples.zh: 地震学的进步帮助科学家绘制拥挤城市下方的断层。

meaning: n. 生机论, 活力论;生机论, 生活力说

examples.en: Vitalism lost support once chemists synthesized organic compounds in ordinary laboratories.
examples.zh: 自从化学家在普通实验室里合成有机物,活力论便失去了支持。

meaning: n. 辱骂, 毁谤, 耻辱

examples.en: The mayor endured years of public obloquy after the stadium project failed.
examples.zh: 体育场项目失败后,市长忍受了多年的公开毁谤。

meaning: a. 好搞派系的, 好结党营私的

examples.en: The factious committee split into rival groups and blocked every proposal.
examples.zh: 派系纷争的委员会分裂成对立阵营,否决了一切提案。

meaning: a. 无远见的, 浪费的

examples.en: Improvident spending during the boom years left the city deep in debt.
examples.zh: 繁荣年份的挥霍让这座城市深陷债务。

meaning: n. 领带夹

examples.en: He fastened his silk cravat with a small pearl stickpin.
examples.zh: 他用一枚珍珠领带针别住真丝领结。

meaning: a. 人为的, 人工的, 不自然的;人工的, 人造的, 假的

examples.en: The sudden demand looked factitious, stirred up by dealers hoarding the stamps.
examples.zh: 这股突发的需求看似人为炒作,是商家囤积邮票所致。

meaning: n. 小型拨弦古钢琴, 小型立式钢琴

examples.en: She restored a 1780 spinet and now gives monthly concerts in her parlor.
examples.zh: 她修复了一架1780年的小键琴,如今每月在客厅开音乐会。

meaning: n. 咒, 坏话

examples.en: The old letter contained a malediction against anyone who opened the chest.
examples.zh: 那封旧信里有一道诅咒,针对任何打开箱子的人。

meaning: vt. 扰乱, 搅乱, 弄乱

examples.en: A gust of wind swept through the study and disarranged the papers.
examples.zh: 一阵风穿过书房,弄乱了他桌上的文件。

meaning: a. 音响好的, 悦耳的, 声音和谐的

examples.en: The poet chose euphonious place names for the valleys in her fantasy novel.
examples.zh: 这位诗人为奇幻小说中的山谷取了音韵优美的名字。

meaning: a. 不觉痛苦的, 不受伤害的, 无感觉的, 无感情的

examples.en: The judge remained impassible while the lawyer shouted across the courtroom.
examples.zh: 律师在法庭上大喊大叫,法官始终面无表情。

meaning: vt. 诽谤, 中伤, 背叛;诽谤, 中伤, 诋毁

examples.en: His rivals tried to traduce his reputation with rumors and half-truths.
examples.zh: 对手们企图用谣言和半真半假的话诋毁他的名誉。

meaning: n. 轻快, 活泼

examples.en: She answered each question with briskness, keeping the meeting under thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 她答问干脆利落,把会议控制在三十分钟以内。

meaning: n. 悦耳之音

examples.en: Translators often sacrifice literal accuracy for the euphony of the target language.
examples.zh: 译者常常为了目标语言的音韵美感而舍弃字面对应。

meaning: vt. 修订, 校勘

examples.en: The editor proposed to emend two lines corrupted by centuries of hand copying.
examples.zh: 编校者建议校改这两行因历代手抄而讹误的文字。

meaning: n. 满足, 自鸣得意, 自满

examples.en: Complacence after the early wins left the startup vulnerable to faster rivals.
examples.zh: 早期连胜的自满让这家初创公司难敌更快的对手。

meaning: 胚胎学的

examples.en: The lab's embryological studies track how the spinal cord forms in chick embryos.
examples.zh: 该实验室的胚胎学研究追踪脊髓在鸡胚中的形成过程。

meaning: 重热

examples.en: Repeated reheating destroys many vitamins, so cook only what you can eat fresh.
examples.zh: 反复加热会破坏许多维生素,所以只做能新鲜吃完的量。

meaning: a. 四边形的;四边形的, 四边形

examples.en: The surveyor marked each quadrilateral of land with numbered stakes and tape.
examples.zh: 测量员用编号木桩和胶带标出每块四边形地块。

meaning: n. 晕机

examples.en: Turbulence over the mountains brought on a wave of airsickness among the passengers.
examples.zh: 山区上空的湍流让乘客们纷纷晕机。

meaning: a. 多毛的, 有粗毛的;多毛的

examples.en: The hirsute actor grew a thicker beard for his role as a wild explorer.
examples.zh: 那位多须的演员为演粗野的探险家蓄起了更浓的胡子。

meaning: n. 镀锡铁皮, 马口铁;镀锡薄钢板

examples.en: The factory stamps tinplate into cans for the seasonal salmon harvest.
examples.zh: 工厂把马口铁冲压成罐,用于当季三文鱼加工。

meaning: vi. 唠叨, 空谈;vt. 瞎扯

examples.en: He would prate about investments for hours without asking a single question.
examples.zh: 他能喋喋不休地大谈投资几个小时,从不问一个问题。

meaning: a. 知晓的；有知识的；熟识的

examples.en: Orientation week helps new students get acquainted with campus services.
examples.zh: 迎新周帮助新生熟悉校园的各项服务。

meaning: a. 美学的, 艺术的, 美的, 审美的

examples.en: Critics praised the tower's aesthetical proportions despite its controversial cost.
examples.zh: 尽管造价有争议,评论家仍称赞这座塔的美学比例。

meaning: vt. 使古旧, 废弃

examples.en: Rapid advances in battery design antiquate last year's charging equipment within a few seasons.
examples.zh: 电池设计的飞速进步让去年的充电设备几个季度便告过时。

meaning: v. 断言, 主张, 保证, 承认

examples.en: I can avouch for his honesty, having worked beside him for a decade.
examples.zh: 我可以为他的人品作保,我与他共事已有十年。

meaning: n. 管乐队指挥

examples.en: The bandmaster raised his baton, and the parade marched into the square.
examples.zh: 乐队指挥举起指挥棒,游行队伍步入广场。

meaning: n. 勃鲁斯乐曲, (非正式)伤感的, 伤心的;忧闷, 沮丧

examples.en: She sings the blues at a small club every Friday night.
examples.zh: 她每周五晚上在一家小俱乐部唱蓝调。

meaning: a. 弯腿的

examples.en: Years in the saddle left the old cowboy distinctly bowlegged but still agile.
examples.zh: 常年骑马使老牛仔明显罗圈腿,但他依然矫健。

meaning: 宽边的

examples.en: The archaeologist wore a broad-brimmed hat against the fierce desert sun.
examples.zh: 考古学家戴着宽檐帽抵御沙漠烈日。

meaning: pl. 仙人掌

examples.en: Desert cacti store water in thick stems to survive long dry seasons.
examples.zh: 沙漠仙人掌在粗茎中储水,以度过漫长的旱季。

meaning: a. 吹毛求疵的, 挑剔的

examples.en: His captious review mocked the font choice but never discussed the novel's ideas.
examples.zh: 他那篇吹毛求疵的书评嘲笑字体选择,却不谈小说的思想。

meaning: a. 铸铁的, 铸铁制成的, 坚固的, 不妥协的;铸铁

examples.en: The cornbread recipe works best in a heavy cast-iron pan heated slowly.
examples.zh: 这款玉米面包食谱最适合用慢慢加热的厚铸铁锅做。

meaning: vt. 侮辱, 蔑视

examples.en: Puritan preachers contemned the theater as a school of vanity.
examples.zh: 清教徒传道人谴责戏剧,说它是教人虚荣之所。

meaning: n. 交叉的股骨图形

examples.en: A skull and crossbones on the label warned that the bottle held poison.
examples.zh: 标签上的骷髅图案警告瓶中盛有毒物。

meaning: n. 杂交育种;v. 杂交(crossbred的过去分词)

examples.en: Careful crossbreeding produced a wheat variety that resists drought and ripens early.
examples.zh: 精心的杂交培育出抗旱又早熟的小麦品种。

meaning: vt. 消磁, 使退磁;去磁, 退磁

examples.en: A strong alternating current can demagnetize a steel tool that has become magnetized.
examples.zh: 强交流电流可以给已磁化的钢制工具退磁。

meaning: n. 转移, 缩小, 减损, 贬低, 毁损

examples.en: Detraction from envious colleagues never dimmed her reputation among students.
examples.zh: 嫉妒同事的贬损从未损害她在学生中的声誉。

meaning: vt. 使不安, 使烦乱, 使烦恼

examples.en: The unexpected question seemed to discompose the normally confident witness.
examples.zh: 这个意外的问题似乎打乱了一向自信的证人的阵脚。

meaning: a. 膨胀的, 扩张的

examples.en: The distent belly of the starving child shocked the aid workers.
examples.zh: 孩子因饥饿而肿胀的肚子令援助人员震惊。

meaning: vt. 使分离, 使不和

examples.en: Years of propaganda aimed to disunite the ethnic communities of the port city.
examples.zh: 多年的宣传蛊惑企图离间这座港口城市的各族群。

meaning: n. 滴水石

examples.en: Centuries of dripping water formed a dripstone curtain across the cave mouth.
examples.zh: 数百年的滴水在洞口形成一道滴水石帘。

meaning: a. 无齿的, 贫齿目的;n. 贫齿目动物

examples.en: The edentate anteater crushes insects with a sticky tongue instead of teeth.
examples.zh: 这种无齿的食蚁兽用黏舌头而不是牙齿捕食昆虫。

meaning: a. 可教育的

examples.en: The court ruled that every educable child deserves a place in a mainstream classroom.
examples.zh: 法院裁定每个可受教育的孩子都应在主流课堂有一席之地。

meaning: vt. 引出, 推断出, 使显出

examples.en: The workshop aims to educe hidden talents from even the shyest participants.
examples.zh: 工作坊旨在发掘哪怕最腼腆学员的潜在才能。

meaning: vi. 冒泡, 泡腾, 兴奋;起泡, 发气泡

examples.en: The vitamin tablets effervesce in water, releasing a light lemon flavor.
examples.zh: 维生素泡腾片在水中冒泡,释放淡淡的柠檬味。

meaning: vt. 围绕, 环绕, 珍爱

examples.en: Steep pine woods embosom the chapel and muffle every sound from the road.
examples.zh: 陡峭的松林环抱着小教堂,隔开了路上的声响。

meaning: n. 热血动物;吸热线

examples.en: An endotherm keeps its body temperature steady even in freezing weather.
examples.zh: 内温动物即使在严寒中也能保持体温恒定。

meaning: vt. 授予, 赋予, 穿上

examples.en: Legend says the spring could endue weary travelers with strength for the climb.
examples.zh: 传说这眼泉水能赋予疲惫的旅人登山的力气。

meaning: vt. 使高兴, 使愉快, 鼓励

examples.en: Cold morning swims exhilarate her far more than any cup of coffee.
examples.zh: 清晨的冷水泳比任何一杯咖啡都更让她精神振奋。

meaning: a. 外分泌的;外分泌的, 外分泌物

examples.en: The pancreas releases exocrine enzymes into the small intestine during digestion.
examples.zh: 消化时,胰腺把外分泌酶释放进小肠。

meaning: n. 柴把, 束薪;vt. 捆, 束

examples.en: The baker fed a fagot of dry kindling into the oven before dawn.
examples.zh: 天亮前,面包师把一捆干柴添进烤炉。

meaning: vt. 使挨饿;vi. 饥饿, 挨饿

examples.en: The long siege would famish the garrison long before spring arrived.
examples.zh: 漫长的围困会在春天到来之前就让守军断粮挨饿。

meaning: 鞭毛(原虫), 鞭节(昆虫)

examples.en: Many bacteria swim by rotating tiny flagella like boat propellers.
examples.zh: 许多细菌像船用螺旋桨一样旋转细小鞭毛游动。

meaning: n. 蝇粪留下的污点, 小斑, 污点;vi. 弄脏

examples.en: The inspector found one flyspeck on a glass and rejected the entire shipment.
examples.zh: 检查员在一块玻璃上发现一个污点,就拒收了整批货。

meaning: a. 不整洁的, 有臭味的, 很闷的

examples.en: The dorm's frowzy common room needed airing, scrubbing, and a fresh coat of paint.
examples.zh: 宿舍那间又脏又乱的公共休息室需要通风、擦洗和重新粉刷。

meaning: n. 通电, 镀锌, 震惊;镀锌; 镀锌作用

examples.en: Galvanization protects the bridge's steel cables from salt spray and rust.
examples.zh: 镀锌处理保护桥梁钢缆免受盐雾和锈蚀。

meaning: n. 饶舌, 多嘴;多言

examples.en: His garrulity tired the patience of everyone trapped beside him on the train.
examples.zh: 他的饶舌磨光了火车上被困在他身旁所有人的耐心。

meaning: a. 不易激动的, 冷静的, 脚踏实地的, 无懈可击的

examples.en: The hardheaded auditor refused to sign the accounts until every figure was verified.
examples.zh: 这位务实的审计员坚持核实每个数字后才肯签署账目。

meaning: n. 水圈, 水界, 水气

examples.en: Oceans, rivers, and groundwater together form the planet's hydrosphere.
examples.zh: 海洋、河流和地下水共同构成地球的水圈。

meaning: vt. 祈求, 诅咒

examples.en: The captured captain dared to imprecate curses upon the whole invading fleet.
examples.zh: 被俘的船长竟敢诅咒整支入侵舰队。

meaning: n. 无差别, 不加区别的事物(行为)

examples.en: Critics attacked the policy for its indiscrimination between serious and trivial offenses.
examples.zh: 批评者抨击该政策不分轻重罪行、一概而论。

meaning: vt. 写成文章, 创作

examples.en: She would indite long letters by candlelight after the children were asleep.
examples.zh: 孩子们睡后,她常在烛光下写长信。

meaning: a. 可导致的；可诱导的

examples.en: The enzyme is inducible, appearing only when lactose is present in the medium.
examples.zh: 这种酶是可诱导的,只有培养基中有乳糖时才出现。

meaning: a. 交错的

examples.en: The new tram line intersected the old trade route near the river ford.
examples.zh: 新电车线在河流渡口附近与旧商路交汇。

meaning: a. 开玩笑的, 诙谐的, 戏谑的

examples.en: His jocose reply lightened the mood of the tense budget meeting.
examples.zh: 他诙谐的回答缓和了预算会议的紧张气氛。

meaning: n. 波动曲线记录仪;记波器

examples.en: The kymograph recorded each muscle contraction as a wave on smoked paper.
examples.zh: 记纹器在熏烟纸上以波形记录每次肌肉收缩。

meaning: n. 画家, 画匠

examples.en: A wandering limner painted the family's portraits in exchange for a sack of flour.
examples.zh: 一位游方画师给全家画像,换得一袋面粉。

meaning: vt. 移动；行动

examples.en: Amoebas locomote by stretching finger-like projections of their cytoplasm forward.
examples.zh: 变形虫向前伸展指状细胞质来移动。

meaning: n. 疯草

examples.en: Ranchers clear locoweed from the pastures because it poisons grazing cattle.
examples.zh: 牧场主清除牧草地上的疯草,因为它会毒害牛群。

meaning: a. 持久的；持续的；长期的

examples.en: Regular sealing gives the deck a long-lasting finish against winter rain.
examples.zh: 定期封涂能让甲板获得持久的防护,抵御冬雨。

meaning: a. 长期存在的

examples.en: The two universities ended their long-standing rivalry with a joint research center.
examples.zh: 两所大学通过合建研究中心结束了长期竞争。

meaning: a. 男子气概的, 坚定的, 勇敢的, 果断的

examples.en: Despite exhaustion, the team made a manful effort in the final ten minutes.
examples.zh: 尽管筋疲力尽,球队在最后十分钟里仍全力拼搏。

meaning: n. 半空中

examples.en: The two drones nearly collided in midair above the crowded beach.
examples.zh: 两架无人机在拥挤海滩上空几乎相撞。

meaning: a. 矫饰的, 装腔作势的, 装模作样的, 切碎的

examples.en: The chef demonstrated the correct way of mincing garlic with a single knife.
examples.zh: 厨师演示了用一把刀正确剁蒜的方法。

meaning: a. 非人类的

examples.en: The ethics board now reviews studies involving nonhuman subjects.
examples.zh: 伦理委员会现在审查涉及非人类受试者的研究。

meaning: a. 无职业的, 无专长的

examples.en: The choir mixes trained singers with keen nonprofessional members from the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 合唱团将专业歌手与社区热心的业余成员混编。

meaning: n. 营养物, 食物, 营养素

examples.en: Decaying leaves provide nutriment for the seedlings on the forest floor.
examples.zh: 腐叶为林地上幼苗提供养分。

meaning: 分泌过多

examples.en: Chronic stress drives the oversecretion of cortisol, weakening immune defenses.
examples.zh: 长期压力促使皮质醇分泌过多,削弱免疫防御。

meaning: n. 杀父(罪), 杀父者;杀父, 杀父者

examples.en: In the myth, the gods punish patricide with unending storms.
examples.zh: 在神话中,诸神以无休止的风暴惩罚弑父之罪。

meaning: v. 挪用, 盗用, 侵吞

examples.en: The clerk was dismissed for attempting to peculate funds from the housing society.
examples.zh: 那名职员因企图挪用住房互助金而被解职。

meaning: 每人, 按人口, 按人口计算;每人, 按人头

examples.en: Per capita income in the region has doubled over the past decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年,该地区的人均收入翻了一番。

meaning: n. 使变成石头, 石化, 化石, 僵化, 吓呆;石化

examples.en: Visitors marvel at the petrifaction of ancient logs in the desert park.
examples.zh: 游客惊叹于沙漠公园中古木的石化。

meaning: pl. 现象

examples.en: Auroras are among the most photographed phenomena in the polar night sky.
examples.zh: 极光是极地夜空中被拍摄最多的现象之一。

meaning: n. 小偷小摸, 偷窃, 赃物;偷窃险, 脏物

examples.en: Hidden cameras cut pilferage in the warehouse by nearly ninety percent.
examples.zh: 隐蔽摄像头使仓库失窃减少近九成。

meaning: a. 老实说的, 直言无隐的, 言辞率直的

examples.en: Her plainspoken advice about budgets won the trust of every department head.
examples.zh: 她关于预算的直率建议赢得各部门主管的信任。

meaning: n. 浅池, 积水坑, 击水声, (水的)飞溅;v. (水)溅泼

examples.en: The soft plash of oars against the dock lulled the fishermen to sleep.
examples.zh: 船桨轻拍码头的声音让渔民昏昏欲睡。

meaning: 板状的, 层状的

examples.en: Under the microscope, the crystals form platelike sheets stacked like playing cards.
examples.zh: 显微镜下,晶体形成像扑克牌般叠放的板状薄片。

meaning: vt.vi. (使)闭会, (使)休会;使休会, 使闭会

examples.en: The constitution lets the president prorogue parliament only once per session.
examples.zh: 宪法规定总统每届会期只能宣布议会休会一次。

meaning: vt. 重组, 修改, 使镇定

examples.en: After the interruption, she paused and recomposed herself at the podium.
examples.zh: 中断之后,她停顿片刻,在讲台上重新镇定下来。

meaning: vt. 使适应, 再调整

examples.en: The merger forced the agency to reorient its services toward smaller clients.
examples.zh: 合并迫使该机构把服务转向更小的客户群。

meaning: n. 酬答, 还礼;报答, 回报, 报复

examples.en: He sent a crate of cherries as requital for the neighbor's help with the harvest.
examples.zh: 他送了一箱樱桃,答谢邻居在收获季的帮忙。

meaning: n. 象有学识, 装聪明, 智慧

examples.en: Ancient fables credit the owl with a grave and worldly sapience.
examples.zh: 古代寓言认为猫头鹰具备沉稳而世故的智慧。

meaning: n. 危害, 损伤, 损害;vt. 损伤, 伤害, 痛斥

examples.en: Frost could not scathe the hardy olives planted on the south slope.
examples.zh: 霜冻损伤不了种在南坡的耐寒橄榄树。

meaning: n. 促胰液素;肠促胰液肽; 胰泌素

examples.en: Secretin signals the pancreas to release bicarbonate when food enters the intestine.
examples.zh: 食物进入肠道时,促胰液素发出信号让胰腺释放碳酸氢盐。

meaning: a. 自给自足的, 极为自负的

examples.en: Solar panels and a rain tank made the mountain cabin self-sufficient.
examples.zh: 太阳能板和雨水箱让山间小屋实现了自给自足。

meaning: a. 雨量非常少的, 半干旱的

examples.en: Farmers in the semiarid belt rely on drought-resistant sorghum and millet.
examples.zh: 半干旱地带的农民靠抗旱的高粱和小米过日子。

meaning: n. 半文盲

examples.en: Night classes help semiliterate workers read contracts and protect their wages.
examples.zh: 夜校帮助半文盲工人读懂合同,维护自己的工资。

meaning: 半熔化的

examples.en: The semimolten rock beneath the plates drives the slow drift of continents.
examples.zh: 板块之下的半熔融岩石驱动大陆缓慢漂移。

meaning: a. 短射程的;短射程的

examples.en: Drones offer only short-range delivery, so depots must sit near customers.
examples.zh: 无人机配送距离有限,货站必须靠近客户。

meaning: a. 有背骨的, 有脊柱的, 有刺的

examples.en: The spined caterpillar warns off birds with bright stripes and sharp bristles.
examples.zh: 这种带刺的毛虫用鲜艳条纹和尖刺驱避鸟类。

meaning: 立体照片, 立体照相, 立体照像

examples.en: The doctors studied a stereophotograph of the fracture before planning the operation.
examples.zh: 制定手术方案前,医生们研究了骨折的立体照片。

meaning: n. 学科的分支

examples.en: Neurolinguistics grew into a distinct subdiscipline over the past fifty years.
examples.zh: 过去五十年,神经语言学发展成一门独立的分支学科。

meaning: vt. 使过热;n. 过热

examples.en: Power plants superheat the steam to squeeze more energy from every ton of coal.
examples.zh: 电厂把蒸汽过热,以从每吨煤中榨取更多能量。

meaning: n. 悬挂者(物), 袜吊, 吊裤带;悬吊带, 悬吊器

examples.en: He sewed the loose suspender button back on before the wedding photographs.
examples.zh: 婚礼拍照前,他把松掉的背带扣重新缝好。

meaning: 远程工作者

examples.en: As a telecommuter, she trades two hours of driving for a morning walk.
examples.zh: 作为远程上班族,她把两小时车程换成了晨间散步。

meaning: a. 丝状的, 像丝的, 细长的

examples.en: Threadlike fungi spread through the soil, ferrying nutrients between the trees.
examples.zh: 丝状真菌在土壤中蔓延,在树木之间输送养分。

meaning: a. 三维的, 立体的, 真实的

examples.en: The printer builds a three-dimensional model of the ruin layer by layer.
examples.zh: 打印机逐层构建遗址的三维模型。

meaning: a. 耗时的

examples.en: Proofreading the index was the most time-consuming stage of the whole project.
examples.zh: 校对索引是整个项目中最耗时的环节。

meaning: a. 有趾的, 斜着钉进去的

examples.en: The three-toed sloth climbs down from its tree only once a week.
examples.zh: 三趾树懒每周只下树一次。

meaning: a. 肿胀的, 肿大的;肿胀的

examples.en: The tumid river pressed against the levees after a week of rain.
examples.zh: 一周降雨后,暴涨的河水紧逼防洪堤。

meaning: adv. 不客气地, 无道德原则地

examples.en: The contractor unscrupulously billed the city for repairs that were never made.
examples.zh: 承包商昧着良心向市政府收取从未做过的维修费。

meaning: n. 脉纹的形成, 脉纹的排列;铸模龟裂

examples.en: Careful polishing brings out the delicate veining in the marble countertop.
examples.zh: 细心抛光让大理石台面上细腻的纹理显现出来。

meaning: n. 生机论者, 活力论者;生机论者, 生活力说者

examples.en: The vitalist insisted that no chemistry could explain the growth of embryos.
examples.zh: 这位活力论者坚称任何化学都解释不了胚胎的发育。

meaning: a. 可保证的, 可担保的, 可证明为正当的;可保证的, 可承认的, 正当的

examples.en: The delay was hardly warrantable after three weeks of perfect weather.
examples.zh: 连续三周好天气之后,这样的延误实在说不过去。

meaning: n. 织布鸟

examples.en: The weaverbird braids grass into a hanging nest with a narrow entrance.
examples.zh: 织布鸟把草编成入口狭窄的悬巢。

meaning: a. 楔形的;楔形

examples.en: A wedge-shaped block of ice slid from the roof into the yard.
examples.zh: 一块楔形冰从屋顶滑落到院子里。

meaning: a. 安宁的, 康乐的

examples.en: Flexible hours improved the staff's well-being more than any bonus.
examples.zh: 弹性工作比任何奖金都更能提升员工幸福感。

meaning: n. 中心, 中心点, 中锋;a. 中央的, 位在正中的

examples.en: The debate will center on funding for rural schools.
examples.zh: 辩论将围绕乡村学校经费展开。

meaning: a. 联合的, 团结的, 一致的, 和睦的;联合的, 统一的, 一致的

examples.en: The united opposition forced the government to withdraw the fuel tax.
examples.zh: 团结一致的反对派迫使政府撤回燃油税。

meaning: n. 约克郡；约克王朝

examples.en: The family spent a rainy weekend exploring the medieval lanes of York.
examples.zh: 一家人在雨中的周末漫步探索约克的中世纪小巷。

meaning: a. 存在的, 目前的, 现存的, 现有的;现成的, 已有的, 现存的

examples.en: Engineers must strengthen the existing bridge before the heavier trams can cross.
examples.zh: 更重的电车通行前,工程师必须先加固现有桥梁。

meaning: n. 牛津, 牛津大学

examples.en: He polished his brown Oxford shoes for the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 他为毕业典礼擦亮了那双棕色牛津鞋。

meaning: n. 工作, 运转, 劳动;a. 工作的, 劳动的, 经营的, 抽搐的, 运转的

examples.en: After two weekends of tinkering, the old radio is working again.
examples.zh: 摆弄了两个周末之后,旧收音机又能出声了。

meaning: a. 教育的, 教育性的

examples.en: The museum loans educational kits to rural schools every spring.
examples.zh: 博物馆每年春天向乡村学校出借教学用具箱。

meaning: adv. 有效地, 有力地, 实际上

examples.en: The new filters effectively remove lead from the town's drinking water.
examples.zh: 新滤芯有效去除了镇上饮用水中的铅。

meaning: n. 创造, 创作物, 发明;产生

examples.en: The gallery marked the creation of a fund for young sculptors.
examples.zh: 美术馆庆祝青年雕塑家基金正式设立。

meaning: n. 西班牙

examples.en: He studied flamenco guitar in Spain for two winters.
examples.zh: 他连续两个冬天在西班牙学弗拉门戈吉他。

meaning: vt. 烦扰, 迷惑;vi. 烦恼, 操心

examples.en: Don't bother printing the forms; the office now accepts scans.
examples.zh: 不必费心打印表格,办事处现在收电子版。

meaning: n. 经费, 开销;开支, 开销, 经费

examples.en: The board voted to cap spending on travel for the next fiscal year.
examples.zh: 董事会投票决定下一财年限制差旅开支。

meaning: n. 剑桥

examples.en: Her paper on glacier retreat was accepted at a Cambridge conference.
examples.zh: 她那篇关于冰川消退的论文入选剑桥的一场会议。

meaning: n. 设计者, 谋划者, 制图者;设计员

examples.en: The designer chose a calmer palette for the hospital waiting rooms.
examples.zh: 设计师为医院候诊区选用了更沉静的色调。

meaning: n. 元, 雄鹿, 纨绔子弟, 鞍马, 培克(赌博时的庄家标志), 碱水, 自夸, 谈话;vi. 马背突然拱起, 反对, 吹牛, 闲聊

examples.en: A young buck stepped out of the pines at dusk.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分,一头年轻的雄鹿走出松林。

meaning: n. 伯明翰

examples.en: The jewelry quarter in Birmingham still houses hundreds of small workshops.
examples.zh: 伯明翰的珠宝区仍聚集着数百家小作坊。

meaning: a. 生物学的;生物学的

examples.en: Wetlands filter pollution and support rich biological communities.
examples.zh: 湿地能过滤污染,并支撑丰富的生物群落。

meaning: n. (非正式)杀人者, 屠杀者, 猛兽, 致死(疾病), 杀手, 止痛药, 限制器, 瞄准器;删除程序; 断路器

examples.en: Cheap imported copies became the killer of the local shoe industry.
examples.zh: 廉价进口仿制品成了本地制鞋业的致命杀手。

meaning: a. 讲述的, 叙述的；有关系的, 有关联的

examples.en: The two fires on the same block appear to be related.
examples.zh: 同一街区的两场火灾看起来存在关联。

meaning: 处理;加工

examples.en: Local processing of the catch keeps more jobs in the fishing port.
examples.zh: 渔获就地加工为渔港保留了更多就业岗位。

meaning: n. 布里斯托尔(英国西部港口)

examples.en: The balloon fiesta fills Bristol's skies every August morning.
examples.zh: 每年八月的清晨,热气球节布满布里斯托尔的天空。

meaning: n. 柏林, (软质)柏林毛线

examples.en: The orchestra toured Berlin before recording the new symphony.
examples.zh: 乐团在录制新交响曲前先去了柏林巡演。

meaning: n. 看守者, 监护人, 保护人;a. 保护的

examples.en: The court appointed a guardian to manage the young heir's estate.
examples.zh: 法院指定一名监护人打理年轻继承人的财产。

meaning: n. 正餐, 宴会

examples.en: The hotel's rooftop dining terrace overlooks the old harbor lights.
examples.zh: 酒店顶层的露天餐区俯瞰老港灯火。

meaning: n. 课税, 征税, 抽税, 税款, 估定的税额;征税, 纳税, 税制

examples.en: Parliament debated the taxation of empty homes for several weeks.
examples.zh: 议会就空置房屋征税问题辩论了数周。

meaning: n. 生活方式

examples.en: A quieter lifestyle by the sea cured her chronic insomnia.
examples.zh: 海边更安静的生活方式治好了她的慢性失眠。

meaning: n. 农业, 耕作

examples.en: Terrace farming lets villagers grow rice on the steep hillsides.
examples.zh: 梯田耕作让村民能在陡坡上种水稻。

meaning: n. 喝, 喝酒

examples.en: The charity installs wells so villagers have safe drinking water.
examples.zh: 慈善机构打井,让村民喝上安全饮用水。

meaning: n. 银行业务;银行业, 银行事务

examples.en: Mobile banking spread quickly in regions with few branch offices.
examples.zh: 在网点稀少的地区,手机银行迅速普及。

meaning: n. 指示器, 指示剂, 指标;指示器

examples.en: Moth numbers are a useful indicator of a healthy hedgerow.
examples.zh: 蛾类数量是树篱生态健康的有用指标。

meaning: n. 步行, 步态;a. 步行的, 步行用的

examples.en: A walking tour of the murals takes about ninety minutes.
examples.zh: 步行游览壁画大约需要九十分钟。

meaning: n. 舞蹈演员, 跳舞者

examples.en: The principal dancer retired after twenty seasons with the national ballet.
examples.zh: 首席舞者随国家芭蕾舞团二十个演出季后退休。

meaning: n. 教养, 生育, 饲养;生育, 繁殖, 育种, 饲养

examples.en: The wetland serves as a breeding ground for migrating herons.
examples.zh: 这片湿地是迁徙苍鹭的繁殖地。

meaning: n. 赶, 操纵, 驾驶;a. 推进的, 强劲的, 精力旺盛的

examples.en: Drowsy driving causes as many crashes as drunken driving on rural roads.
examples.zh: 在乡村道路上,疲劳驾驶与酒驾酿成的事故一样多。

meaning: n. 开端, 开始, 出发, 起动, 开动;开动, 起动

examples.en: Starting a compost pile is easier than most gardeners expect.
examples.zh: 堆肥堆的起建比多数园艺爱好者想的容易。

meaning: n. 开端者, 在起跑线上的人, 参加赛跑的人, 调度员, 起动机, 酵母;启动程序, 启动器

examples.en: A bowl of lentil soup made a hearty starter.
examples.zh: 一碗扁豆汤是道暖胃的开胃菜。

meaning: a. 职业的, 军事占领的;职业的

examples.en: Back pain remains the most common occupational injury among nurses.
examples.zh: 背痛仍是护士中最常见的职业伤害。

meaning: a. 可付的, 到期的, 应付的, 有利益的;应付的

examples.en: The fine is payable within thirty days of receiving the notice.
examples.zh: 罚款须在收到通知后三十日内缴清。

meaning: n. 切断, 切下, 路堑;切屑

examples.en: The workshop teaches safe cutting of sheet metal for beginners.
examples.zh: 车间向初学者传授安全的金属板材切割。

meaning: a. 父母亲的, 做双亲的, 作为渊源的;父母的, 双亲的

examples.en: Parental consent is required before students join the overnight field trip.
examples.zh: 学生参加夜间考察前须取得家长同意。

meaning: n. 英国货币, 标准纯银;a. 英国货币的, 标准纯银的, 含标准成分的

examples.en: The jeweler stamps each sterling piece with the workshop's own mark.
examples.zh: 银匠在每件纯银制品上打上作坊印记。

meaning: n. 处理;a. 操作的

examples.en: Careful handling preserved the fragile glass negatives for over a century.
examples.zh: 妥善的搬运保存使易碎玻璃底片留存百年。

meaning: a. 中间的, 中央的, 中部的;prep. 在...之中

examples.en: She froze mid sentence when the fire alarm rang.
examples.zh: 火警骤响,她话说一半愣住了。

meaning: n. 放置, 布置, 工作安排, 编班, 定位球;放置

examples.en: The agency guarantees a work placement for every trainee who passes.
examples.zh: 该机构保证每位通过考核的学员获得实习岗位。

meaning: n. 制造, (手工)制造业, 制作, 形成, 发展, 要素, 内在因素, 赚头, 制造物

examples.en: The short film documents the making of a violin from a single log.
examples.zh: 这部短片记录了一把小提琴由一根原木诞生的过程。

meaning: n. 草案, 礼仪, 协议;v. 拟定

examples.en: The new protocol requires two nurses to check every dose.
examples.zh: 新规程要求两名护士核对每一剂药。

meaning: n. 计划者, 设计者, 安排者;刨床机

examples.en: The town planner reserved a corridor for the future tram line.
examples.zh: 城市规划师为未来的电车线路预留了通道。

meaning: n. 评价, 估价, 价值判断;估价, 计价, 评价

examples.en: An independent valuation put the vineyard at three million euros.
examples.zh: 独立评估给这座葡萄园作价三百万欧元。

meaning: a. 印刷的, 印好的, 印花样的;印刷的

examples.en: The corrected pages were printed and bound within a week.
examples.zh: 订正后的书页一周内完成印刷装订。

meaning: a. 附近的, 邻近的, 邻接的

examples.en: Fire crews from neighboring towns helped contain the warehouse blaze.
examples.zh: 邻镇消防队协助控制了仓库大火。

meaning: n. 清洁, 扫除, 家畜的胞衣, 扫除出来的垃圾, 大败, 输得精光, 除伐, 巨额利润;清洗, 清除

examples.en: Regular cleaning of the vents keeps the kitchen free of grease fires.
examples.zh: 定期清洁排风管道可避免厨房油火。

meaning: a. 领土的, 土地的, 地方的, 区域性的;n. 本土自卫队队员

examples.en: The gulls become fiercely territorial during the nesting weeks.
examples.zh: 筑巢的几周里,海鸥领地意识极强。

meaning: n. 组织者, 编制者, 创立者, 组织导体;组织导体, 机化中心(胚)

examples.en: The festival organizer booked local bands instead of expensive headliners.
examples.zh: 音乐节主办人请了本地乐队,没请昂贵大牌。

meaning: n. 小册子

examples.en: A slim booklet explains the trail markers in four languages.
examples.zh: 一本薄册子用四种语言讲解步道标识。

meaning: n. 鸡尾酒, 开味品;a. 鸡尾酒会的

examples.en: The bar's signature cocktail combines grapefruit, honey, and rosemary.
examples.zh: 这家酒吧的招牌鸡尾酒融合西柚、蜂蜜和迷迭香。

meaning: n. 上升, 造反, 叛乱;a. 上升的, 高涨的, 新兴的

examples.en: Rising freight costs pushed the price of flour sharply higher.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的运费大幅推高了面粉价格。

meaning: n. 调味品, 穿衣, 化妆;追肥

examples.en: The nurse changed the dressing on the wound every morning.
examples.zh: 护士每天早晨为伤口更换敷料。

meaning: a. 精神病学的, 医精神病的;精神病学的

examples.en: The hospital opened a psychiatric wing for adolescents last spring.
examples.zh: 这家医院去年春天开设了青少年心理病区。

meaning: n. 暗杀;暗杀, 行刺

examples.en: The museum preserves the balcony where the assassination attempt failed.
examples.zh: 博物馆保存了那次刺杀未遂发生的阳台。

meaning: n. 雅典(希腊首都)

examples.en: From the hill you can see most of Athens below.
examples.zh: 从山顶可以俯瞰雅典的大部分城区。

meaning: n. 典狱官, 渔猎法监督官, 看守人;看守人, 监护人, 管理员

examples.en: The park warden leads a dawn walk to count the deer.
examples.zh: 公园管理员黎明带队清点鹿群数量。

meaning: adv. 恰当地, 充分地, 适当地, 及时地

examples.en: The contract was duly signed and filed with the county clerk.
examples.zh: 合同依规签署,并交县书记官存档。

meaning: n. 清除, 间隙;间隙; 空隙

examples.en: The pilot waited for clearance while snow buried the runway lights.
examples.zh: 大雪掩埋跑道灯时,飞行员仍在等待放行许可。

meaning: a. 应用的;应用的; 应用, 申请

examples.en: Applied research turned the lab's alloy into lighter surgical tools.
examples.zh: 应用研究把实验室合金变成更轻的手术器械。

meaning: n. 悉尼（澳大利亚港市）

examples.en: The ferry from Manly gives the best view of Sydney Harbour.
examples.zh: 从曼利出发的渡轮能饱览悉尼港美景。

meaning: n. 团体, 协会, 行业协会;同业公会

examples.en: In the 1400s a powerful guild governed every goldsmith in the city.
examples.zh: 十五世纪时,一个强大的行会管辖城中所有金匠。

meaning: n. 给养；承办酒席；提供饮食及服务

examples.en: The couple chose a small catering firm that uses only local produce.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇选了家只用本地食材的小餐饮公司。

meaning: n. 夜总会, 迪斯科, 的士高

examples.en: The youth club's Friday disco raised money for new guitars.
examples.zh: 青年俱乐部周五的迪斯科舞会为新吉他筹款。

meaning: n. 睡眠;a. 睡着的

examples.en: Freezing nights demand thicker sleeping bags on the high plateau.
examples.zh: 高原寒夜需要更厚的睡袋。

meaning: n. 林学, 森林地;林地, 林学, 林业

examples.en: Sustainable forestry allows a controlled cut each winter.
examples.zh: 可持续林业允许每年冬天限额采伐。

meaning: n. 出借人, 贷方;出借者, 贷方, 贷款人

examples.en: As the largest lender, the bank set strict terms for the bridge loan.
examples.zh: 作为最大放贷方,银行为过渡贷款定下苛刻条件。

meaning: a. 可信的, 可靠的;可信的, 可靠的

examples.en: The witness gave a credible account that matched the security footage.
examples.zh: 证人的陈述可信,与监控录像吻合。

meaning: n. 甲胄, 装甲, 潜水服

examples.en: The museum restored a suit of medieval armour for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 博物馆为展览修复了一套中世纪盔甲。

meaning: vt. 配音, 轻点, 授予称号, 击;n. 一下击鼓声, 笨蛋

examples.en: The press began to dub the young mayor 'the reformer'.
examples.zh: 媒体开始把这位年轻市长称作改革派。

meaning: a. 暂时的, 暂定的, 临时的;临时的

examples.en: The committee issued a provisional schedule, subject to change after the draw.
examples.zh: 委员会发布了临时赛程,抽签后或有调整。

meaning: a. 部门的, 各部的, 分科的

examples.en: Departmental budgets will be reviewed at Thursday's meeting.
examples.zh: 各部门预算将在周四会议上审议。

meaning: a. (头发)亚麻色的, 淡色的, 白肤金发碧眼的, 白里透红的, 白皙的, 淡黄色的;n. 肤色白皙的金发女人
