examples.en: The witness described a tall blonde man in a gray raincoat.
examples.zh: 目击者描述了一名灰雨衣的金发高个男子。

meaning: n. 溶剂;a. 有偿付能力的, 有溶解力的

examples.en: Ticket sales kept the small theater solvent through two lean winters.
examples.zh: 票房让这家小剧院撑过两个惨淡的冬天。

meaning: a. 药学的, 制药的, 药用的, 药物的, 药剂师的, 药师的;n. 药品, 成药, 药剂

examples.en: The pharmaceutical company recalled two batches of blood pressure pills.
examples.zh: 这家制药公司召回了两个批次降压药。

meaning: n. 掌舵, 操纵, 指导

examples.en: The driver pulled over when the steering began to stick on the bends.
examples.zh: 方向盘在弯道开始发涩,司机随即靠边停车。

meaning: n. 板岩, 页岩, 提名名单, 人选, 记录, 石板;a. 石板色的

examples.en: The quarry still cuts slate for roofs across the valley.
examples.zh: 采石场仍为山谷各地切割屋顶板岩。

meaning: n. 登记, 注册, 入伍;登记, 注册

examples.en: Enrollment in evening language classes doubled after the fee waiver.
examples.zh: 减免学费后,夜间语言班报名人数翻倍。

meaning: a. 专注的, 献身的

examples.en: A dedicated team of volunteers repairs bicycles for refugees.
examples.zh: 一支热忱的志愿者队伍为难民修自行车。

meaning: a. 属类的, 一般的;一般的

examples.en: Pharmacists often suggest a generic drug that costs half as much.
examples.zh: 药师常推荐价格减半的仿制药。

meaning: n. 脏水, 污水;污水, 污物

examples.en: The city will upgrade its sewage plants before the summer crowds arrive.
examples.zh: 该市将在夏季人潮到来前升级污水处理厂。

meaning: n. 火炮, 炮兵, 炮术;火炮, 炮兵

examples.en: Museum staff polished the old artillery pieces for the centenary display.
examples.zh: 馆员为百年展览擦拭老旧火炮。

meaning: n. 精神力, 智力, 头脑作用, 心态;智力

examples.en: The coach tried to instill a champion's mentality in the young squad.
examples.zh: 教练努力向年轻队伍灌输冠军心态。

meaning: n. 种植, 栽培, 播种, 人工林, 花圃, 苗圃

examples.en: The students finished planting two hundred saplings along the riverbank.
examples.zh: 学生们沿河岸种完了两百棵树苗。

meaning: n. 会见者, 面谈者, 进行面试者

examples.en: The interviewer asked pointed questions about the gaps in his resume.
examples.zh: 面试官就他简历上的空档提出尖锐问题。

meaning: n. 草皮, 泥炭, 跑马场;vt. 覆草皮于

examples.en: The gardeners rolled fresh turf over the worn training field.
examples.zh: 园丁为磨损的训练场铺上新鲜草皮。

meaning: n. 无, 全无, 零;无, 零, 无有

examples.en: The second leg ended nil nil, so penalties decided the tie.
examples.zh: 次回合零比零战平,只能点球决胜。

meaning: a. 忙碌的, 爱管闲事的, 自负的, 固执己见的, 实际的, 务实的, 国事的, 国务的;闲断的, 固执己见的, 实用主义的

examples.en: The council took a pragmatic approach, repairing the roof before the autumn rains.
examples.zh: 议会采取务实做法,赶在秋雨前修好屋顶。

meaning: a. 进来的, 刚开始的, 新来的;n. 进来

examples.en: The port logs every incoming vessel before it may dock.
examples.zh: 港口对每艘进港船只先登记后准停靠。

meaning: n. 海味, 海鲜, 鱼类

examples.en: The market's seafood stalls open at dawn with the day's catch.
examples.zh: 市场的海鲜摊随当日渔获在黎明开张。

meaning: n. 军火, 弹药;弹药

examples.en: Soldiers cached spare ammunition in the cellar throughout the long siege.
examples.zh: 漫长围城中,士兵们把备用弹药藏在地下室。

meaning: n. 奉献, 献身, 献辞;专用

examples.en: Her dedication to night classes earned her a nursing degree at fifty.
examples.zh: 她坚持上夜课,五十岁取得护理学位。

meaning: a. 不平坦的, 不均等的, 奇数的

examples.en: Uneven funding leaves some schools with crumbling labs and leaking roofs.
examples.zh: 经费不均使一些学校实验室破败、屋顶漏水。

meaning: adv. 定期, 循环, 间歇, 周期, 定期刊行, 期刊

examples.en: The system periodically backs up customer data to a remote server.
examples.zh: 系统定期把客户数据备份到远程服务器。

meaning: n. 偶然性, 可能性, 意外事故;意外事故, 意外开支, 偶然事故

examples.en: Keep three months of savings as a contingency against sudden job loss.
examples.zh: 存足三个月生活费,以防突然失业。

meaning: n. 小组委员会

examples.en: A subcommittee will review the safety rules before the next season.
examples.zh: 小组委员会将在下赛季前审查安全规则。

meaning: n. 碎屑, 面包屑, 少许;vt. 捏碎, 弄碎

examples.en: A single crumb of bread drew a line of ants across the desk.
examples.zh: 一粒面包屑引来一列蚂蚁爬过桌面。

meaning: n. 马来西亚;马来西亚

examples.en: She taught marine biology in Malaysia for two memorable years.
examples.zh: 她在马来西亚教了两年海洋生物学,令人难忘。

meaning: 上扬

examples.en: Heating costs ran higher this winter, so the council extended its relief fund.
examples.zh: 今冬取暖费用更高,议会因此延长了补助基金。

meaning: a. 不尖的, 钝的, 不得要领的

examples.en: Arguing with the referee is pointless; the decision cannot be changed.
examples.zh: 与裁判争执毫无意义,判罚无法更改。

meaning: 租用, 雇用

examples.en: The airline paused hiring while fuel prices stayed high.
examples.zh: 燃油价格高企期间,这家航空暂停招聘。

meaning: n. 期待, 期望的事物, 嘱望, 希望, 期望, 预期;预期

examples.en: Clean water and vaccination raised life expectancy across the region.
examples.zh: 清洁水源和疫苗接种提高了当地预期寿命。

meaning: n. 阿斯匹林;乙酰水杨酸; 阿司匹灵; 邻乙酸基苯甲酸

examples.en: The pharmacist suggested taking aspirin with food to avoid stomach upset.
examples.zh: 药师建议随餐服阿司匹林,以免肠胃不适。

meaning: a. 经验丰富的, 老练的

examples.en: A seasoned reporter, she stayed calm when the press conference turned hostile.
examples.zh: 作为资深记者,发布会转呛时她依然镇定。

meaning: n. 行军床, 小屋, (家畜等的)棚, (家畜等的)栏;指套; 小床

examples.en: The hospital added a cot so the parent could sleep beside the child.
examples.zh: 医院加了张折叠床,让家长能睡在孩子身旁。

meaning: n. 补药, (音乐)主调音或基音;a. 滋补的, 声调的, 使精神振作的

examples.en: A walk along the cliffs was the best tonic for his tired mind.
examples.zh: 悬崖散步是他疲惫心灵的最好调剂。

meaning: a. 战争的, 军事的, 尚武的, 威武的;含铁的

examples.en: He took up martial arts to build discipline after school.
examples.zh: 放学后他开始练武术,培养自律。

meaning: n. 卖弄风骚的人, 急动, 急扔;vt. 忽然弹出, 轻快摆动, 挥动

examples.en: Young sailors were warned not to flirt with danger on the slippery deck.
examples.zh: 年轻水手受到警告,别在湿滑甲板上玩命。

meaning: n. 就职, 装设, 分期付款

examples.en: The final instalment of the trilogy reaches bookstores this autumn.
examples.zh: 三部曲的最后一部今秋上市发售。

meaning: n. 爱国心, 爱国精神, 爱国主义

examples.en: His patriotism expressed itself in decades of unpaid coastguard service.
examples.zh: 他的爱国心体现在数十年无酬的海岸救援服务。

meaning: n. 软木塞, 软木树, 软木;木栓

examples.en: The cork forests of southern Portugal are harvested every nine years.
examples.zh: 葡萄牙南部的软木树林每九年采剥一次。

meaning: n. 骑脚踏车兜风, 骑脚踏车消遣;循环操作

examples.en: Cycling to work cut his commuting costs in half.
examples.zh: 骑车上班让他的通勤开支减半。

meaning: n. 浮渣, 糟粕, 浮藻, 熔渣, 不起好作用的人;vt. 撇去(浮沫)

examples.en: Workers skimmed a green scum from the surface of the cooling pond.
examples.zh: 工人撇去冷却池水面的绿色浮垢。

meaning: a. 恶兆的, 不吉利的, 预兆的

examples.en: An ominous silence fell over the stadium as the storm approached.
examples.zh: 暴风雨逼近,体育场陷入不祥的寂静。

meaning: n. 召集, 集合, 检阅, 清单, 花名册, 样品;vt. 召集, 集合, 应召

examples.en: She could not muster much enthusiasm for another committee meeting.
examples.zh: 她实在提不起劲再开一次委员会。

meaning: a. 遗忘的, 健忘的, 不知不觉的;忘却的, 健忘的, 不在意的

examples.en: He walked on, oblivious to the sirens behind him.
examples.zh: 他继续前行,对身后的警笛浑然不觉。

meaning: vt. 损毁, 损伤, 糟蹋;n. 三月

examples.en: One careless footnote could mar an otherwise careful piece of research.
examples.zh: 一个粗心的脚注可能败坏原本严谨的研究。

meaning: a. 尖的, 有尖顶的, 锐利的, 率直的, 显然的

examples.en: The chair avoided the reporter's pointed question about the missing funds.
examples.zh: 主席避开了记者关于资金下落的尖锐提问。

meaning: vt. 驱散, 驱逐

examples.en: The manager met the staff to dispel rumors of layoffs.
examples.zh: 经理与员工座谈,澄清裁员传闻。

meaning: a. 被抛弃了的, 无主的, 玩忽职守的;n. 遗弃物, 被遗弃的人, 玩忽职守者

examples.en: The derelict mill was converted into artists' studios last year.
examples.zh: 那座废弃磨坊去年被改成艺术家工作室。

meaning: a. 不适当的, 过度的, 未到期的;未到(支付)期的

examples.en: Do not place undue trust in a single weather model.
examples.zh: 不要过分信赖单一气象模型。

meaning: prep. 在...当中

examples.en: Amidst the applause, the retiring teacher thanked her first students.
examples.zh: 掌声之中,即将退休的教师感谢了她最早的学生。

meaning: a. 世袭的, 遗传的;遗传的

examples.en: The disease is hereditary, so the whole family joined the screening study.
examples.zh: 这种病具有遗传性,全家都参加了筛查研究。

meaning: n. 陈腔滥调, 凸印版;a. 陈腐的

examples.en: Her opening line avoided the tired cliche about following your dreams.
examples.zh: 她的开场白避开了追逐梦想的老套说辞。

meaning: n. 救济品, 失业救济金;vt. 发放救济

examples.en: He was on the dole for a year before the bakery hired him.
examples.zh: 面包房雇他之前,他领了一年失业救济金。

meaning: n. 特权, 君权, 职权;a. 特权的, 行使特权的

examples.en: Choosing the menu is the host's prerogative, not the caterer's.
examples.zh: 定菜单是主人的特权,不是承办方的。

meaning: v. 回收利用( recycle的过去式和过去分词 ); 再利用; 再次应用; 重新使用（概念、方法、玩笑等）

examples.en: The park benches are made from recycled ocean plastic.
examples.zh: 公园长椅由回收的海洋塑料制成。

meaning: n. 铺位, 废话, 逃走;vi. 逃跑, 睡在铺上

examples.en: The cabin's narrow bunk creaked with every roll of the ship.
examples.zh: 船身每次摇晃,舱内窄铺就吱呀作响。

meaning: n. （英）擦靴的仆役；靴子（boot的复数）

examples.en: The hikers left their muddy boots outside the hostel door.
examples.zh: 徒步者把泥靴留在旅舍门外。

meaning: n. 苏格兰人

examples.en: A cheery Scotsman guided our group across the foggy moors.
examples.zh: 一位爽朗的苏格兰人领我们穿越雾中荒原。

meaning: n. 畸形人, 畸形物, 不正常的事物, 反复无常;a. 奇异的, 反常的

examples.en: A freak hailstorm in June stripped the orchards overnight.
examples.zh: 六月一场反常冰雹一夜之间毁了果园。

meaning: vt. 击退, 保护, 供养

examples.en: The program teaches refugees to fend for themselves in a new city.
examples.zh: 该项目教难民在陌生城市自立谋生。

meaning: n. 舞厅, 跳舞场

examples.en: The hotel's grand ballroom hosted the city's charity gala.
examples.zh: 酒店的大宴会厅承办了城市慈善晚会。

meaning: a. 现象的, 能知觉的, 异常的, 显著的, 惊人的

examples.en: The startup saw phenomenal growth after its app went viral.
examples.zh: 应用走红后,这家初创公司增长惊人。

meaning: vi. 牛拉货车, 艰苦跋涉;n. 牛车旅行, 艰苦跋涉

examples.en: The trek to base camp takes nine days on foot.
examples.zh: 徒步到大本营需要九天时间。

meaning: n. 一百年;a. 一百年的

examples.en: The city planned a year of events for the bridge's centenary.
examples.zh: 为纪念大桥落成百年,该市筹备全年活动。

meaning: n. 疟疾, 瘴气;疟

examples.en: Bed nets remain the cheapest defense against malaria in humid regions.
examples.zh: 在湿热地区,蚊帐仍是抵御疟疾最廉价的手段。

meaning: a. 不充分的, 不足的;vt. 减少, 吝啬, 限制, 藐视, 忽略

examples.en: The report offered scant evidence for such a sweeping claim.
examples.zh: 这份报告为如此笼统的论断提供的证据寥寥。

meaning: n. 慷慨, 宽大, 礼物;奖励金, 补贴

examples.en: The harbor's autumn bounty filled the market with silver fish.
examples.zh: 秋港的丰饶让市场摆满银亮的鱼。

meaning: n. 硬纸盒, 纸板箱;卡纸

examples.en: He flattened each carton before stacking it for recycling.
examples.zh: 他把纸箱逐一压扁码好以便回收。

meaning: a. 锯齿状的;锯齿形的

examples.en: Jagged peaks ring the valley on three sides.
examples.zh: 锯齿状的山峰从三面环抱山谷。

meaning: a. 瘦的, 不毛的, 贫乏的, 贫弱的, 少量的, 力量不够的, 质不高的, 量不足的

examples.en: She raised three children on a meagre seamstress wage.
examples.zh: 她靠微薄的缝纫工资养大三个孩子。

meaning: a. 旅行的, 旅行用的, 移动的

examples.en: Traveling by night train saved the cost of two hotel nights.
examples.zh: 乘夜班火车出行省下两晚酒店钱。

meaning: a. 可笑的, 滑稽的, 荒唐的

examples.en: It seems ludicrous to fine a food truck for a crooked sign.
examples.zh: 因招牌挂歪就罚餐车,实在荒唐。

meaning: a. 乖张的, 故意作对的, 有悖常情的, 执迷不悟的, 歪曲的, 错误的, 不正当的;邪恶的, 罪恶的:堕落的, 不合法的

examples.en: In a perverse twist, the safety drill itself caused the accident.
examples.zh: 荒诞的是,安全演习本身酿成了事故。

meaning: n. 盛会, 游行, 虚饰, 露天表演

examples.en: The town's winter pageant features lanterns made by schoolchildren.
examples.zh: 小镇冬季节庆以学生手制灯笼为亮点。

meaning: n. 光彩, 假象, 注释;vt. 使光彩, 掩盖, 上光于, 注释, 曲解

examples.en: No amount of marketing gloss can hide the app's weak privacy controls.
examples.zh: 再多营销粉饰也掩盖不了这款应用薄弱的隐私管控。

meaning: n. 大破坏, 蹂躏;vt. 严重破坏

examples.en: The summer storms wreaked havoc on the cherry harvest.
examples.zh: 夏季风暴重创樱桃收成。

meaning: n. 肤色, 情况, 局面;体质; 面色, 面容

examples.en: The scandal changed the complexion of the election overnight.
examples.zh: 丑闻一夜之间改变了选举的态势。

meaning: n. 蔑视, 挑战;挑战, 藐视, 违抗

examples.en: In open defiance of the ban, the fishermen sailed at dawn.
examples.zh: 渔民公然违抗禁令,拂晓出海。

meaning: n. 门厅, 入门大堂

examples.en: Latecomers waited in the gilded foyer until the interval.
examples.zh: 迟到观众在金碧辉煌的门厅等到中场。

meaning: n. 优先, 居先;先后次序; 优先规定

examples.en: Safety must take precedence over speed on any construction site.
examples.zh: 在任何工地,安全都必须优先于进度。

meaning: n. 英里数;运费(按英里计算的)

examples.en: Correct tire pressure improves your mileage by a few percent.
examples.zh: 胎压标准可使油耗表现提升几个百分点。

meaning: a. 可怕的, 惨白的, 极坏的;adv. 可怖地, 惨白地

examples.en: The forecast promised ghastly weather for the whole holiday week.
examples.zh: 预报说整个假期天气都糟糕透顶。

meaning: n. 船岸之间的水区, 锚地, 卧铺;vi. 停泊

examples.en: The captain eased the ferry into its berth beside the fish market.
examples.zh: 船长驾渡轮缓缓靠上鱼市旁的泊位。

meaning: n. 胀, 膨胀;vi. 凸出

examples.en: A slight bulge in the pipe warned of pressure building inside.
examples.zh: 管道轻微鼓起,警示内部压力积聚。

meaning: n. 误用, 滥用;vt. 误用, 滥用, 虐待

examples.en: The audit revealed systematic misuse of the research funds.
examples.zh: 审计发现研究经费遭到系统性滥用。

meaning: n. 鳄鱼

examples.en: Rangers warned tourists after a crocodile was seen near the swimming hole.
examples.zh: 在游泳水域附近发现鳄鱼后,管理员警告游客。

meaning: vt. 妨碍, 干扰, 调戏;调戏, 作弄, 恶意干涉

examples.en: The school trained staff to recognize signs that a child might be molested.
examples.zh: 学校培训员工识别儿童可能遭侵害的迹象。

meaning: vt. 获得, 取得, 导致;vi. 拉皮条

examples.en: The hospital struggled to procure enough saline solution during the shortage.
examples.zh: 短缺期间,医院难以购得足量生理盐水。

meaning: a. 原始的, 土著的;n. 土著居民, 土生生物

examples.en: The park is co-managed with aboriginal rangers who read the fire seasons.
examples.zh: 这座公园与深谙火季的原住民护林员共管。

meaning: n. 三人一组, 三个一组的东西, 三位一体

examples.en: The lecture explored the trinity of liberty, equality, and fraternity.
examples.zh: 讲座探讨了自由、平等与博爱三位一体。

meaning: n. 逐出, 开除, 驱逐, 排气;逼出

examples.en: The senator faces expulsion after the bribery recordings were released.
examples.zh: 受贿录音曝光后,该参议员面临开除处分。

meaning: vt. 译解, 解释;n. 密电译文

examples.en: Scholars needed decades to decipher the script on the ancient tablets.
examples.zh: 学者们花了几十年才破译古碑上的文字。

meaning: n. 企业联合, 辛迪加, 财团;v. 联合成辛迪加

examples.en: A national syndicate distributes the comic strip to hundreds of newspapers.
examples.zh: 一家全国性辛迪加向数百家报纸发行这部连环漫画。

meaning: n. 墨尔本

examples.en: She moved to Melbourne to study sound engineering.
examples.zh: 她搬到墨尔本学习音响工程。

meaning: a. 有效的, 显著的, 显露内心活动的

examples.en: The report's most telling detail was the missing signature page.
examples.zh: 报告中最能说明问题的细节是缺了签名页。

meaning: n. 游览;a. 游览的

examples.en: The string quartet is touring coastal cities throughout August.
examples.zh: 弦乐四重奏八月将在沿海城市巡演。

meaning: n. 打油诗文, 诙谐的模仿诗文, 拙劣的模仿;vt. 拙劣模仿, 作模仿诗文

examples.en: The sketch show's parody of news anchors went viral overnight.
examples.zh: 喜剧节目对新闻主播的滑仿一夜走红。

meaning: n. 缓冲器, 满杯;a. 大胜利的

examples.en: Timely rains promise a bumper grain harvest this autumn.
examples.zh: 及时的降雨预示今秋谷物大丰收。

meaning: n. 消耗, 耗尽, 放血;排除, 缺失(液体), 衰竭(由于缺液)

examples.en: Strict quotas slowed the depletion of the cod stocks.
examples.zh: 严格配额减缓了鳕鱼种群的消耗。

meaning: a. 公正的, 正义的, 正直的;正直的, 正当的, 正义的

examples.en: The villagers directed righteous anger at the polluting factory.
examples.zh: 村民们把义愤指向那家排污工厂。

meaning: n. 狂吼, 狂暴;v. 愤怒地说, 叫嚷, 咆哮

examples.en: Critics began to rave about the young director's debut film.
examples.zh: 评论家开始盛赞年轻导演的处女作。

meaning: a. 有益于...的, 有助于...的, 助长的

examples.en: Soft lighting and quiet corners are conducive to serious reading.
examples.zh: 柔和灯光与安静角落有利于专注阅读。

meaning: a. 装满的, 负载的, 苦恼的;lade的过去分词

examples.en: Trucks laden with relief supplies crossed the border at dawn.
examples.zh: 满载救援物资的卡车黎明越过边境。

meaning: n. 谈话, 演说;a. 讲话的, 适于说的, 讲某种语言的

examples.en: A short course in public speaking boosted her confidence at work.
examples.zh: 一期简短的演讲课增强了她的职场自信。

meaning: n. 蔓延, 风行一时, 超过限度;vt. 蔓延, 蹂躏, 超过, 泛滥

examples.en: The project's budget overrun forced the museum to postpone two galleries.
examples.zh: 项目预算超支迫使博物馆推迟两个展厅开放。

meaning: vt. 使发狂, 激怒;vi. 发狂, 发怒

examples.en: The endless hold music was enough to madden even patient callers.
examples.zh: 没完没了的等待音乐足以让再有耐心的人发疯。

meaning: n. 守卫, 门警, 管理人;幽门

examples.en: The janitor unlocks the gymnasium at six every morning.
examples.zh: 管理员每天早晨六点打开体育馆大门。

meaning: vt. 强制, 强迫

examples.en: The regulator says the firm tried to coerce farmers into exclusive contracts.
examples.zh: 监管机构称该公司企图胁迫农民签独家合同。

meaning: vt. 统治, 威压, 打败, 驳回;否决, 驳回, 批驳

examples.en: The appeals court can overrule the lower court's reading of the statute.
examples.zh: 上诉法院可推翻下级法院对法规的解读。

meaning: n. 论文, 专著

examples.en: The monk's treatise on herbs remained the standard text for three centuries.
examples.zh: 那位修士的草药论著作为标准读本沿用了三百年。

meaning: n. 旁观者, 袖手旁观者

examples.en: An onlooker called the coastguard the moment the kayak overturned.
examples.zh: 皮划艇一翻,一名旁观者立即呼叫海岸警卫队。

meaning: n. 兽医;兽医

examples.en: The veterinarian taught farmers a simple test for spoiled feed.
examples.zh: 兽医教农民一种检测饲料变质的简便方法。

meaning: n. 预兆, 前兆, 征兆;vt. 预示, 有...的前兆, 显出...的预兆

examples.en: Many saw the twin comets as an omen of great change.
examples.zh: 许多人把双彗星视作剧变的预兆。

meaning: vt. 逐出, 赶出, 驱逐;逐出, 驱逐, 没收

examples.en: A landlord cannot evict tenants without a court order.
examples.zh: 房东没有法院命令不得驱逐房客。

meaning: n. 怠工, 破坏活动, 破坏;vi. 从事破坏活动

examples.en: Investigators found no evidence of sabotage in the signal failure.
examples.zh: 调查人员未发现信号故障系蓄意破坏的证据。

meaning: a. 爱炫耀的, 虚夸的, 盛大的

examples.en: The pompous preface ran eighteen pages and said almost nothing.
examples.zh: 那篇自命不凡的序言长达十八页,却几乎言之无物。

meaning: n. 骚动, 暴乱;震荡

examples.en: A commotion outside the courtroom drew the reporters to the windows.
examples.zh: 法庭外的骚动把记者引到窗边。

meaning: n. 失败, 误送, 流产;流产

examples.en: The article examined a famous miscarriage of justice from the 1930s.
examples.zh: 文章剖析了上世纪三十年代一桩著名冤案。

meaning: n. 猛扑, 爪;vi. 猛扑, 突袭

examples.en: The editor was ready to pounce on any typo in the draft.
examples.zh: 编辑随时准备揪出草稿里的任何拼写错误。

meaning: n. 神经症患者;a. 神经质的, 神经症的

examples.en: Constant audits made the accountant neurotic about tiny discrepancies.
examples.zh: 频繁审计让这位会计对细小差错变得神经质。

meaning: n. 污点, 墨水渍;vt. 乱涂, 使模糊, 吸干

examples.en: A red blot spread across the page where the pen had leaked.
examples.zh: 钢笔漏水,红色污渍在纸上洇开。

meaning: n. 虔诚, 孝敬, 虔诚的行为

examples.en: The merchant's lavish donations were piety mixed with shrewd advertising.
examples.zh: 富商的慷慨捐献既是虔诚,也是精明炒作。

meaning: n. 转向, 弯曲, 背离;vi. 突然转向, 转弯, 背离

examples.en: Deer on the road can force a driver to swerve sharply.
examples.zh: 路上的鹿可能迫使司机猛打方向闪避。

meaning: n. 行为不良, 失职;毁约, 怠工, 旷职

examples.en: Youth delinquency fell after the city opened evening sports centers.
examples.zh: 市里开办晚间运动中心后,青少年不良行为减少。

meaning: vi. 从属于, 关于, 涉及, 附属, 适合, 相称;属于, 从属, 附属

examples.en: These older rules pertain only to vehicles registered before 1990.
examples.zh: 这些旧规定仅适用于1990年前注册的车辆。

meaning: n. 约会, 约会地点;v. 集合, 集结, 在约定场所会面

examples.en: The climbers set a rendezvous at the mountain hut before splitting up.
examples.zh: 登山者约定在小屋会合后分头行动。

meaning: n. 僵局, 停顿;v. (使)停顿, (使)相持不下

examples.en: Wage talks reached a deadlock after the union rejected the third offer.
examples.zh: 工会拒绝第三份方案后,工资谈判陷入僵局。

meaning: n. 阿拉斯加州

examples.en: Salmon runs in Alaska draw photographers from around the world.
examples.zh: 阿拉斯加的鲑鱼洄游吸引全球摄影师。

meaning: n. 一丝光线, 微光, 少许;vi. 发微光

examples.en: Rescuers saw a first glimmer of hope when the radio crackled.
examples.zh: 无线电响起杂音时,救援者看到一线希望。

meaning: n. 灾难, 不幸事件

examples.en: Drought and fire combined into a single calamity for the herders.
examples.zh: 旱灾与火灾交织,给牧民带来一场浩劫。

meaning: n. 控诉者, 指责者;原告, 指控人, 控告者

examples.en: The court heard the accuser's testimony behind closed doors.
examples.zh: 法院闭门听取了指控者的证词。

meaning: n. 悲观, 悲观情绪, 悲观主义;悲观主义

examples.en: Economists warned against deep pessimism about the region's recovery.
examples.zh: 经济学家提醒,不要对该地区复苏过度悲观。

meaning: n. 创办计划书, (内容)说明书, 内容简介;(募债)说明书

examples.en: Read the fund's prospectus carefully before you invest a single euro.
examples.zh: 投一分钱之前,请仔细阅读基金招募说明书。

meaning: n. 被接见者, 被采访者, 被面试者

examples.en: Each interviewee answered the same twelve questions in a quiet room.
examples.zh: 每位受访者在安静房间回答同样的十二个问题。

meaning: n. 皱痕, 折痕;v. (使)起皱痕

examples.en: He ironed a sharp crease into each trouser leg.
examples.zh: 他把每条裤腿熨出笔直裤线。

meaning: vt. 使湿透, 使充满;n. 滂沱大雨, 弄湿

examples.en: A wave over the seawall will drench anyone walking too close.
examples.zh: 海浪越过防波堤会浇湿靠得太近的行人。

meaning: n. 儿童照管；儿童保育

examples.en: Affordable childcare remains the biggest barrier for returning mothers.
examples.zh: 平价托育仍是妈妈们重返职场最大障碍。

meaning: a. 松的, 不严格的, 腹泻的, 松弛的;n. 腹泻, 松元音

examples.en: Investigators blamed lax screening for the counterfeit parts in the supply chain.
examples.zh: 调查人员把假件流入供应链归咎于把关松懈。

meaning: n. 辛苦, 苦工, 网, 罗网, 圈套;vi. 苦干, 跋涉

examples.en: Months of quiet toil produced a garden the whole street envied.
examples.zh: 数月默默耕耘换来整条街羡慕的花园。

meaning: a. 未说过的, 未透露的, 未加叙述的, 数不清的, 无限的, 不可计量的, 无数的;未说明的, 未方露的, 未说出的

examples.en: The flood caused untold damage to the valley's oldest farms.
examples.zh: 洪水给山谷最古老的农田造成难以估量的损失。

meaning: n. 泥沼, 泥泞;vt. 使陷于泥泞, 使陷入困境

examples.en: The negotiations sank deeper into a mire of mutual accusations.
examples.zh: 谈判在相互指责的泥潭中越陷越深。

meaning: n. 热烈欢迎, 大喝采, 小凯旋式

examples.en: The retiring conductor received a ten-minute standing ovation.
examples.zh: 退休指挥家获得十分钟全场起立鼓掌。

meaning: a. 语音的, 语音学的, 表示语音的, 语音差异的;语音的

examples.en: Learners use phonetic symbols to master unfamiliar vowel sounds.
examples.zh: 学习者借助音标掌握陌生的元音发音。

meaning: n. 喧嚣;v. 絮絮不休地说, 喧闹

examples.en: The din of jackhammers forced the lecture into another hall.
examples.zh: 手提钻的喧闹迫使讲座换到另一大厅。

meaning: n. 纪念物, 令人回忆的东西

examples.en: She kept the ticket stub as a memento of their first journey.
examples.zh: 她留下那张票根,作为初次旅行的纪念。

meaning: adv. 华丽地, 欢乐地

examples.en: The narrow streets were gaily decorated for the spring parade.
examples.zh: 窄街为春季游行装点得五彩缤纷。

meaning: n. 医疗保健；卫生保健；健康护理, 健康服务

examples.en: Rural healthcare depends heavily on a handful of visiting specialists.
examples.zh: 乡村医疗严重依赖少数巡回专家。

meaning: n. 增加, 增值, 盈余;增量

examples.en: Each increment of funding extended the monitoring program for another year.
examples.zh: 经费每增一档,监测项目便能再延一年。

meaning: n. 附言;PostScript页面描述语言

examples.en: The letter ended with a handwritten postscript about the coming visit.
examples.zh: 信末有一段关于即将到访的手写附言。

meaning: n. 主动表示, 事件的开端, 序言, 提议, 提案, 初步交涉;vt. 提议, 为...奏前奏曲

examples.en: The mayor's visit was an overture to the striking transit workers.
examples.zh: 市长到访是对罢工公交员工的和解示意。

meaning: n. 海盗行为, 海上劫掠, 剽窃, 著作权侵害, 非法翻印;海盗行为, 海上掠夺, 海盗罪

examples.en: Software piracy cost the studio millions in lost subscriptions.
examples.zh: 软件盗版使这家工作室损失数百万订阅费。

meaning: vt. 放气, 抽出空气, 使缩小;vi. 缩小

examples.en: A single leaky valve can deflate the whole air mattress in an hour.
examples.zh: 一个漏气阀门能让整张气垫床一小时内瘪掉。

meaning: vt. 追过, 胜过, 凌驾

examples.en: Demand for housing continues to outstrip supply in the capital.
examples.zh: 首都住房需求持续超过供给。

meaning: n. 最高声部, 三倍;a. 三倍的, 最高声部的

examples.en: Donations trebled after the charity's story aired on national television.
examples.zh: 慈善故事上了国家电视台后,捐款增至三倍。

meaning: n. 旅行, 旅行队, 科学考察

examples.en: A dawn safari offers the best chance to watch leopards hunting.
examples.zh: 清晨观兽之行最有机会看到花豹捕猎。

meaning: v. 劝诫, 忠告

examples.en: The coach continued to exhort the swimmers through the final lap.
examples.zh: 最后一段赛程,教练仍在为游泳选手呐喊鼓劲。

meaning: n. 体格, 体形;体格

examples.en: Years of rowing gave the quiet librarian a powerful physique.
examples.zh: 常年划船让这位安静的馆员体格强健。

meaning: a. 可憎的, 使人不愉快的, 令人讨厌的

examples.en: The forum bans users whose obnoxious comments drive others away.
examples.zh: 论坛封禁以恶劣言论气走他人的用户。

meaning: a. 斜的, 倾斜的, 间接的, 不光明正大的, 躲躲闪闪的;斜的

examples.en: Her oblique reference to the merger puzzled the reporters.
examples.zh: 她对合并一事的影射让记者困惑。

meaning: vt. 使附于, 署名, 粘贴, 盖印于;n. 附加物, 词缀

examples.en: Please affix a recent photograph to the top of the form.
examples.zh: 请在表格上方贴一张近期照片。

meaning: a. 破坏的；荒废的, 要塌似的

examples.en: The council bought a dilapidated theater and restored its 1920s interior.
examples.zh: 议会买下破败剧院,修复其上世纪二十年代内装。

meaning: n. 父亲身份, 父系血统, 创始人(身份), 来源, 出处;父权, 亲权; 父系

examples.en: The court ordered a paternity test as part of the custody case.
examples.zh: 作为监护权案的一环,法院下令做亲子鉴定。

meaning: n. 缺乏, 粮食不足, 饥馑

examples.en: A dearth of skilled welders is slowing the shipyard's recovery.
examples.zh: 熟练焊工短缺拖慢了船厂的复苏。

meaning: a. 共鸣的, 反响的, 洪亮的, 共振的;反响的, 叩响的, 共鸣的, 共振的

examples.en: The empty stairwell has a resonant acoustic that singers love.
examples.zh: 空荡楼梯间有着歌者喜爱的共鸣声学。

meaning: a. 被逐出的, 被遗弃的, 无家可归的;n. 被驱逐的人, 流浪者

examples.en: He felt like an outcast until the chess club welcomed him.
examples.zh: 象棋社接纳他之前,他自觉像个局外人。

meaning: n. 色调, 色彩, 气味, 气息;vt. 染, 使带气息

examples.en: The old film has a faint tinge of violet at the edges.
examples.zh: 这部老电影的边缘泛着淡淡紫色。

meaning: a. 腐败的, 脓毒性的;n. 引起腐败的物质

examples.en: The clinic sterilizes instruments to prevent septic infections after minor surgery.
examples.zh: 诊所给器械消毒,防止小手术后发生脓毒性感染。

meaning: n. 雨水

examples.en: Barrels under the eaves collect rainwater for the summer garden.
examples.zh: 屋檐下的水桶收雨水供夏日浇园。

meaning: a. 道歉的, 急于认错的, 辩护的;辩护的, 辩解的, 道歉的

examples.en: The gate agent sounded apologetic when announcing the third delay.
examples.zh: 地勤宣布第三次延误时语气满是歉意。

meaning: n. 爱好, 素质, 癖性, 天性, 倾向, 易感受性;素因, 素质

examples.en: The test shows only a predisposition, not a certain future illness.
examples.zh: 这项检测只显示易患倾向,并非必然患病。

meaning: n. 铆钉;vt. 用铆钉固定, 敲进去, 注目, 吸引住

examples.en: Every rivet on the bridge is checked for corrosion each spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天,桥上每颗铆钉都要查锈蚀。

meaning: n. 微光, 闪光;vi. 闪烁

examples.en: Heat made the empty highway shimmer in the distance.
examples.zh: 高温使空旷的公路在远处泛起波光。

meaning: n. 维持, 维修费;维修费, 养护费, 保养

examples.en: The upkeep of the cathedral consumes most of the parish budget.
examples.zh: 大教堂的维护耗去堂区预算大半。

meaning: a. 眼睛的, 视觉的, 光学的;n. 镜片

examples.en: The clinic bought new equipment for delicate optic nerve surgery.
examples.zh: 诊所购置了新设备用于精细的视神经手术。

meaning: n. 错误的观念(或信念), 谬见, 谬论;错觉, 幻觉, 虚妄

examples.en: The report exposes the fallacy that cheap fuel guarantees cheap food.
examples.zh: 报告揭穿了廉价燃料必保廉价食品的谬见。

meaning: n. 奥德赛(古希腊史诗)

examples.en: Their decade-long odyssey across three continents ended in a small coastal town.
examples.zh: 他们跨越三洲的十年漂泊终在滨海小镇落幕。

meaning: adv. 一件一件地, 逐个地, 零碎地;a. 一片一片的, 逐渐的, 零碎的

examples.en: Repairs were done piecemeal, so the roof never quite held.
examples.zh: 修修补补式的维修让屋顶始终不牢。

meaning: a. 狂热的, 发狂的, 疯的;interj. 呸, 胡说

examples.en: The bakery grinds its own nuts for the holiday cakes.
examples.zh: 面包房为节日糕点自己研磨坚果。

meaning: n. 唯利是图者, 雇佣兵;a. 为钱而工作的, 被雇的, 图利的

examples.en: The medieval city hired mercenary troops whenever its own militia shrank.
examples.zh: 自有民兵缩减时,这座中世纪城便雇雇佣军。

meaning: vt. 使成不毛, 使绝育, 杀菌, 使不起作用;灭菌, 消毒; 绝育

examples.en: Technicians sterilize the bottles with steam before filling them with juice.
examples.zh: 灌果汁之前,技师用蒸汽为瓶子消毒。

meaning: a. 发狂的, 癫狂的, 疯狂的;n. 狂人, 疯子

examples.en: He drove like a maniac to reach the airport before sunset.
examples.zh: 他开车如疯,想赶在日落前到机场。

meaning: a. 不能征服的, 无敌的

examples.en: The young squad felt invincible after its twenty-third straight win.
examples.zh: 连胜二十三场后,这支年轻队伍自觉不可战胜。

meaning: n. 公告, 布告, 小牌, 海报;vt. 公布, 布告, 张帖, 贴海报于

examples.en: Protesters carried a placard demanding cleaner river water.
examples.zh: 抗议者举着要求净化河水的标语牌。

meaning: a. 可磋商的, 可转让的, 可通行的;可流通的, 可转让的

examples.en: The asking price is negotiable, especially for a quick cash sale.
examples.zh: 要价可以商量,现金快购尤甚。

meaning: n. 解剖刀;vt. 用解剖刀切开

examples.en: The surgeon reached for the scalpel only after reviewing the scans.
examples.zh: 外科医生看完扫描才拿起手术刀。

meaning: n. 随身用具

examples.en: The attic held all the paraphernalia of a 1960s darkroom.
examples.zh: 阁楼里堆着上世纪六十年代暗房的全套家当。

meaning: 结肠, 冒号, 科朗;可乐果; 可乐果属; 可乐果干子叶

examples.en: He gave up cola and lost four kilograms by summer.
examples.zh: 他戒掉可乐,入夏瘦了四公斤。

meaning: n. 饮剂, 饮料, 一次饮用量, 一服, 一剂;饮剂

examples.en: In the folk tale, a magic potion puts the whole castle to sleep.
examples.zh: 民间故事里,一剂魔药让整座城堡沉睡。

meaning: a. 依字母顺序的, 字母的

examples.en: The seed catalog lists every variety in alphabetical order.
examples.zh: 种子目录按字母顺序列出所有品种。

meaning: a. 宽大的, 温和的, 慈悲为怀的;宽大的, 仁慈的

examples.en: The judge seemed unusually lenient given the driver's third offense.
examples.zh: 鉴于司机第三次违章,判决显得异常宽大。

meaning: a. 难以消除的, 不能拭除的, 难忘的

examples.en: Her year teaching abroad left an indelible mark on her writing.
examples.zh: 海外执教一年给她的写作留下深刻烙印。

meaning: a. 瘦削的, 憔悴的, 荒凉的

examples.en: The drought left the herd gaunt and the farmers anxious.
examples.zh: 旱灾使牛群瘦骨嶙峋,农民忧心忡忡。

meaning: n. 淘气鬼, 顽童

examples.en: Sea urchin roe is a prized delicacy in coastal sushi bars.
examples.zh: 海胆黄是沿海寿司店的名贵美味。

meaning: vi. 振动, 彷徨, 犹豫;vt. 使振动, 使动摇

examples.en: The needle will oscillate wildly until the sensor is properly grounded.
examples.zh: 传感器正确接地前,指针会剧烈摆动。

meaning: n. 上部构造, 上层建筑;超结构

examples.en: Engineers reinforced the bridge's superstructure before the heavier trams could run.
examples.zh: 更重电车通行前,工程师加固了桥梁上部结构。

meaning: vt. 使斜靠;vi. 靠, 斜倚, 依赖

examples.en: Passengers may recline their seats only after the seatbelt sign goes off.
examples.zh: 安全带灯熄灭后,乘客方可调倒椅背。

meaning: n. 假名, 笔名;笔名, 假名

examples.en: The novelist published her first three books under a pseudonym.
examples.zh: 这位小说家前三本书都以笔名出版。

meaning: a. 海上的, 航海的, 船员的

examples.en: The museum displays nautical instruments from the age of sail.
examples.zh: 博物馆陈列着帆船时代的航海仪器。

meaning: n. 前情, 先行词;a. 先前的, 先行的

examples.en: Historians trace the charter's antecedent to a medieval trade guild.
examples.zh: 历史学家把宪章的雏形追溯到中世纪行会。

meaning: vt. 不如实地叙述(或说明), 不称职地代表

examples.en: The broker was fined for trying to misrepresent the fund's risks.
examples.zh: 经纪人因企图歪曲基金风险而被罚款。

meaning: n. 大洪水, 泛滥;vt. 使泛滥

examples.en: The office faced a deluge of applications after the fee waiver.
examples.zh: 免费政策一出,办公室申请如潮涌来。

meaning: n. 汇款;汇款, 寄款, 支付(金额)

examples.en: Each month the worker sends a remittance home to his parents.
examples.zh: 工人每月给父母寄一笔汇款。

meaning: n. 否定, 反面, 不存在;否定, 否认

examples.en: The new policy is the negation of everything the union fought for.
examples.zh: 新政策是对工会多年主张的全盘否定。

meaning: a. 适合的, 一致的, 合谐的, 全等的

examples.en: The witness's account was congruent with the timeline from the phone records.
examples.zh: 证人的说法与通话记录时间线相符。

meaning: a. 无力偿还的, 破产的;n. 无力偿还者, 破产者

examples.en: The builder was declared insolvent, leaving a housing estate half finished.
examples.zh: 建筑商被宣告破产,住宅区只建一半。

meaning: n. 专类辞典, 宝库, 知识宝库, 叙词表, 主题词表;同义词, 同义词典

examples.en: A thesaurus helps, but exact words still come from wide reading.
examples.zh: 同义词词典有用,精准措辞仍靠广泛阅读。

meaning: vi. 懒散地闲荡, 垂下头, 伸舌;vt. 垂, 伸, 靠着

examples.en: In August the harbor seals loll on the rocks all afternoon.
examples.zh: 八月里斑海豹整下午懒洋洋趴在礁石上。

meaning: a. 无言的, 沉默的, 不情愿的;言不尽意的, 沈默寡言的, 有保留的

examples.en: The normally reticent engineer spoke boldly at the safety hearing.
examples.zh: 一贯寡言的工程师在安全听证会上直言。

meaning: n. 软毛, 柔毛, 绒毛, 错误, 无价值的东西;vi. 起毛, 变松, 出错

examples.en: Remove the fluff from the dryer filter after every load.
examples.zh: 每烘一机衣物都要清理烘干机滤网绒毛。

meaning: n. 罪行, 犯罪;不端行为, 犯罪, 恶性

examples.en: The archives revealed a forgotten misdeed by a respected founding trustee.
examples.zh: 档案披露了受人尊敬的创始受托人一桩旧恶行。

meaning: n. 霉;vi. 发霉, 生霉

examples.en: Wipe the leaves weekly, or mildew will spread across the squash vines.
examples.zh: 每周擦叶,否则霉斑会爬满南瓜藤。

meaning: n. 伤感力, 感伤, 悲怅, 同情, 偶然因素, 哀婉动人的词句

examples.en: The documentary captures the pathos of a village losing its young people.
examples.zh: 纪录片捕捉到村庄年轻人流失的哀伤。

meaning: n. 棚屋

examples.en: Refugees built a shanty settlement along the flooded railway embankment.
examples.zh: 难民沿被淹的铁轨路基搭起棚户区。

meaning: n. 丘疹, 小脓疱;丘疹, 小脓疱

examples.en: The pharmacist recommended a mild soap for the pimples on his chin.
examples.zh: 药师推荐了一块温和香皂对付他下巴的粉刺。

meaning: n. 反射比;反射本领

examples.en: The lab measures the reflectance of each paint sample under summer sun.
examples.zh: 实验室测量每种漆样在夏日阳光下的反射率。

meaning: n. 美好, 准确, 精密, 拘泥细节, 纤细

examples.en: The negotiation turned on a nicety of contract language.
examples.zh: 谈判成败系于合同措辞的细微差别。

meaning: a. 可察觉的, 能感觉得到的, 看得见的

examples.en: There was a perceptible drop in noise once the new rails were laid.
examples.zh: 新轨铺好后,噪音明显降低。

meaning: vi. 搭便车;vt. 要求(搭便车)

examples.en: Students often hitchhike between festival stages despite the shuttle buses.
examples.zh: 虽有接驳车,学生仍常在音乐节舞台间搭顺风车。

meaning: n. 悬崖, 绝壁, 险境

examples.en: The firm stood on the precipice of bankruptcy before the rescue loan.
examples.zh: 获得救急贷款前,公司濒临破产边缘。

meaning: a. 悲哀的, 哀伤的, 伤心的, 表示痛苦的

examples.en: The lost dog's plaintive howls echoed through the empty streets.
examples.zh: 迷路狗的哀嚎回荡在空街。

meaning: n. (总称)浮游生物;浮游生物

examples.en: Warmer seas are pushing plankton blooms steadily toward the poles.
examples.zh: 海水变暖正把浮游生物水华推向两极。

meaning: n. 仓库, 储藏所, 宝库;库房, 贮藏库, 仓库

examples.en: The cellar serves as a storehouse for the farm's seed potatoes each winter.
examples.zh: 地窖每年冬天存放农场的种薯。

meaning: vt. 违反, 犯罪, 侵犯;vi. 越界, 违法

examples.en: The code clearly states which practices transgress professional boundaries.
examples.zh: 准则明确列出哪些行为逾越职业界限。

meaning: n. 簿记员;簿记员, 记帐员

examples.en: The bookkeeper spotted the duplicate invoice within an hour.
examples.zh: 簿记员一小时内就发现了重复发票。

meaning: n. 无, 零;a. 无价值的, 无用的

examples.en: All their careful planning came to naught in the storm.
examples.zh: 他们周密的筹划在风暴中化为乌有。

meaning: n. 排泄, 大便;粪便

examples.en: Tests on the seals' excrement revealed high levels of mercury.
examples.zh: 海豹粪便检测显示汞含量偏高。

meaning: n. 尸体, 架子

examples.en: Scavengers had reduced the carcase to clean bones before nightfall.
examples.zh: 天黑前,食腐动物已把尸骸啃剩白骨。

meaning: a. 颗粒的, 粒状的;粒状的, 颗粒状的

examples.en: The new sensors give a granular picture of air quality street by street.
examples.zh: 新传感器能逐街呈现精细的空气质量图景。

meaning: a. 难看的, 不优雅的, 粗陋的

examples.en: On land the seal is an ungainly lump, yet it glides underwater.
examples.zh: 海豹在陆上笨拙,水下却灵巧滑行。

meaning: n. 镊子

examples.en: Use clean tweezers to remove the splinter from his palm.
examples.zh: 用干净镊子拔出他掌心的木刺。

meaning: vt. 把...遣返;vi. 回国

examples.en: The museum agreed to repatriate the bronzes to their country of origin.
examples.zh: 博物馆同意把青铜器归还原属国。

meaning: n. 运动装, 休闲服

examples.en: The sportswear brand now weaves fishing-net waste into its shoes.
examples.zh: 这个运动服品牌现在用废弃渔网织鞋。

meaning: n. 微生物学;微生物学

examples.en: She lectures in microbiology and studies antibiotic resistance in soil bacteria.
examples.zh: 她讲授微生物学,研究土壤细菌耐药性。

meaning: a. 宽宏大量的, 有雅量的;气量大的, 宽大的, 高尚的

examples.en: The champion was magnanimous in praising her defeated rival's courage.
examples.zh: 冠军大度称赞落败对手的勇气。

meaning: n. 马金托什防水布, 马金托什雨衣;防水胶布; 胶布雨衣

examples.en: The fisherman buttoned his mackintosh against the horizontal rain.
examples.zh: 渔夫扣紧雨衣,抵挡横扫的暴雨。

meaning: a. 表面的, 假装的, 看得出的;表面的, 诡称的

examples.en: His ostensible reason was the weather, though everyone knew about the audition.
examples.zh: 他表面理由是天气,大家却都知道他要试镜。

meaning: n. 海草, 巨藻, 海草灰;海藻

examples.en: Sea otters wrap themselves in kelp so they will not drift while sleeping.
examples.zh: 海獭睡觉时用海带缠身以免漂走。

meaning: n. 小费, 赠物, 赏钱;小帐, 赏金, 退职金

examples.en: The invoice includes a service charge, so no extra gratuity is expected.
examples.zh: 账单已含服务费,无需另付小费。

meaning: n. 光秃, 率直, 枯燥;秃, 脱发

examples.en: He jokes about his baldness but quietly tried two treatments.
examples.zh: 他拿秃顶打趣,私下却试过两种疗法。

meaning: n. 动物学, 动物区系;动物学

examples.en: Her zoology fieldwork follows a family of meerkats across the Kalahari.
examples.zh: 她的动物学野外调查追踪喀拉哈里的一群猫鼬。

meaning: a. 尊敬的, 虔诚的

examples.en: Visitors keep a reverent silence inside the memorial hall.
examples.zh: 纪念堂内,参观者满怀敬意保持肃静。

meaning: n. 长方形, 长椭圆形;a. 长方形的, 长椭圆形的

examples.en: The carpenter cut an oblong skylight to brighten the narrow stairwell.
examples.zh: 木匠开了长方形天窗照亮狭窄楼梯间。

meaning: n. 困惑, 混乱状态, 使人困惑的事物

examples.en: She stared at the wiring diagram in complete perplexity.
examples.zh: 她满腹困惑地盯着接线图。

meaning: n. 麻疯病, 腐败;麻风

examples.en: Leprosy is now curable, yet the stigma has outlived the bacteria.
examples.zh: 麻风病如今可治,污名却比病菌更顽固。

meaning: a. 流星的, 疾速的, 大气的

examples.en: The reporter's meteoric rise from intern to editor took four years.
examples.zh: 这名记者从实习生成主编仅用四年。

meaning: n. 缩影胶卷;v. 缩微拍摄

examples.en: The archive stores old newspapers on microfilm to save space.
examples.zh: 档案馆用缩微胶卷存旧报以省空间。

meaning: n. 懒惰的人, 玩忽职守者, 旷课者;a. 偷懒的, 旷课的, 游荡的

examples.en: The school hired a counselor after truant numbers doubled in a term.
examples.zh: 一学期逃学人数翻倍,学校遂聘辅导员。

meaning: vt. 补充, 增加

examples.en: Villagers eke out a living from small plots of beans and maize.
examples.zh: 村民靠小块豆田和玉米地勉强糊口。

meaning: n. 卧室兼起居室;vt. 租用卧室兼起居室

examples.en: As a student she lived in a tiny bedsit above a bakery.
examples.zh: 求学时她住在面包店楼上的小单间。

meaning: v. 误解

examples.en: Critics say the ministry has misconceived what rural patients actually need.
examples.zh: 批评者称部委误解了乡村患者的真实需求。

meaning: n. 结婚, 婚姻生活, 婚礼;婚姻, 结婚, 婚礼

examples.en: After fifty years of matrimony, they still walk the shore each morning.
examples.zh: 结婚五十年,他们仍每天清晨沿海岸散步。

meaning: vi. 蹒跚地走, 摇摇晃晃地走, 摇晃不稳;n. 蹒跚

examples.en: The extras had to shamble convincingly down the abandoned street.
examples.zh: 群演须逼真地拖着脚走过废弃街道。

meaning: a. 可航行的, 可通船的, 适于航行的;可航行的, 可通航的

examples.en: Dredging kept the channel navigable for grain barges all summer.
examples.zh: 疏浚使航道整个夏季可供粮驳通行。

meaning: vt. 作成花圈, 环绕, 盘绕, 使笼罩;vi. 扭曲, 成圈, 缭绕

examples.en: Cold mist seemed to wreathe the pond at first light.
examples.zh: 破晓时分,寒雾仿佛缭绕在池塘上。

meaning: pl. 孩子, 孩子们

examples.en: The children collected shells while their parents pitched the tent.
examples.zh: 父母搭帐篷时,孩子们在捡贝壳。

meaning: n. 沥青;沥青; 石油沥青

examples.en: The road crew sprayed hot bitumen before laying fresh gravel.
examples.zh: 养路队先喷热沥青再铺新碎石。

meaning: n. 墙手球, 墙手球运动

examples.en: The gym reserves Friday evenings for handball and volleyball clubs.
examples.zh: 体育馆周五晚间留给手球和排球俱乐部。

meaning: a. 精明的, 明智的, 策略的

examples.en: The mayor thought it politic to praise both rival bids publicly.
examples.zh: 市长认为公开称赞两个竞标方是明智之举。

meaning: n. 睡意;倦睡, 瞌睡

examples.en: The label warns that drowsiness may follow each dose of the syrup.
examples.zh: 标签提示每剂糖浆服后可能引起困倦。

meaning: a. 出生的, 诞生的;分娩的, 生产的; 臀的

examples.en: Nurses make home visits to support safe natal care in remote villages.
examples.zh: 护士上门服务,支持偏远乡村的安全分娩。

meaning: n. 摄影新闻工作, 摄影报道

examples.en: She studied photojournalism and now documents vanishing crafts across Asia.
examples.zh: 她学新闻摄影,如今记录亚洲濒危手艺。

meaning: v. 剽窃, 抄袭

examples.en: Two students failed the course for attempting to plagiarize an online essay.
examples.zh: 两名学生因抄袭网上文章而课程不及格。

meaning: n. 撇号, 呼语法

examples.en: The sign painter forgot the apostrophe in the word 'Teacher's'.
examples.zh: 招牌师傅漏写了表示所有格的那个撇号。

meaning: n. 公证人;公证人, 公证员

examples.en: The notary verified both signatures before sealing the deed.
examples.zh: 公证人核验两处签名后为契据用印。

meaning: a. 存在的, 生存的, 现存的;生存者

examples.en: Only three existent copies of the map survive in private collections.
examples.zh: 此图仅存的三份原本都在私人藏家手中。

meaning: vi. 东倒西歪地走, 蹒跚学步, 溜达;n. 东倒西歪的走路, 蹒跚

examples.en: Grandfather lets his grandson toddle along the garden path each evening.
examples.zh: 每晚爷爷让小孙子在花园小径上蹒跚学步。

meaning: n. 潜望镜(镜头);潜望镜

examples.en: The captain raised the periscope for a quick look at the convoy.
examples.zh: 船长升起潜望镜速览护航船队。

meaning: a. 粘液的, 粘的, 粘液性的;粘液的

examples.en: Warm steam soothes the mucous membranes of the nose and throat.
examples.zh: 温热蒸汽能舒缓鼻腔与咽喉黏膜。

meaning: a. 过分劳累的, 过度紧张的, 神经质的, 过度兴奋的, 过分推敲的, 不自然的

examples.en: After seventy hours without sleep, the residents were overwrought and snappish.
examples.zh: 七十小时不眠后,住院医师焦躁易怒。

meaning: n. 虚饰, 虚有其表, 卖弄

examples.en: Their charity is quiet, performed without ostentation or press releases.
examples.zh: 他们的慈善低调,不事张扬也不发通稿。

meaning: n. 瞌睡;vi. 打瞌睡

examples.en: Grandfather would drowse over his crossword by three every afternoon.
examples.zh: 祖父每天下午三点便对着填字游戏打盹。

meaning: a. 非社会的, 厌恶社交的, 不喜交际的, 孤僻的

examples.en: Nurses receive extra pay for working unsocial hours at night.
examples.zh: 护士夜间非常规时段工作可获额外津贴。

meaning: n. 手铐, 束缚;vt. 给...上手铐, 束缚

examples.en: The museum displays a rusted manacle from an eighteenth-century slave fort.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出十八世纪奴隶堡留下的锈镣。

meaning: n. 男女同校

examples.en: The college moved to coeducation in the 1970s and doubled its applicant pool.
examples.zh: 该校上世纪七十年代改男女同校,申请翻倍。

meaning: a. 不愿意的, 厌恶的

examples.en: Though loth to borrow, the farmer finally approached the credit union.
examples.zh: 农夫虽不愿借贷,最终还是找了信贷联盟。

meaning: n. 反义词

examples.en: Ask learners to give the antonym of every adjective on the list.
examples.zh: 让学习者说出清单上每个形容词的反义词。

meaning: (某个题目或学科的)推荐书目, 书单

examples.en: The professor posted the spring booklist a month before term began.
examples.zh: 教授开学前一个月就公布了春季书单。

meaning: v. 指挥, 管理, 监督

examples.en: The head gardener will superintend the restoration of the walled garden.
examples.zh: 首席园丁将督修围墙花园的修复。

meaning: vt. 输血, 充满;输血, 输液

examples.en: Doctors must match blood types carefully before they transfuse any patient.
examples.zh: 输血前,医生必须仔细配对血型。

meaning: n. 不幸, 灾难

examples.en: By some mischance, the invitation was addressed to the wrong street.
examples.zh: 不知何故,请柬误寄到了别的街。

meaning: 数学的

examples.en: Her mathematic instincts caught the ledger error at once.
examples.zh: 她的数学直觉立刻察觉账目有误。

meaning: a. 不适当的, 不熟练的

examples.en: His closing joke was inapt for such a solemn memorial service.
examples.zh: 在肃穆的追思会上,他的收尾笑话不得体。

meaning: n. 档案, 档案室;公文档案, 案卷, 档案保管处

examples.en: Researchers traced the land grant in the county archives.
examples.zh: 研究人员在县档案馆查到那份土地授予文书。

meaning: n. 法官；乐队

examples.en: Brass bands led the union marchers through the old mining town.
examples.zh: 铜管乐队领着工会队伍穿过老矿区镇。

meaning: n. 音乐节拍；差拍振动；心脏跳动（beat的复数）

examples.en: The producer layered live drums over the track's electronic beats.
examples.zh: 制作人在电子节拍上叠了真鼓。

meaning: n. 骨骼, 尸体

examples.en: Archaeologists sorted the bones of three separate burials in the trench.
examples.zh: 考古人员在探沟内分拣三处墓葬的骸骨。

meaning: n. 小册子( brochure的名词复数 ); （某地、某旅馆等的）情况介绍手册; （印成小册子的）论文

examples.en: The tourist office stocks brochures for every walking trail in the region.
examples.zh: 游客中心备有本地区各条步道的宣传册。

meaning: n. 咖啡馆, 小餐厅( cafe的名词复数 ); 洞穴( cave的名词复数 )

examples.en: Guided boats enter the sea caves only at low tide.
examples.zh: 带导游的船仅在退潮时进入海蚀洞。

meaning: n. 证明书, 执照( certificate的名词复数 )

examples.en: The evening course awards certificates recognized by the hotel industry.
examples.zh: 夜间课程的证书获酒店业认可。

meaning: n. （同班）同学( classmate的名词复数 ); 砚兄砚弟

examples.en: Former classmates gathered to repaint the rural school they once attended.
examples.zh: 昔日同窗重聚,为母校乡村学校重刷墙面。

meaning: a. 合作的；有协作精神的；愿意配合的; 齐心协力的；合作进行的;n. 合作社；合作机构

examples.en: The dairy co-operative pays farmers on the first Monday of each month.
examples.zh: 这家乳业合作社每月第一个周一向农户结款。

meaning: n. （电台或电视播放的）广告 ( commercial的名词复数 ); 以大众欣赏为目的谱写的乐曲

examples.en: Radio commercials for the farmers market air every half hour.
examples.zh: 农贸市场的电台广告每半小时播一次。

meaning: n. （尤指由政府或雇主给予的）特许权( concession的名词复数 ); 承认; 减价; （在某地的）特许经营权

examples.en: The union won concessions on rest breaks after three days of talks.
examples.zh: 三天谈判后,工会在工休方面赢得让步。

meaning: n. 目录;目录

examples.en: Check the contents of each box against the packing slip.
examples.zh: 逐箱对照装箱单核对箱内物品。

meaning: n. 契约( contract的名词复数 ); 婚约; 契约法; 行贿

examples.en: The city awards paving contracts only to firms with clean safety records.
examples.zh: 该市只把铺路合同授予安全记录良好的公司。

meaning: n. 灾难；窗帘（curtain的复数）

examples.en: Thick curtains keep the afternoon heat out of the nursery.
examples.zh: 厚窗帘挡住照进婴儿房的午后热浪。

meaning: n. 困难( difficulty的名词复数 ); 难度; 难事; 麻烦

examples.en: Students with reading difficulties get extra sessions with a specialist.
examples.zh: 有阅读障碍的学生可获得专家加课辅导。

meaning: n. 辩论( dispute的名词复数 ); 争端; （劳资）纠纷; 罢工;v. 辩论, 争论( dispute的第三人称单数 ); 争夺; 阻止; 就…进行辩

examples.en: Disputes over fence lines occupy much of the parish council's time.
examples.zh: 界栅纠纷占了堂区议会大量时间。

meaning: n. 下降, 减少

examples.en: The library added a drop-off box for returns beside the car park.
examples.zh: 图书馆在停车场旁增设还书投放箱。

meaning: 漏失信息; 丢"1"

examples.en: Mentoring halved the drop-out rate across the district's high schools.
examples.zh: 导师制使全区高中辍学率减半。

meaning: n. 活力( energy的名词复数 ); （原子、电、辐射的）能; 精力; （有效地发挥的）力量

examples.en: The charity now directs its energies toward winter shelter for the homeless.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构如今把精力投向流浪者过冬庇护。

meaning: n. 实验( experiment的名词复数 ); 试验; 尝试; 实践

examples.en: Simple experiments with vinegar and baking soda delighted the young scouts.
examples.zh: 醋加小苏打的简单实验让童子军兴高采烈。

meaning: pl. 脚;n. 尺

examples.en: The hikers soaked their sore feet in the cold mountain stream.
examples.zh: 徒步者把酸痛的双脚泡进冰冷山溪。

meaning: n. 渡船( ferry的名词复数 ); 渡口; 摆渡; 飞机渡运;v. 运送( ferry的第三人称单数 ); （乘渡船）渡过（河等）; 渡运飞机; 摆渡,

examples.en: Cross-river ferries run every twenty minutes until midnight.
examples.zh: 过江轮渡每二十分钟一班直到午夜。

meaning: a. 急救的

examples.en: Every coach must hold a current first-aid certificate.
examples.zh: 每位教练都须持有效的急救证书。

meaning: n. 楼地面；地板；楼层；层数（floor的复数）

examples.en: Staff polished the marble floors before the gala opened.
examples.zh: 晚会开始前,员工擦亮大理石地面。

meaning: n. 繁荣

examples.en: Historians trace the town's brief flourishment to the canal trade of the 1830s.
examples.zh: 历史学家把小镇短暂的繁荣归于十九世纪三十年代运河贸易。

meaning: n. 化石( fossil的名词复数 ); 老顽固; 食古不化的人; 老古董（老人）

examples.en: The cliffs yield fresh marine fossils after every winter storm.
examples.zh: 每次冬季风暴过后,悬崖都会露出新的海洋化石。

meaning: n. <美>毕业生( graduate的名词复数 ); <英>大学毕业生; （已经取得学士学位正在攻读高级学位的）研究生; 量筒;v. 渐变( graduate

examples.en: Nursing graduates increasingly choose community clinics over hospital wards.
examples.zh: 护理毕业生越来越多选社区诊所而非医院病房。

meaning: n. 身份( identity的名词复数 ); 同一性; 个性; 同一人

examples.en: The fraud ring stole identities through fake rental listings online.
examples.zh: 诈骗团伙借网上假租房信息盗取身份。

meaning: n. 调查( inquiry的名词复数 ); 疑问; 探究; 打听

examples.en: The hotline fields inquiries about visas from dawn to midnight.
examples.zh: 热线从清晨到午夜受理签证咨询。

meaning: n. 接见( interview的名词复数 ); 采访; 面谈; 会谈;v. 面试( interview的第三人称单数 ); 访问; 会见; （私下）提问

examples.en: The reporter recorded interviews with fishermen along the whole coast.
examples.zh: 记者沿海岸线录下对渔民的采访。

meaning: n. 工作（job的复数形式）

examples.en: Summer jobs at the cannery pay for next term's books.
examples.zh: 罐头厂的暑期工钱够下学期书本费。

meaning: n. 千克( kilogram的名词复数 )

examples.en: The suitcase weighed three kilograms over the airline's limit.
examples.zh: 行李箱超重航空公司限额三公斤。

meaning: n. 功课( lesson的名词复数 ); 课程; 教训; 一堂课

examples.en: Swimming lessons at the lido begin every June morning.
examples.zh: 露天泳池的游泳课每年六月清晨开班。

meaning: n. （供食用的）家畜的肺脏；灯光（light的复数）

examples.en: Harbor lights guided the fleet home through the fog.
examples.zh: 港湾灯火引船队在雾中归航。

meaning: 低危的, 低风险的

examples.en: Treasurers moved the endowment into low-risk bonds before the downturn.
examples.zh: 财务主管在下行前把基金转入低风险债券。

meaning: n. 上午十时左右

examples.en: By midmorning the bakery had sold out of rye bread.
examples.zh: 到上午十点,面包房的黑麦面包已售罄。

meaning: n. 电影

examples.en: The youth club screens classic movies on the library lawn.
examples.zh: 青年俱乐部在图书馆草坪放映经典电影。

meaning: n. 不喝酒的人, 戒酒的人

examples.en: As a committed non-drinker, he toasts with sparkling apple juice.
examples.zh: 作为坚定的不饮酒者,他举杯只喝气泡苹果汁。

meaning: n. 目标( objective的名词复数 ); （望远镜、显微镜、照相机及其他光学仪器上的）物镜; 1)。 宾语 2)。 宾格; 出击目标

examples.en: The retreat clarified the team's objectives for the coming year.
examples.zh: 研讨营明确了团队来年目标。

meaning: n. 机会( opportunity的名词复数 ); 适当的时机; 条件; 就业（或晋升、进步等）的良机

examples.en: Internships open opportunities that grades alone cannot provide.
examples.zh: 实习带来成绩单给不了的机会。

meaning: n. 乘客( passenger的名词复数 ); 旅客; 白吃饭的人; 闲散人员

examples.en: Stranded passengers slept in the terminal during the snow shutdown.
examples.zh: 大雪停运期间,滞留旅客睡在航站楼。

meaning: n. 影印本( photocopy的名词复数 ); 复印件

examples.en: The clerk keeps photocopies of every permit issued since 1998.
examples.zh: 书记员留存1998年以来所有许可证复印件。

meaning: n. 磅, 英镑；重击（pound复数形式）

examples.en: He lost fifteen pounds walking the coast path all summer.
examples.zh: 整个夏天走海岸步道,他减重十五磅。

meaning: n. 预防措施( precaution的名词复数 ); 防备; 避孕措施

examples.en: Fire drills remind residents of precautions during the dry season.
examples.zh: 消防演习提醒居民旱季防范事项。

meaning: n. 先( priority的名词复数 ); 优先; 优先权; 优先考虑的事

examples.en: A new mayor means new priorities for the capital budget.
examples.zh: 新市长上任,资本预算优先级随之改变。

meaning: n. 奖赏( prize的名词复数 ); 值得竞争的东西; 难能可贵的事物; 难以争取的重要事物;v. 珍视, 珍惜( prize的第三人称单数 )

examples.en: The fair's prizes went to the largest pumpkin and best jam.
examples.zh: 集市的奖项颁给了最大南瓜和最佳果酱。

meaning: n. 语言心理学

examples.en: Psycholinguistics examines how the brain stores and retrieves words.
examples.zh: 心理语言学研究大脑如何存取词语。

meaning: a. 纯的( pure的最高级 ); 单纯的; 纯真的; 干净的

examples.en: The silicon lab requires the purest water available.
examples.zh: 硅实验室需要现有最纯净的水。

meaning: n. 裁判员( referee的名词复数 ); 证明人; 公断人; （专业性强的文章的）审阅人

examples.en: The league trains young referees at a weekend clinic each August.
examples.zh: 联盟每年八月办周末班培训年轻裁判。

meaning: n. <律>（尤指离婚案的）被告( respondent的名词复数 ); 回答问题的人, （尤指）调查对象

examples.en: Nearly all respondents favored longer opening hours at the library.
examples.zh: 几乎所有受访者赞成图书馆延长开放。

meaning: n. 饭店( restaurant的名词复数 ); 餐馆; 饭馆; 菜馆

examples.en: Waterfront restaurants fill quickly on summer race weekends.
examples.zh: 夏季赛事周末,滨水餐厅很快满座。

meaning: n. 自卫, 自卫术, 自卫权;自卫, 正当防卫

examples.en: The college offers a self-defense course every fall term.
examples.zh: 学院每年秋季学期开设防身课程。

meaning: n. 自我训练, 自我修养, 自律;自律, 自我约束, 自我修养

examples.en: Learning an instrument teaches patience and self-discipline alike.
examples.zh: 学乐器既练耐心也练自律。

meaning: n. 判决, 宣判; 句子（ sentence的名词复数 ）;v. 宣判, 判决（ sentence的第三人称单数 ）

examples.en: The textbook draws its example sentences from real newspaper articles.
examples.zh: 教科书的例句取自真实报刊文章。

meaning: n. 匙, 调羹( spoon的名词复数 ); 一匙的量

examples.en: Carved wooden spoons sold out at the craft fair.
examples.zh: 手雕木勺在手工市集销售一空。

meaning: n. (英)运动会, 运动的, 适用于运动的, 运动会的, 与运动会有关的

examples.en: Local sports clubs share the stadium's new floodlit pitch.
examples.zh: 本地体育俱乐部共用体育场新灯光球场。

meaning: n. 药片( tablet的名词复数 ); （木、竹）简; 碑; 一块肥皂

examples.en: Take two tablets daily with food until the course is finished.
examples.zh: 每日随餐服两片,直至疗程结束。

meaning: pl. 牙齿;牙

examples.en: Hockey players wear mouthguards to protect their teeth in matches.
examples.zh: 冰球选手比赛中戴护齿保护牙齿。

meaning: n. 威胁, 恐吓( threat的名词复数 ); 可能造成威胁的人; 恶兆, 兆头

examples.en: The MP referred the online threats to the police at once.
examples.zh: 议员立即把网上威胁言论移交警方。

meaning: n. 旅行者, 观光客( tourist的名词复数 )

examples.en: Tourists gather at the fish auction every morning before sunrise.
examples.zh: 游客每天日出前聚到鱼类拍卖场。

meaning: n. 隧道, 地道( tunnel的名词复数 ); （动物栖息的）穴

examples.en: The disused railway tunnels now shelter a mushroom farm.
examples.zh: 废弃铁路隧道如今成了蘑菇农场。

meaning: n. 大学( university的名词复数 )

examples.en: The two universities share a marine station on the rocky peninsula.
examples.zh: 两所大学在多岩半岛合用海洋站。

meaning: a. 熟练的, 精通的

examples.en: Well versed in dialects, the interpreter calmed the frightened travelers.
examples.zh: 译员通晓方言,安抚了惊慌的旅客。

meaning: n. 签证( visa的名词复数 )

examples.en: Processing times for student visas doubled after the new rules.
examples.zh: 新规出台后,学生签证办理时间翻倍。

meaning: n. 义务工作者( volunteer的名词复数 ); 志愿者; 自告奋勇者; 主动做某事的人;v. 自动提供, 自愿效劳( volunteer的第三人称单数

examples.en: Volunteers replanted the dune grass after the winter storms.
examples.zh: 冬季风暴后,志愿者补种沙丘草。

meaning: n. 水钟, 滴漏

examples.en: Visitors watch a replica water-clock measure time drop by drop.
examples.zh: 游客观看水钟复制品逐滴计量时间。

meaning: n. 丧服

examples.en: Every June Saturday, volunteers pull weeds from the castle moat.
examples.zh: 每年六月的周六,志愿者清理城堡护城河杂草。

meaning: n. 鲸, 鲸鱼( whale的名词复数 )

examples.en: Whales pass close to the headland during their autumn migration.
examples.zh: 秋季迁徙时,鲸鱼贴近海角游过。

meaning: n. 旋转；车轮（wheel的复数）

examples.en: The old tram's steel wheels hum over the cobbled street.
examples.zh: 老电车的钢轮碾过鹅卵石街嗡嗡作响。

meaning: 伍伦贡

examples.en: He commutes by train from Wollongong to his Sydney office.
examples.zh: 他乘火车从卧龙岗去悉尼上班。

meaning: n. 专题讨论会( workshop的名词复数 ); 车间; 工作坊; 研究会

examples.en: The festival's workshops teach printing, bookbinding, and paper marbling.
examples.zh: 艺术节工坊教授印刷、装订和大理石纹纸。

meaning: n. 无花果, 无价值的东西, 少许, 服装;vt. 打扮, 使马跑快

examples.en: A fig tree shades the courtyard of the old library.
examples.zh: 一棵无花果树荫蔽老图书馆的庭院。

meaning: a. 法令的, 法定的, 可依法惩处的;法定的

examples.en: Statutory notice periods protect tenants from sudden eviction.
examples.zh: 法定通知期保护租客免遭突然驱逐。

meaning: a. 回答的, 应答的, 反射的;n. 应答者, 被告

examples.en: Each respondent rated the service on a five-point scale.
examples.zh: 每位受访者按五分制为服务打分。

meaning: n. 剧本提纲, 情节, 剧本, 方案, 事态;方案

examples.en: The drill rehearses a scenario in which both power lines fail.
examples.zh: 演习演练两条电力线路同时故障的情景。

meaning: n. 刻痕, 缺口, 划痕;vt. 刻痕于, 弄缺, 擦伤

examples.en: The blade left a small nick in the tabletop.
examples.zh: 刀刃在桌面留下一道小划痕。

meaning: n. 关闭;vt. 使终止

examples.en: Angry commuters protested the closure of the ticket office.
examples.zh: 愤怒的通勤者抗议售票处关停。

meaning: a. 有记号的, 显著的, 醒目的;有记号的; 显著的

examples.en: The patient showed a marked improvement after the therapy began.
examples.zh: 治疗开始后,病人明显好转。

meaning: a. 胃的;胃的

examples.en: The surgeon specializes in gastric surgery for chronic ulcer patients.
examples.zh: 这位外科医生专攻慢性溃疡的胃部手术。

meaning: n. 牧师

examples.en: The pastor opened a food bank in the church basement.
examples.zh: 牧师在教堂地下室开办食物银行。

meaning: n. 砰然的一击, 妙计, 出乎意料的行动, 政变;发作, 中, 击

examples.en: The novel opens with a coup that topples the aging president.
examples.zh: 小说以推翻年迈总统的政变开场。

meaning: n. 母体, 子宫, 基质, 脉石, 模型, 矩阵;矩阵

examples.en: The risk matrix ranks each hazard by likelihood and impact.
examples.zh: 风险矩阵按概率与影响为隐患分级。

meaning: n. 掮客, 经纪人;经纪人, 掮客

examples.en: An independent broker found the couple a cheaper flood policy.
examples.zh: 独立经纪人帮夫妇找到更便宜的洪水险。

meaning: n. 糖尿病, 多尿症;糖尿病; 多尿症

examples.en: Simple diet changes help him manage his diabetes without insulin.
examples.zh: 简单调整饮食让他无需胰岛素控糖。

meaning: n. 外地人, 粗野的人;a. 省的, 外地的, 偏狭的

examples.en: Provincial budgets rarely cover the cost of new rural bridges.
examples.zh: 省级预算很少覆盖新建乡村桥的费用。

meaning: n. 抗体;抗体

examples.en: Each antibody targets a single protein on the virus surface.
examples.zh: 每种抗体只针对病毒表面一种蛋白。

meaning: n. 经营行为, 行为, 交易;待遇, 处置, 行为

examples.en: His fair dealing with suppliers earned the merchant lasting trust.
examples.zh: 他与供应商公平往来,赢得长久信任。

meaning: n. 王室守林人, 骑警, 漫游者

examples.en: The park ranger showed us fresh lynx tracks by the stream.
examples.zh: 公园护林员指给我们看溪边猞猁的新足迹。

meaning: n. 契约, 盟约;v. 立契约, 缔结盟约

examples.en: The residents signed a covenant to keep the common meadow unmown.
examples.zh: 居民签署契约,约定公共草甸不修剪。

meaning: n. 遗嘱, <<圣约书>>;遗言, 遗嘱, 确实的证明

examples.en: The restored organ stands as a testament to forty years of volunteering.
examples.zh: 修复的管风琴见证四十年志愿付出。

meaning: n. 义勇军, 民兵组织, 国民军

examples.en: The local militia drilled on the green every Sunday after church.
examples.zh: 当地民兵每周日礼拜后在草场操练。

meaning: n. 测量员；检验员

examples.en: The surveyor confirmed the fence sat half a meter over the boundary.
examples.zh: 测量员确认栅栏越界半米。

meaning: n. 胆汁, 坏脾气, 暴躁;胆汁

examples.en: The liver produces bile that helps the gut absorb fats.
examples.zh: 肝脏分泌胆汁帮助肠道吸收脂肪。

meaning: n. 新手

examples.en: The rookie officer defused the dispute with calm, patient questions.
examples.zh: 新警员用冷静耐心的提问化解纠纷。

meaning: n. 内部的人, 权威人士, 知道内情的人;熟悉内情者

examples.en: An insider described the chaotic final hours before the studio's sale.
examples.zh: 知情人士讲述工作室出售前最后几小时的混乱。

meaning: n. 无罪, 无知, 天真无邪;无罪, 无罪的人, 清白无辜者

examples.en: DNA evidence finally proved his innocence after twelve years in prison.
examples.zh: 入狱十二年后,DNA证据终证其清白。

meaning: n. 矮种马;v. 借助逐字直译文翻译

examples.en: The children fed a shaggy pony at the farm's open day.
examples.zh: 开放日那天,孩子们在农场喂了毛茸茸的小马。

meaning: n. 快速的轻打, 轻打声, 弹开;v. 轻弹, 轻轻拂去, 忽然摇动

examples.en: With a flick of the wrist, the server opened the bottle.
examples.zh: 服务员手腕一抖,瓶塞应声而开。

meaning: n. 选民, 有选举权者, 选区;选民, 选举团, 选区

examples.en: The electorate punished the government for its broken railway promises.
examples.zh: 选民因政府背弃铁路承诺而惩罚它。

meaning: a. 字典的, 词汇的

examples.en: Learners often stumble at the lexical gaps between English and Japanese.
examples.zh: 学习者常卡在英语与日语的词汇空缺上。

meaning: n. 煮锅, 长柄浅锅

examples.en: Grandma's heavy skillet has fried fifty years of Sunday breakfasts.
examples.zh: 祖母的厚铁锅煎了五十年周日早餐。

meaning: n. 结果, 后果;后果, 结果

examples.en: In the aftermath of the storm, neighbors cleared each other's driveways.
examples.zh: 风暴过后,邻居互帮清理门前车道。

meaning: n. 教区牧师, 教堂主持, 代理人;代表, 代理牧师, 代理主教

examples.en: The vicar keeps bees behind the church and sells the honey.
examples.zh: 牧师在教堂后面养蜂并售蜜。

meaning: n. 颂歌, 欢乐的歌;v. 歌颂, 欢唱

examples.en: The children's carol service raised money for the local hospice.
examples.zh: 儿童颂歌礼拜为本地临终安养院筹款。

meaning: n. 公羊, 撞锤;vi. 猛击, 撞

examples.en: The ram butts the gate whenever strangers approach the pen.
examples.zh: 陌生人一近围栏,公羊便撞门。

meaning: n. 一回, 回合, 较量;发作

examples.en: A bout of flu kept the conductor away from opening night.
examples.zh: 一场流感让指挥错过首演之夜。

meaning: n. 赛马骑师, 驾驶员, 操作工;vt. 骗, 瞒, 驾驶, 移动

examples.en: The winning jockey thanked the stable staff in her interview.
examples.zh: 获胜骑师在采访中感谢马房员工。

meaning: vt. 取...最大值, 使增加(或扩大)到最大限度;最大化

examples.en: South-facing windows maximize the winter sun inside the passive house.
examples.zh: 朝南窗最大限度利用被动房的冬日阳光。

meaning: n. 胆汁, 五倍子, 苦味, 肿痛, 恼怒, 磨损处;vt. 烦恼, 屈辱, 磨伤

examples.en: He had the gall to demand an apology after breaking the vase.
examples.zh: 打碎花瓶后,他竟还好意思索要道歉。

meaning: vi. 排列, 排成一行, 结盟;vt. 使结盟, 使成一行, 校正

examples.en: The holes must align precisely before you tighten the bolts.
examples.zh: 拧螺栓前,孔位必须精确对齐。

meaning: n. 修道院, 僧侣

examples.en: The cliff monastery welcomes hikers with simple meals and quiet cells.
examples.zh: 悬崖修道院以简餐静室接待徒步者。

meaning: vi. 提出看法, 引起注意, 留意;n. 广告

examples.en: A single radio advert doubled inquiries at the cycling school.
examples.zh: 一则电台广告让骑行学校咨询翻倍。

meaning: n. 证明;证明

examples.en: Organic certification requires three years of soil tests and inspections.
examples.zh: 有机认证需三年土壤检测与检查。

meaning: n. 支配, 控制, 管辖

examples.en: The smaller party rejected any domination by its larger coalition partner.
examples.zh: 小党拒绝联盟大党的支配。

meaning: vt. 深植, 灌输, 嵌入;n. 植入物, 植入管

examples.en: The tiny implant relays sound directly to the inner ear.
examples.zh: 微小植入体把声音直接传入内耳。

meaning: n. 斜视眼, 斜着;a. 斜视的

examples.en: Readers squint at the faded handwriting in the margin notes.
examples.zh: 读者眯眼辨认页边褪色批注。

meaning: n. 统治, 统辖, 管理;统治, 管理, 支配

examples.en: The scandal forced the charity to rewrite its governance rules.
examples.zh: 丑闻迫使慈善机构重写治理规则。

meaning: n. 花名册

examples.en: Volunteers follow a weekly roster for the food bank shifts.
examples.zh: 志愿者按每周班表轮流服务食物银行。

meaning: n. 友好, 好意, 善意, 亲善, (企业享有的)信誉, 声誉;(企业的)商誉, 信誉

examples.en: Lending wheelchairs freely built years of goodwill for the pharmacy.
examples.zh: 免费出借轮椅为药店积攒多年好口碑。

meaning: n. 三重唱

examples.en: A jazz trio plays at the corner cafe every Friday.
examples.zh: 爵士三重奏每周五在街角咖啡馆演出。

meaning: n. 缓冲器, 缓冲区;vt. 缓冲

examples.en: The hedgerow acts as a buffer against wind erosion on the slope.
examples.zh: 灌木树篱起缓冲作用,减轻坡面风蚀。

meaning: n. 哮喘;气喘

examples.en: Cleaner school air sharply reduced the children's asthma attacks.
examples.zh: 校园空气改善,儿童哮喘发作锐减。

meaning: n. (英国)财政部, 国库;国库, 财源, 财政法院

examples.en: Medieval clerks of the exchequer recorded taxes on parchment tallies.
examples.zh: 中世纪财政部书吏以羊皮符木记税。

meaning: n. 火器, 枪炮

examples.en: Every firearm in the collection must be registered and stored locked.
examples.zh: 收藏的每支枪都必须登记并锁存。

meaning: n. 出庭律师, 律师;律师, 专门律师, 大律师

examples.en: The barrister argued the appeal before three senior judges.
examples.zh: 出庭律师在三位资深法官前辩护上诉。

meaning: n. 战栗, 发抖;vi. 战栗, 发抖

examples.en: The old lift gave a shudder before starting its slow climb.
examples.zh: 旧电梯颤了一下才缓缓上升。

meaning: a. 苍翠繁茂的, 多青草的, 丰富的;n. 酒, 酒鬼

examples.en: Spring rain turned the usually dry hillside lush and green.
examples.zh: 春雨让常年干旱的山坡郁郁葱葱。

meaning: n. 糖衣, 结冰

examples.en: Spread the icing evenly before it sets on the cake.
examples.zh: 趁糖霜未凝,把它均匀抹上蛋糕。

meaning: n. 冒号, 结肠;结肠

examples.en: The style guide says a colon should introduce the list of references.
examples.zh: 样式指南规定冒号用于引出参考文献列表。

meaning: a. 紧迫的, 迫切的, 热切的;n. 压, 压榨, 冲压件, 唱片

examples.en: Housing affordability is the most pressing issue facing the city council.
examples.zh: 住房负担能力是市议会面临的最紧迫问题。

meaning: vt. 拆除...的设备, 分解, 去除覆盖物

examples.en: Regulators ordered the company to dismantle its illegal surveillance network immediately.
examples.zh: 监管机构责令该公司立即拆除非法监控网络。

meaning: vi. 招徕顾客, 兜售物品;vt. 招徕, 刺探...情报

examples.en: Officials tout the new bridge as a solution to chronic traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 官员们吹捧新大桥是解决长期拥堵的良方。

meaning: a. 思索性的, 投机的, 推测的;投机的, 冒险的

examples.en: Much of the reporting on the merger remains purely speculative at this stage.
examples.zh: 目前关于合并的报道大多纯属猜测。

meaning: n. 礼节, 拘谨, 正式手续;克式浓度

examples.en: Signing the guest book was a mere formality before entering the conference.
examples.zh: 签字登记只是进入会场前的一道手续。

meaning: n. 袖口, 一巴掌;vt. 用巴掌打

examples.en: The tailor shortened the sleeves and adjusted the cuff on each wrist.
examples.zh: 裁缝改短了袖子并修整了每只袖口。

meaning: n. 耳环, 耳饰

examples.en: She lost a silver earring somewhere between the office and the subway.
examples.zh: 她在办公室到地铁站之间丢了一只银耳环。

meaning: n. 刺激, 烦恼, 刺激物;刺激, 兴奋

examples.en: Loud notifications are a constant source of irritation in the open office.
examples.zh: 大声的提示音是开放式办公室里持续的烦扰来源。

meaning: n. 匾, 饰板, 名牌, 勋章, 胸襟饰物, 血小板

examples.en: A bronze plaque beside the door records the building's founding date.
examples.zh: 门旁的铜牌记载着这栋建筑的建造年代。

meaning: n. 吸血鬼;吸血蝙蝠

examples.en: The novel reimagines the vampire as a lonely immigrant struggling to belong.
examples.zh: 这部小说把吸血鬼重塑为挣扎着寻找归属的孤独移民。

meaning: a. 独裁的, 独裁主义的

examples.en: The report documents how authoritarian regimes suppress independent journalism.
examples.zh: 报告记录了威权政权如何打压独立新闻业。

meaning: a. 可怕的, 悲惨的, 阴沉的, 极端的

examples.en: Economists issued dire warnings about the consequences of leaving the market.
examples.zh: 经济学家对退出该市场的后果发出了严厉警告。

meaning: n. 恶化, 衰退, 退化;变坏, 变质, 颓废, 衰退

examples.en: Doctors noted a gradual deterioration in the patient's memory over two years.
examples.zh: 医生注意到两年间患者记忆力的逐渐衰退。

meaning: a. 恶言谩骂的, 被滥用的, 腐败的, 虐待的

examples.en: The platform now removes abusive comments within hours of being reported.
examples.zh: 该平台现在会在举报后数小时内删除辱骂性评论。

meaning: a. 愚笨的, 癫狂的, 狂闹的

examples.en: It sounds daft, but the simplest fix solved the entire problem.
examples.zh: 听起来很傻，但最简单的办法解决了全部问题。

meaning: n. 令状, 文书, 文件, 书面命令;法院命令

examples.en: The lawyer filed a writ to block the demolition of the old theater.
examples.zh: 律师申请了令状以阻止老剧院的拆除。

meaning: n. 重罪;重罪, 重刑罪

examples.en: In many states, forging a signature on a contract remains a felony.
examples.zh: 在许多州，在合同上伪造签名仍是重罪。

meaning: n. 营, 军队, 集团

examples.en: A reserve battalion was deployed to help families affected by the floods.
examples.zh: 一个预备营被派往帮助受洪水影响的家庭。

meaning: n. 陋屋, 棚屋;vi. 居住, 暂住

examples.en: They lived in a wooden shack at the edge of the sugarcane fields.
examples.zh: 他们住在甘蔗田边一间简陋的木屋里。

meaning: a. 谋叛的, 起义的, 澎湃的;n. 起义者, 叛乱者

examples.en: The government blamed insurgent groups for the attack on the border post.
examples.zh: 政府指责叛乱组织袭击了边境哨所。

meaning: n. 改革运动, 十字军东侵;vi. 从事改革运动, 加入十字军

examples.en: She launched a personal crusade against food waste in school cafeterias.
examples.zh: 她发起了针对学校食堂食物浪费的个人运动。

meaning: n. 躯干, 裸体躯干雕像;躯干

examples.en: The scanner maps the torso to tailor the jacket precisely.
examples.zh: 扫描仪对躯干建模，以便精确裁剪这件夹克。

meaning: a. 辩论的, 法院的, 关于法庭的;n. 辩论练习

examples.en: Forensic accountants traced the missing funds to an offshore shell company.
examples.zh: 法务会计师把失踪的资金追踪到一家离岸空壳公司。

meaning: vt. 解开...的皮带, 发出, 发动

examples.en: The central bank's decision could unleash a wave of foreign investment.
examples.zh: 央行的决定可能引发一波外国投资浪潮。

meaning: n. 母马, 母驴, 月球表面阴暗部;海

examples.en: The old mare still carries visitors along the canyon trail each morning.
examples.zh: 这匹老母马每天清晨仍驮着游客走峡谷小径。

meaning: n. 手镯;手镯, 腕带, 腕纹(掌侧横列腕部的线纹)

examples.en: She wove a friendship bracelet from threads in three school colors.
examples.zh: 她用三种校色的线编了一条友情手链。

meaning: a. 兽医的;n. 兽医

examples.en: The veterinary clinic offers free checkups for pets of senior residents.
examples.zh: 这家兽医诊所为老年居民的宠物提供免费体检。

meaning: n. 统一, 联合, 一致;连结; 统一

examples.en: Historians still debate the economic effects of German unification in 1990.
examples.zh: 历史学家仍在争论1990年德国统一的经济影响。

meaning: n. (事物的)主体, 文集, 本金, 语料库;体

examples.en: The linguists built a corpus of ten million words from online forums.
examples.zh: 语言学家用网络论坛文本建成了千万词级的语料库。

meaning: n. 肝炎;肝炎

examples.en: The clinic launched a vaccination drive against hepatitis in rural districts.
examples.zh: 诊所在农村地区发起了肝炎疫苗接种行动。

meaning: n. 喃喃而语, 咕哝;v. 喃喃而语, 咕哝

examples.en: Students often mumble their answers when they are unsure of the facts.
examples.zh: 学生对答案没把握时往往含糊作答。

meaning: vt. 推翻, 颠覆;vi. 倒塌, 摇摇欲坠

examples.en: Protesters tried to topple the statue in the central square.
examples.zh: 抗议者试图推倒中央广场上的雕像。

meaning: n. 杏仁;杏仁

examples.en: She sprinkled sliced almond pieces over the salad before serving it.
examples.zh: 上桌前她在沙拉上撒了杏仁片。

meaning: n. 取得, 捕获, 进款;a. 迷人的, 可爱的, 会传染的

examples.en: The taking of photographs inside the museum is strictly prohibited.
examples.zh: 博物馆展厅内严禁拍摄任何照片。

meaning: n. 活泼, 生气, 激励, 卡通制作;动画

examples.en: The studio's animation team spent three years on the twelve-minute film.
examples.zh: 工作室的动画团队为这部十二分钟的影片耗时三年。

meaning: a. 裸的, 肉色的, 无装饰的;n. 裸体画, 裸体

examples.en: The gallery removed the nude portrait after complaints from several visitors.
examples.zh: 几位游客投诉后，美术馆撤下了那幅裸体肖像。

meaning: a. 鼻的, 鼻声的, 尖锐的;n. 鼻音, 鼻音字

examples.en: The dialect is recognizable by its distinctive nasal vowels.
examples.zh: 这种方言以其独特的鼻化元音被人辨识。

meaning: n. 轨道, 弹道, 轨线;轨道

examples.en: The satellite altered its trajectory to avoid a cluster of debris.
examples.zh: 卫星改变轨道以避开一片碎片群。

meaning: n. 阁楼, 鸽房, 楼上;vt. 储存于阁楼上

examples.en: They converted the dusty loft into a bright studio for painting.
examples.zh: 他们把积灰的阁楼改造成明亮的画室。

meaning: n. 板条箱, 装货箱;篓, 筐

examples.en: Workers lifted each wooden crate onto the truck with a small crane.
examples.zh: 工人们用小吊车把每个木箱吊上卡车。

meaning: a. 光滑的, 熟练的, 聪明的, 华而不实的, 老套的, 陈腐的;adv. 灵活地, 聪明地

examples.en: The roads were slick after the freezing rain, so traffic crawled along slowly.
examples.zh: 冻雨过后路面湿滑，车辆只能缓慢前行。

meaning: n. 加冕礼

examples.en: The exhibition displays costumes worn at the coronation two centuries ago.
examples.zh: 展览展出了两百年前加冕典礼上穿过的礼服。

meaning: n. 摸索, 笨拙的行动, 漏球;vt. 摸索, 乱摸, 笨拙的处理, 漏接(球)

examples.en: Quarterbacks often fumble the ball when defenders break through the line.
examples.zh: 防守队员突破防线时，四分卫常会掉球。

meaning: n. 手榴弹

examples.en: New recruits practiced throwing a grenade accurately from a concealed trench.
examples.zh: 新兵练习从掩体中准确投掷手榴弹。

meaning: n. 哀叫声, 嘎嘎声, 哀鸣;vi. 哭诉, 嘎嘎响, 发呜呜声

examples.en: The old generator would whine loudly whenever the load increased.
examples.zh: 每当负荷增加，那台老发电机就会呜呜作响。

meaning: n. 胎儿;胎, 胎儿

examples.en: Ultrasound imaging lets doctors monitor the fetus throughout the pregnancy.
examples.zh: 超声成像让医生能在整个孕期监测胎儿。

meaning: 偏激份子

examples.en: The lecture examined how extremist ideas spread through online communities.
examples.zh: 讲座分析了极端主义思想如何通过网络社群传播。

meaning: vt. 以大写字母写, 使资本化, 估计...的价值;资本化, 收益的现值化

examples.en: Startups must capitalize on emerging trends before larger competitors arrive.
examples.zh: 初创公司必须趁大公司进场前利用新兴趋势。

meaning: n. 墩座, 矮隔墙, 指挥台;足, 吸足

examples.en: She stepped onto the podium and thanked her research team first.
examples.zh: 她走上领奖台，首先感谢了自己的研究团队。

meaning: n. 箍, 铁环, 呼呼声;vt. 加箍于, 包围

examples.en: The children rolled a wooden hoop down the cobblestone street.
examples.zh: 孩子们沿着鹅卵石街道滚动一只木环。

meaning: n. 节目主持人, 奉献者, 提出者;告发者, 提出者, 推荐者

examples.en: The presenter opened the session with a question about data privacy.
examples.zh: 主讲人以一个关于数据隐私的问题开启会议。

meaning: a. 就任的, 开幕的;n. 就职演讲

examples.en: The orchestra's inaugural concert raised funds for the new music school.
examples.zh: 乐团的首场音乐会为新音乐学校筹款。

meaning: n. 四重奏;四位字节

examples.en: A jazz quartet played quietly in the corner of the lobby.
examples.zh: 一支爵士四重奏在大堂角落里轻声演奏。

meaning: n. 残暴, 凶恶, 暴行;暴行, 残酷, 残忍

examples.en: The memorial preserves the memory of every documented atrocity of the war.
examples.zh: 纪念馆保存着战争中每一起有案可查的暴行的记忆。

meaning: n. 骑兵

examples.en: The museum preserves the uniforms once worn by the imperial cavalry.
examples.zh: 博物馆保存着帝国骑兵曾穿过的军服。

meaning: a. 假设的, 有待证实的, 假定的, 有前提的;理想的

examples.en: The seminar discussed a hypothetical case of two companies sharing data.
examples.zh: 研讨会讨论了两家公司共享数据的假设案例。

meaning: n. 熟悉, 精通, 亲密

examples.en: Her familiarity with local regulations made the permit process much easier.
examples.zh: 她对当地法规的熟悉使许可申请顺利许多。

meaning: n. 教会法规, 圣典, 准则, 标准, 教士;规范, 炮

examples.en: This novel belongs to the canon of nineteenth century literature.
examples.zh: 这部小说属于十九世纪文学的经典之列。

meaning: n. 保镖, 护卫

examples.en: A bodyguard escorted the ambassador through the crowd of reporters.
examples.zh: 一名保镖护送大使穿过记者群。

meaning: n. 军官学校学生;军校学生

examples.en: Every cadet must complete a survival course before graduation.
examples.zh: 每名学员毕业前都必须完成野外生存课程。

meaning: n. 凉鞋, 拖鞋, 檀香木;vt. 穿以便鞋

examples.en: He left a sandal behind on the crowded summer beach.
examples.zh: 他把一只凉鞋落在了拥挤的夏日海滩上。

meaning: n. 步兵, 步兵团

examples.en: Her grandfather served in an infantry regiment during the winter campaign.
examples.zh: 她祖父在冬季战役中服役于一个步兵团。

meaning: n. 指示, 指定, 命名;指定

examples.en: The valley received a national park designation after years of lobbying.
examples.zh: 经过多年游说，这个山谷获得了国家公园的命名。

meaning: v. 司炉, (使)大吃

examples.en: Some commentators stoke anxiety with exaggerated claims about the technology.
examples.zh: 一些评论者用夸张的说法煽动对这项技术的焦虑。

meaning: a. 怪诞的, 可怕的, 奇异的, 令人迷惑不解的

examples.en: An eerie silence filled the stadium after the final whistle.
examples.zh: 终场哨响后，体育场陷入一片诡异的寂静。

meaning: n. 下士;a. 肉体的, 身体的, 个人的

examples.en: The corporal led the new recruits on their first night march.
examples.zh: 下士带领新兵进行了第一次夜间行军。

meaning: n. 劈, 砍, 砍痕, 出租车, 干咳, 晒架, 鹤嘴锄;vt. 劈, 砍, 出租, 用旧

examples.en: Security experts demonstrated how intruders could hack the router in minutes.
examples.zh: 安全专家演示了入侵者如何在几分钟内攻破该路由器。

meaning: a. 所有者的, 所有权的, 私有的;n. 所有者, 业主, 所有权

examples.en: The firm declined to share its proprietary algorithm with the auditors.
examples.zh: 该公司拒绝与审计人员分享其专有算法。

meaning: 选择的

examples.en: Managers receive a discretionary budget for team training each quarter.
examples.zh: 经理每季度获得一笔可自由支配的培训预算。

meaning: a. 纪念碑的, 做为纪念的, 不朽的

examples.en: Cataloguing the archive was a monumental task that took a decade.
examples.zh: 编目这份档案是一项历时十年的浩大工程。

meaning: n. 美洲山核桃(树)

examples.en: She baked a pecan pie for the neighborhood gathering on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日她为邻里聚会烤了一个山核桃派。

meaning: n. 牢牢抓住, 钉紧, 敲弯钉尖;vt. 紧握, 牢牢地抓住, 确定, 敲弯

examples.en: He would clench his fists whenever the negotiation turned tense.
examples.zh: 每当谈判变得紧张，他就会攥紧拳头。

meaning: n. 特性描述, 人物之塑造;特性因数

examples.en: Critics praised the novel's characterization of a family across three generations.
examples.zh: 评论家称赞小说对三代一个家庭的刻画。

meaning: n. 葡萄糖;葡萄糖; 右旋糖; 葡糖(用于复合词中)

examples.en: The sensor tracks glucose levels and sends alerts to her phone.
examples.zh: 传感器追踪血糖水平并向她的手机发送提醒。

meaning: n. 词汇, 词典, 辞典;辞典

examples.en: Terms like streaming have entered the everyday lexicon within a decade.
examples.zh: 诸如流媒体之类的词十年间就进入了日常用语。

meaning: vt. 节省, 限制, 停止;vi. 节约

examples.en: Her stint abroad gave the firm valuable insight into European markets.
examples.zh: 她在海外的历练让公司获得了对欧洲市场的洞察。

meaning: a. 末梢的;远侧的, 远中的(牙)

examples.en: The fracture lies near the distal end of the radius bone.
examples.zh: 骨折位于桡骨远端附近。

meaning: n. 豆荚, (豆荚状的)保护性外壳, 扁豆形矿体;vt. 从豆荚中剥出

examples.en: The children split open a pea pod to count the seeds inside.
examples.zh: 孩子们剥开豆荚数里面的豆粒。

meaning: vt. 赋予实质, 使体现, 物质化;vi. 成有形, 体现, 实现

examples.en: The promised funding never materialized, so the lab closed the project.
examples.zh: 承诺的资金迟迟没有到位，实验室便终止了项目。

meaning: n. 徘徊, 粗纺, 流浪;vt. 漂泊于, 漫游于

examples.en: Armed with a camera, he would rove the old harbor at dawn.
examples.zh: 他带着相机，常在黎明时分漫游老港口。

meaning: n. 巩固, 团结, 合并, 加强;实变

examples.en: The merger led to the consolidation of three regional banks into one.
examples.zh: 这场并购使三家地区银行合并为一家。

meaning: n. 耻辱, 污名, 烙印;柱头; 小孔, 眼点; 气孔; 小斑; 特征

examples.en: The campaign aims to reduce the stigma surrounding mental health treatment.
examples.zh: 这场运动旨在减少围绕心理健康治疗的污名。

meaning: a. 有益的, 有报酬的, 报答的

examples.en: Volunteering at the shelter proved more rewarding than she had expected.
examples.zh: 在收容所做志愿者比她预想的更有意义。

meaning: vt. 使再结合, 再加入, 回答;vi. 重新聚合, 回答, 第二次答辩

examples.en: After the sabbatical, she will rejoin the department as a senior lecturer.
examples.zh: 休假结束后，她将以高级讲师身份重返该系。

meaning: n. 毒素;毒素

examples.en: The lab identified a toxin produced by bacteria in the contaminated water.
examples.zh: 实验室鉴定出污染水中的细菌产生的一种毒素。

meaning: n. 敲击, 破布;vt. 打补钉

examples.en: Regional brands struggle to match the clout of international competitors.
examples.zh: 区域品牌难以匹敌国际竞争者的影响力。

meaning: n. 钩, 弯曲部分, 坏蛋;vt. 使弯曲, 诈骗

examples.en: The informant confirmed that the crook had fled to a coastal town.
examples.zh: 线人确认那名骗子已逃往一座海滨小镇。

meaning: n. 假货, 假冒者, 赝品;a. 伪造的, 假的, 不可信的, 华而不实的

examples.en: The regulator fined the firm for publishing phony performance figures.
examples.zh: 监管机构因该公司发布虚假业绩数据而处以罚款。

meaning: a. 不矫揉造作的, 自然的, 未受影响的, 未被感动的;不受影响的

examples.en: The island's villages were largely unaffected by the mainland power failure.
examples.zh: 岛上的村庄基本没有受到大陆停电的影响。

meaning: n. 假发, 斥责;vt. 给...戴假发, 激怒, 使发狂

examples.en: The actor wore a gray wig for the role of the aging judge.
examples.zh: 演员戴上灰色假发出演年迈的法官。

meaning: a. 令人毛骨悚然的, 感到恐惧的

examples.en: Survivors described the horrific conditions inside the overcrowded detention center.
examples.zh: 幸存者描述了过度拥挤的拘留中心里的恐怖状况。

meaning: vi. 证明, 表明, 作证;vt. 为...作证

examples.en: Thousands of letters attest to the lasting impact of her teaching.
examples.zh: 数以千计的信件证明了她教学的长远影响。

meaning: n. 管, 输送管;vt. 通过管道输送

examples.en: Dust had collected in the air duct above the office ceiling.
examples.zh: 办公室天花板上方的通风管道里积了灰尘。

meaning: n. 舵, 驾驶盘, 枢机, 头盔;vt. 给...掌舵, 指挥, 给...戴头盔

examples.en: She took the helm of the newspaper during its most difficult year.
examples.zh: 她在报社最艰难的一年执掌大权。

meaning: a. (似)患妄想狂的, (似)患偏执狂的;n. 患妄想狂的人

examples.en: Constant surveillance made the workers paranoid about every email they sent.
examples.zh: 持续的监控让员工对发出的每封邮件都疑神疑鬼。

meaning: n. 假装, 虚伪, 借口, 自称, 要求;假装, 借口, 托词

examples.en: He kept up the pretence of running a legitimate shipping business.
examples.zh: 他一直伪装经营着一家合法的航运公司。

meaning: n. 马夫, 新郎, 男仆;vt. 喂马, 使...整洁, 推荐

examples.en: Riders groom the horses early each morning before the tourists arrive.
examples.zh: 骑手们每天清晨在游客到来前先给马匹刷洗。

meaning: vi. 舒适地坐定, 挨靠, 偎依;vt. 抱, 安置

examples.en: The village seems to nestle between two steep forested hills.
examples.zh: 村庄仿佛安卧在两座陡峭的林木葱郁的山丘之间。

meaning: a. 直觉的

examples.en: The app's intuitive interface lets new users publish within minutes.
examples.zh: 这款应用直观的界面让新用户几分钟内就能发布内容。

meaning: a. 无污点的, 纯洁的, 无缺点的, 无辜的;无斑点, 无瑕疵的, 洁净的

examples.en: The kitchen was immaculate, with every knife arranged by size.
examples.zh: 厨房一尘不染，每把刀都按大小摆放。

meaning: n. 权宜之计, 临时代用品;a. 权宜的, 临时代用的

examples.en: Refugees slept in makeshift shelters along the railway embankment.
examples.zh: 难民睡在铁路路堤旁的临时窝棚里。

meaning: v. 招手示意, 召唤, 吸引;n. 表召唤的点头(或手势)

examples.en: Bright shop windows beckon pedestrians into the winter market.
examples.zh: 明亮的橱窗吸引行人走进冬季市场。

meaning: a. 叭嗒叭嗒响的, 松软的

examples.en: The old server in the basement still reads data from floppy disks.
examples.zh: 地下室那台老服务器仍能读取软盘上的数据。

meaning: n. 畏缩, 退避;vi. 畏缩, 退缩, 退避

examples.en: He would wince whenever the dentist touched the broken molar.
examples.zh: 牙医一碰到那颗坏牙，他就疼得皱眉。

meaning: n. 贵族, 上层社会, 知识界杰出分子;贵族政治, 贵族统治

examples.en: The palace's fortunes declined as the aristocracy lost its political power.
examples.zh: 随着贵族失去政治权力，宫殿的境况也衰落了。

meaning: a. 得到灵感的, 有灵感的, 官方授意的

examples.en: Her lecture inspired many students to pursue careers in ecology.
examples.zh: 她的讲座激励许多学生投身生态学事业。

meaning: a. 脑的, 大脑的;小脑的

examples.en: The film rewards patient viewers with its cerebral, layered storytelling.
examples.zh: 这部影片以理性而层次丰富的叙事回报耐心的观众。

meaning: vi. 自然增加, 产生;应计, 产生, 出现

examples.en: Interest will accrue on the unpaid balance after the grace period.
examples.zh: 宽限期后，未付余额将开始累积利息。

meaning: n. 摄政者, 摄政王;a. 摄政的

examples.en: The regent ruled wisely until the young king came of age.
examples.zh: 摄政王明智地统治，直到年幼的国王成年亲政。

meaning: n. 犯人, 罪犯, 刑事被告;犯罪者, 犯人, 罪犯

examples.en: Investigators found that a faulty cable was the main culprit.
examples.zh: 调查人员发现故障电缆是罪魁祸首。

meaning: a. 好争吵的, 爱争论的, 有异议的;诉讼的, 争执的, 引起争论的

examples.en: Water rights remain the most contentious issue between the two states.
examples.zh: 水权仍是两州之间最具争议的问题。

meaning: n. 隐藏所, 隐藏的粮食或物资, 贮藏物, 高速缓冲存储器;vt. 隐藏, 窖藏

examples.en: Hikers discovered a cache of supplies hidden near the mountain hut.
examples.zh: 徒步者在山间小屋附近发现了一批隐藏的补给。

meaning: n. 替代者, 代用品;vt. 代理, 替代

examples.en: The study used test scores as a surrogate for overall learning.
examples.zh: 该研究用考试分数作为整体学习效果的替代指标。

meaning: n. 弹幕, 掩护炮火;vt. 以密集炮火进攻

examples.en: The minister faced a barrage of questions about the missing documents.
examples.zh: 部长就文件失踪一事遭遇连番追问。

meaning: a. 根本不同的, 全异的, 不相干的;n. 无法相比的东西(或人)

examples.en: The anthology weaves disparate voices from twelve countries into one narrative.
examples.zh: 这部选集将十二个国家的迥异声音织成一个叙事。

meaning: n. 磨刀石, 抱怨, 想念;vt. 用磨刀石磨, 磨练

examples.en: Interns hone their reporting skills under the guidance of senior editors.
examples.zh: 实习生在资深编辑指导下磨练报道技能。

meaning: a. 清晰的, 轮廓分明的；有定义的, 确定的

examples.en: The job comes with clearly defined responsibilities and measurable targets.
examples.zh: 这份工作职责明确，目标可衡量。

meaning: a. 幻像的, 幻想的, 梦想的;n. 有眼力的人, 空想家, 梦想者

examples.en: Critics called the architect a visionary whose plans were decades ahead.
examples.zh: 评论家称这位建筑师有远见，其设计领先时代数十年。

meaning: a. 黝暗的, 阴沉的, 朦胧的

examples.en: The report traced the funds through a murky network of holding companies.
examples.zh: 报告追踪了资金流经的一个不透明的控股公司网络。

meaning: a. 有毛病的, 出差错的;adv. 错误地, 不顺当, 有缺陷地

examples.en: Engineers sensed something amiss in the turbine's vibration data.
examples.zh: 工程师察觉涡轮机的振动数据有些不对劲。

meaning: vt. 比喻, 比拟

examples.en: Reviewers liken the young composer's style to early Debussy.
examples.zh: 评论者把这位年轻作曲家的风格比作早期的德彪西。

meaning: n. 昏迷, 麻木, 彗发;彗差; 彗形像差

examples.en: The patient emerged from the coma after three difficult weeks.
examples.zh: 病人在煎熬的三周后从昏迷中苏醒。

meaning: a. 暴露的, 显露的, 揭露的

examples.en: The documentary offers a revealing look at the fashion industry's supply chain.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片对时尚产业的供应链作了深刻的揭示。

meaning: vt. 登记, 铭记于, 题写, 雕刻;书写

examples.en: Winners asked the author to inscribe their copies of the novel.
examples.zh: 获奖者请作者在他们的小说上题词签名。

meaning: n. 凤凰, 不死鸟, 死而复生的人, 完人, 殊品

examples.en: The city rose like a phoenix after the great fire of 1906.
examples.zh: 这座城市在1906年大火之后如凤凰般重生。

meaning: n. 土窖, 地穴, 地下室;隐窝; 滤泡, 腺管

examples.en: Archaeologists opened the crypt beneath the cathedral last summer.
examples.zh: 考古学家去年夏天打开了教堂地下的墓室。

meaning: n. 肉峰, 预感, 大块;vt. 弯腰驼背, 预感到, 耸肩

examples.en: Her hunch that demand would fall proved correct by autumn.
examples.zh: 她预感需求会下降，到秋天果然应验。

meaning: n. 威吓者, 虚张声势的人;vt.vi. 说大话, 吓唬, 折磨, 愚弄

examples.en: He would hector the staff about deadlines instead of offering help.
examples.zh: 他只会就期限咄咄逼人地训斥员工，却从不帮忙。

meaning: n. 芦笋;天冬; 天门冬

examples.en: The market sells fresh asparagus only during a few spring weeks.
examples.zh: 市场只在春季的短短几周出售新鲜芦笋。

meaning: n. 仙人掌;仙人掌属

examples.en: A tall cactus stands at the entrance of the desert reserve.
examples.zh: 沙漠保护区入口处矗立着一株高大的仙人掌。

meaning: a. 不被注意的, 被忽视的;未被注意的, 未被顾及的:不瞩目的

examples.en: The error slipped unnoticed into the final version of the report.
examples.zh: 这个错误悄无声息地混进了报告的最终版本。

meaning: vt. 重新洗牌, 改组, 撤换;n. 重新洗牌, 改组, 撤换

examples.en: The prime minister announced a cabinet reshuffle after the budget defeat.
examples.zh: 预算案受挫后，首相宣布改组内阁。

meaning: n. 稳定的进程, 思路, 要旨, 大意, 誊本, 票据的限期, 男高音;a. 男高音的

examples.en: The tenor of the negotiations shifted after the election results.
examples.zh: 选举结果之后，谈判的基调发生了转变。

meaning: n. 歌谣

examples.en: The closing ballad reduced much of the audience to tears.
examples.zh: 结尾的抒情歌让许多观众潸然泪下。

meaning: n. 调和, 和谐, 一致, 齐唱, 齐奏;a. 共同做的, 同声的

examples.en: The crowd rose in unison to applaud the returning athletes.
examples.zh: 人群齐声起立，为归来的运动员鼓掌。

meaning: n. 甜菜(根);甜菜
